000264 |     /// Reads account metadata without creating directories or trusting the legacy current mirror.
000265 |     pub fn inspect(root: &Path, active: &Path, owner: u32) -> io::Result<AccountStatus> {
000266 |         if owner != unsafe { libc::geteuid() } {
000267 |             return Err(denied("account owner is not the current user"));
000268 |         }
000269 |         if !root.is_absolute()

000271 |             || root.starts_with(active)
000272 |             || active.starts_with(root)
000273 |         {
000274 |             return Err(denied("invalid or overlapping account roots"));
000275 |         }
000276 |         let store = Self {
000277 |             root: root.to_owned(),
000278 |             active: active.to_owned(),
000279 |             owner,
000280 |         };
000281 |         if optional_identity(root)?.is_none() {
000282 |             storage::validate_no_symlinks(
000283 |                 root.parent()
000284 |                     .ok_or_else(|| invalid("missing root parent"))?,
000285 |             )?;
000286 |             return Ok(AccountStatus {
000287 |                 current: Some(AccountId::A),
000288 |                 a_saved: false,
000289 |                 b_saved: false,
000290 |                 recovery_pending: false,
000291 |             });

000293 |         store.check_directory(root)?;
000294 |         for directory in [store.v2(), store.transactions()] {
000295 |             if optional_identity(&directory)?.is_some() {
000296 |                 store.check_directory(&directory)?;

000300 |             if optional_identity(&store.archive(account))?.is_some() {
000301 |                 storage::validate_no_symlinks(&store.archive(account))?;
000302 |             }
000303 |         }
000304 |         store.status()
000305 |     }
000306 |     /// Root and active directory must be explicit, disjoint, real directories.
000307 |     pub fn new(root: &Path, active: &Path, owner: u32) -> io::Result<Self> {

000309 |             return Err(denied("account owner is not the current user"));
000310 |         }
000311 |         storage::validate_no_symlinks(root)?;

000317 |             root: root.to_owned(),

000453 |     pub(crate) fn initialize_with_copy(
000454 |         &self,
000455 |         lock: &LifecycleLock,
000456 |         stopped: &dyn Fn() -> io::Result<()>,
000457 |         bind: &mut dyn FnMut(&InitializationCopy) -> io::Result<()>,
000458 |         hook: &mut dyn FnMut(&str) -> io::Result<()>,
000459 |     ) -> io::Result<()> {
000460 |         self.check_lock(lock)?;
000461 |         stopped()?;
000462 |         self.no_journal()?;
000463 |         if self.state()?.is_some() {
000464 |             return Err(invalid("account state already initialized"));
000465 |         }

000470 |                 "existing archives require explicit association or manual recovery",
000471 |             ));

000476 |         let copy = InitializationCopy {
000477 |             transaction: tx.file_name().unwrap().to_str().unwrap().to_owned(),
000478 |             directory: identity(&staging)?,
000479 |             hash,
000480 |         };
000481 |         hook("copy_completed")?;
000482 |         // The coordinator must persist the full copy binding before any rename.
000483 |         bind(&copy)?;
000484 |         hook("copy_bound")?;
000485 |         self.finish_initialization(lock, &copy, stopped, hook)
000486 |     }
000487 |     pub(crate) fn validate_initialization_copy(&self, copy: &InitializationCopy) -> io::Result<()> {
000488 |         if !valid_hash(&copy.hash)
000489 |             || copy.transaction.len() > 80
000490 |             || !copy.transaction.starts_with("tx-")
000491 |             || !copy
000492 |                 .transaction
000493 |                 .bytes()
000494 |                 .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || byte == b'-')
000495 |         {
000496 |             return Err(invalid("invalid initialization copy binding"));
000497 |         }
000498 |         let staging = self.transactions().join(&copy.transaction).join("incoming");
000499 |         let archive = self.archive(AccountId::A);
000500 |         let path = match (optional_identity(&staging)?, optional_identity(&archive)?) {
000501 |             (Some(staged), None) if staged == copy.directory => staging,
000502 |             (None, Some(archived)) if archived == copy.directory => archive,
000503 |             _ => return Err(invalid("initialization copy identity conflict")),
000504 |         };
000505 |         if self.fingerprint(&path)?.0 != copy.hash {
000506 |             return Err(invalid("initialization copy changed"));
000507 |         }
000508 |         Ok(())
000509 |     }
000510 |     pub(crate) fn finish_initialization(
000511 |         &self,
000512 |         lock: &LifecycleLock,
000513 |         copy: &InitializationCopy,
000514 |         stopped: &dyn Fn() -> io::Result<()>,
000515 |         hook: &mut dyn FnMut(&str) -> io::Result<()>,
000516 |     ) -> io::Result<()> {
000517 |         self.check_lock(lock)?;
000518 |         stopped()?;
000519 |         self.no_journal()?;
000520 |         self.validate_initialization_copy(copy)?;
000521 |         let tx = self.transactions().join(&copy.transaction);
000522 |         let staging = tx.join("incoming");
000523 |         if optional_identity(&staging)?.is_some() {
000524 |             if self.state()?.is_some() {
000525 |                 return Err(invalid("state precedes initialization archive"));
000526 |             }
000527 |             fs::rename(&staging, self.archive(AccountId::A))?;
000528 |             storage::sync_directory(&self.archives())?;
000529 |             storage::sync_directory(&tx)?;
000530 |         }
000531 |         hook("archive_renamed")?;
000532 |         let state = ActiveState {
000533 |             schema: 1,
000534 |             account: AccountId::A,
000535 |             generation: 1,
000536 |             directory: identity(&self.active)?,
000537 |             transaction: None,
000538 |         };
000539 |         match self.state()? {
000540 |             Some(existing) if existing != state => {
000541 |                 return Err(invalid("initialization state conflicts"));
000542 |             }
000543 |             None => storage::atomic_json(&self.state_path(), &state)?,
000544 |             _ => {}
000545 |         }
000546 |         hook("state_written")?;
000547 |         self.mirror(AccountId::A)?;
000548 |         if optional_identity(&tx)?.is_some() {
000549 |             fs::remove_dir(&tx)?;
000550 |         }
000551 |         storage::sync_directory(&self.transactions())
000552 |     }
000553 |     /// For an existing A archive with missing current/state. No association is inferred.
000554 |     pub fn preview_association_a(&self) -> io::Result<AssociationPreview> {
000555 |         self.no_journal()?;
000556 |         if self.state()?.is_some() {
000557 |             return Err(invalid("association requires missing active state"));
000558 |         }
000559 |         let active_hash = self.fingerprint(&self.active)?.0;
000560 |         if active_hash != self.fingerprint(&self.archive(AccountId::A))?.0 {
000561 |             return Err(invalid(

000563 |             ));
000564 |         }

000569 |         })
000570 |     }

000634 |         lock: &LifecycleLock,

000640 |     /// The coordinator revalidates its private permit after copying and immediately before exchange.
000641 |     #[cfg(test)]
000642 |     pub(crate) fn switch_guarded(
000643 |         &self,
000644 |         target: AccountId,
000645 |         lock: &LifecycleLock,
000646 |         stopped: &dyn Fn() -> io::Result<()>,
000647 |         before_exchange: &dyn Fn() -> io::Result<()>,
000648 |         hook: &mut dyn FnMut(&str) -> io::Result<()>,
000649 |     ) -> io::Result<()> {
000650 |         self.check_lock(lock)?;
000651 |         stopped()?;
000652 |         self.no_journal()?;
000653 |         let before = self
000654 |             .state()?
000655 |             .ok_or_else(|| invalid("initialize or associate account A first"))?;
000656 |         if before.directory != identity(&self.active)? {
000657 |             return Err(invalid("active identity differs from committed state"));
000658 |         }
000659 |         if before.account == target {
000660 |             return self.mirror(target);
000661 |         }
000662 |         let (original_hash, _) = self.fingerprint(&self.active)?;
000663 |         let (target_hash, _) = self.fingerprint(&self.archive(target))?;
000664 |         let target_archive = identity(&self.archive(target))?;
000665 |         let old_archive = optional_identity(&self.archive(before.account))?;
000666 |         if old_archive.is_some() {
000667 |             self.fingerprint(&self.archive(before.account))?;
000668 |         }
000669 |         let tx = self.new_transaction()?;
000670 |         let incoming = tx.join("incoming");
000671 |         let staged_hash = self.copy_verified(&self.archive(target), &incoming)?;
000672 |         let mut journal = Journal {
000673 |             schema: 1,
000674 |             transaction: tx.file_name().unwrap().to_str().unwrap().to_owned(),
000675 |             phase: Phase::Prepared,
000676 |             original: before.directory,
000677 |             staged: identity(&incoming)?,
000678 |             target_archive,
000679 |             old_archive,
000680 |             transaction_directory: identity(&tx)?,
000681 |             before,
000682 |             target,
000683 |             original_hash,
000684 |             target_hash,
000685 |             staged_hash: Some(staged_hash),
000686 |         };
000687 |         self.write_journal(&journal)?;
000688 |         hook("prepared")?;
000689 |         journal.phase = Phase::SwapIntent;
000690 |         self.write_journal(&journal)?;
000691 |         hook("swap_intent")?;
000692 |         stopped()?;
000693 |         self.validate_pre_swap(&journal, &incoming)?;
000694 |         before_exchange()?;
000695 |         exchange(&self.active, &incoming)?;
000696 |         self.sync_exchange(&incoming)?;
000697 |         hook("after_swap")?;
000698 |         journal.phase = Phase::Swapped;
000699 |         self.write_journal(&journal)?;
000700 |         hook("swapped")?;
000701 |         self.finish(&mut journal, stopped, hook)
000702 |     }
000703 |     pub fn recover(&self) -> io::Result<()> {
000704 |         let lock = LifecycleLock::try_acquire(&self.v2())?;
000705 |         self.recover_with_lock(&lock)
000706 |     }
000707 |     pub fn recover_with_lock(&self, lock: &LifecycleLock) -> io::Result<()> {
000708 |         self.recover_legacy_checked(lock, &|| ensure_claude_stopped(self.owner))
000709 |     }
000710 |     pub(crate) fn recover_checked(
000711 |         &self,
000712 |         lock: &LifecycleLock,
000713 |         stopped: &dyn Fn() -> io::Result<()>,
000714 |     ) -> io::Result<()> {
000715 |         self.check_lock(lock)?;
000716 |         stopped()?;
000717 |         let mut journal: Journal = match storage::read_json(&self.journal_path()) {
000718 |             Ok(value) => value,
000719 |             Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {
000720 |                 if let Some(state) = self.state()? {
000721 |                     if identity(&self.active)? != state.directory {
000722 |                         return Err(invalid("active state identity conflict"));
000723 |                     }
000724 |                     self.mirror(state.account)?;
000725 |                 }
000726 |                 return Ok(());
000727 |             }
000728 |             Err(error) => return Err(error),
000729 |         };
000730 |         self.validate_journal(&journal)?;
000731 |         let tx = self.transactions().join(&journal.transaction);
000732 |         let incoming = tx.join("incoming");
000733 |         let current = identity(&self.active)?;
000734 |         if current == journal.original {
000735 |             if self.state()?.as_ref() != Some(&journal.before)
000736 |                 || identity(&tx)? != journal.transaction_directory
000737 |                 || optional_identity(&incoming)? != Some(journal.staged)
000738 |             {
000739 |                 return Err(invalid("pre-swap recovery identity conflict"));
000740 |             }
000741 |             self.validate_pre_swap(&journal, &incoming)?;
000742 |             self.remove_staging(&journal, Some(journal.staged))?;
000743 |             self.mirror(journal.before.account)?;
000744 |             return self.clear_journal();
000745 |         }
000746 |         if current != journal.staged {
000747 |             return Err(invalid(
000748 |                 "recovery requires manual directory identity inspection",
000749 |             ));
000750 |         }
000751 |         self.finish(&mut journal, stopped, &mut |_| Ok(()))
000752 |     }
000753 |     fn validate_journal(&self, journal: &Journal) -> io::Result<()> {
000754 |         if journal.schema != 1
000755 |             || journal.before.schema != 1
000756 |             || journal.before.generation == 0
000757 |             || journal.before.account == journal.target
000758 |             || journal.before.directory != journal.original
000759 |             || journal.original == journal.staged
000760 |             || journal.transaction.len() > 80
000761 |             || !journal.transaction.starts_with("tx-")
000762 |             || !journal
000763 |                 .transaction
000764 |                 .bytes()
000765 |                 .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || byte == b'-')
000766 |             || !valid_hash(&journal.original_hash)
000767 |             || !valid_hash(&journal.target_hash)
000768 |             || journal
000769 |                 .staged_hash
000770 |                 .as_ref()
000771 |                 .is_some_and(|hash| !valid_hash(hash))
000772 |         {
000773 |             return Err(invalid(
000774 |                 "invalid account journal; preserve directories for manual recovery",
000775 |             ));
000776 |         }
000777 |         Ok(())
000778 |     }
000779 |     fn validate_pre_swap(&self, journal: &Journal, incoming: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {
000780 |         if identity(&self.active)? != journal.original
000781 |             || identity(incoming)? != journal.staged
000782 |             || identity(&self.archive(journal.target))? != journal.target_archive
000783 |             || optional_identity(&self.archive(journal.before.account))? != journal.old_archive
000784 |             || self.fingerprint(&self.active)?.0 != journal.original_hash
000785 |             || self.fingerprint(incoming)?.0 != journal.incoming_hash()
000786 |             || self.fingerprint(&self.archive(journal.target))?.0 != journal.target_hash
000787 |         {
000788 |             return Err(invalid("prepared account data changed"));
000789 |         }
000790 |         Ok(())
000791 |     }
000792 |     fn expected_state(&self, journal: &Journal) -> io::Result<ActiveState> {
000793 |         Ok(ActiveState {
000794 |             schema: 1,
000795 |             account: journal.target,
000796 |             generation: journal
000797 |                 .before
000798 |                 .generation
000799 |                 .checked_add(1)
000800 |                 .ok_or_else(|| invalid("generation overflow"))?,
000801 |             directory: journal.staged,
000802 |             transaction: Some(journal.transaction.clone()),
000803 |         })
000804 |     }
000805 |     fn finish(
000806 |         &self,
000807 |         journal: &mut Journal,
000808 |         stopped: &dyn Fn() -> io::Result<()>,
000809 |         hook: &mut dyn FnMut(&str) -> io::Result<()>,
000810 |     ) -> io::Result<()> {
000811 |         self.validate_journal(journal)?;
000812 |         let tx = self.transactions().join(&journal.transaction);
000813 |         let incoming = tx.join("incoming");
000814 |         let archive = self.archive(journal.before.account);
000815 |         let expected = self.expected_state(journal)?;
000816 |         let state = self
000817 |             .state()?
000818 |             .ok_or_else(|| invalid("missing committed pre-switch state"))?;
000819 |         if state != journal.before && state != expected {
000820 |             return Err(invalid("journal conflicts with committed state"));
000821 |         }
000822 |         if identity(&self.active)? != journal.staged
000823 |             || self.fingerprint(&self.active)?.0 != journal.incoming_hash()
000824 |             || identity(&self.archive(journal.target))? != journal.target_archive
000825 |             || self.fingerprint(&self.archive(journal.target))?.0 != journal.target_hash
000826 |         {
000827 |             return Err(invalid("target directory changed during recovery"));
000828 |         }
000829 |         let archive_identity = optional_identity(&archive)?;
000830 |         if archive_identity != Some(journal.original) {
000831 |             if state != journal.before
000832 |                 || identity(&tx)? != journal.transaction_directory
000833 |                 || optional_identity(&incoming)? != Some(journal.original)
000834 |                 || archive_identity != journal.old_archive
000835 |                 || self.fingerprint(&incoming)?.0 != journal.original_hash
000836 |             {
000837 |                 return Err(invalid("outgoing archive identity conflict"));
000838 |             }
000839 |             journal.phase = Phase::ArchiveIntent;
000840 |             self.write_journal(journal)?;
000841 |             hook("archive_intent")?;
000842 |             stopped()?;
000843 |             if journal.old_archive.is_some() {
000844 |                 exchange(&incoming, &archive)?;
000845 |             } else {
000846 |                 fs::rename(&incoming, &archive)?;
000847 |             }
000848 |             storage::sync_directory(&tx)?;
000849 |             storage::sync_directory(&self.archives())?;
000850 |             hook("after_archive")?;
000851 |         }
000852 |         if self.fingerprint(&archive)?.0 != journal.original_hash {
000853 |             return Err(invalid("outgoing archive content conflict"));
000854 |         }
000855 |         journal.phase = Phase::Archived;
000856 |         self.write_journal(journal)?;
000857 |         hook("archived")?;
000858 |         stopped()?;
000859 |         storage::atomic_json(&self.state_path(), &expected)?;
000860 |         journal.phase = Phase::StateCommitted;
000861 |         self.write_journal(journal)?;
000862 |         hook("state_committed")?;
000863 |         self.mirror(journal.target)?;
000864 |         journal.phase = Phase::Mirrored;
000865 |         self.write_journal(journal)?;
000866 |         hook("mirrored")?;
000867 |         journal.phase = Phase::Completed;
000868 |         self.write_journal(journal)?;
000869 |         hook("completed")?;
000870 |         if tx.try_exists()? {
000871 |             self.remove_staging(journal, journal.old_archive)?;
000872 |         }
000873 |         hook("cleaned")?;
000874 |         self.clear_journal()
000875 |     }
000876 |     fn write_journal(&self, journal: &Journal) -> io::Result<()> {
000877 |         storage::atomic_json(&self.journal_path(), journal)
000878 |     }
000879 |     fn clear_journal(&self) -> io::Result<()> {
000880 |         fs::remove_file(self.journal_path())?;
000881 |         storage::sync_directory(&self.v2())
000882 |     }
000883 |     fn remove_staging(&self, journal: &Journal, expected: Option<Identity>) -> io::Result<()> {
000884 |         let tx = self.transactions().join(&journal.transaction);
000885 |         let incoming = tx.join("incoming");
000886 |         if identity(&tx)? != journal.transaction_directory
000887 |             || optional_identity(&incoming)? != expected
000888 |         {
000889 |             return Err(invalid("staging cleanup identity conflict"));
000890 |         }
000891 |         // A complete scan rejects links and foreign-owned data before recursive removal.
000892 |         self.fingerprint(&tx)?;
000893 |         let entries = fs::read_dir(&tx)?.collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
000894 |         if entries.iter().any(|entry| entry.file_name() != "incoming") {
000895 |             return Err(invalid("unexpected staging entry"));
000896 |         }
000897 |         if expected.is_some() {
000898 |             fs::remove_dir_all(&incoming)?;
000899 |         }
000900 |         fs::remove_dir(&tx)?;
000901 |         storage::sync_directory(&self.transactions())
000902 |     }
000903 |     fn new_transaction(&self) -> io::Result<PathBuf> {
000904 |         let nanos = std::time::SystemTime::now()
000905 |             .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
000906 |             .map_err(io::Error::other)?
000907 |             .as_nanos();
000908 |         let path = self.transactions().join(format!(
000909 |             "tx-{nanos}-{}-{}",
000910 |             std::process::id(),
000911 |             NEXT_TRANSACTION.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed)
000912 |         ));
000913 |         if path.try_exists()? {
000914 |             return Err(invalid("transaction name collision"));
000915 |         }
000916 |         storage::create_private_directory(&path)?;
000917 |         Ok(path)
000918 |     }
000919 |     #[cfg(test)]

000921 |         storage::sync_directory(self.active.parent().unwrap())?;
000922 |         storage::sync_directory(incoming.parent().unwrap())
000923 |     }
000924 |     pub(crate) fn copy_verified(&self, from: &Path, to: &Path) -> io::Result<String> {
000925 |         let source_identity = identity(from)?;
000926 |         let source_metadata = copy_metadata(from)?;
000927 |         let (hash, bytes) = self.fingerprint(from)?;
000928 |         ensure_space(
000929 |             to.parent().unwrap(),
000930 |             bytes
000931 |                 .checked_add(1024 * 1024)
000932 |                 .ok_or_else(|| invalid("account size overflow"))?,
000933 |         )?;
000934 |         if to.try_exists()? {
000935 |             return Err(invalid("copy destination already exists"));
000936 |         }
000937 |         let output = Command::new("/usr/bin/ditto")
000938 |             .args(["--rsrc", "--extattr", "--acl"])
000939 |             .arg(from)
000940 |             .arg(to)
000941 |             .env_clear()
000942 |             .env("LC_ALL", "C")
000943 |             .output()?;
000944 |         if !output.status.success() {
000945 |             return Err(io::Error::other(
000946 |                 "account copy failed; staged data retained",
000947 |             ));
000948 |         }
000949 |         #[cfg(test)]
000950 |         simulate_copy_provenance(from, to)?;
000951 |         let target_identity = identity(to)?;
000952 |         if source_identity == target_identity {
000953 |             return Err(invalid("copy destination reuses the source identity"));
000954 |         }
000955 |         // Bind the actual destination before proving its relation to the source.
000956 |         let target_fingerprint = self.fingerprint(to)?;
000957 |         let target_metadata = copy_metadata(to)?;
000958 |         verify_copy_tree(from, to)?;
000959 |         #[cfg(test)]
000960 |         COPY_AFTER_PROOF.with(|hook| hook.take().map_or(Ok(()), |hook| hook(to)))?;
000961 |         if self.fingerprint(to)? != target_fingerprint
000962 |             || copy_metadata(to)? != target_metadata
000963 |             || self.fingerprint(from)?.0 != hash
000964 |             || copy_metadata(from)? != source_metadata
000965 |             || identity(from)? != source_identity
000966 |             || identity(to)? != target_identity
000967 |         {
000968 |             return Err(invalid("copy source or destination changed during proof"));
000969 |         }
000970 |         sync_tree(to)?;
000971 |         storage::sync_directory(to.parent().unwrap())?;
000972 |         Ok(target_fingerprint.0)
000973 |     }
000974 |     pub(crate) fn fingerprint(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<(String, u64)> {
000975 |         self.check_directory(path)?;
000976 |         let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
000977 |         let mut bytes = 0u64;
000978 |         self.scan(path, path, &mut hasher, &mut bytes, 0)?;
000979 |         Ok((
000980 |             hasher
000981 |                 .finalize()
000982 |                 .iter()
000983 |                 .map(|byte| format!("{byte:02x}"))
000984 |                 .collect::<String>(),
000985 |             bytes,
000986 |         ))
000987 |     }
000988 |     fn scan(
000989 |         &self,
000990 |         root: &Path,
000991 |         path: &Path,
000992 |         hasher: &mut Sha256,
000993 |         bytes: &mut u64,
000994 |         migration_source: u32,
000995 |     ) -> io::Result<()> {
000996 |         let relative_path = path.strip_prefix(root).map_err(io::Error::other)?;
000997 |         if migration_source != 0
000998 |             && (relative_path == Path::new("v2/migration")
000999 |                 || relative_path == Path::new("v2/lifecycle.lock"))
001000 |         {
001001 |             return Ok(());
001002 |         }
001003 |         let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path)?;
001004 |         if metadata.file_type().is_symlink()
001005 |             || (!metadata.is_dir() && !metadata.is_file())
001006 |             || metadata.uid() != self.owner
001007 |             || metadata.mode() & 0o022 != 0
001008 |             || metadata.dev() != identity(&self.root)?.device
001009 |             || (metadata.is_file() && metadata.nlink() != 1)
001010 |         {
001011 |             return Err(denied("unsafe account tree entry"));
001012 |         }
001013 |         if migration_source != 0 && relative_path == Path::new("v2/guardian-snapshot.lock") {
001014 |             access_control(path)?;
001015 |             if !metadata.is_file() || metadata.mode() & 0o077 != 0 || metadata.len() != 0 {
001016 |                 return Err(denied("unsafe Guardian snapshot lock"));
001017 |             }
001018 |             return Ok(());
001019 |         }
001020 |         let relative = path
001021 |             .strip_prefix(root)
001022 |             .map_err(io::Error::other)?
001023 |             .as_os_str()
001024 |             .as_bytes();
001025 |         hasher.update((relative.len() as u64).to_le_bytes());
001026 |         hasher.update(relative);
001027 |         hasher.update([u8::from(metadata.is_dir())]);
001028 |         hasher.update((metadata.mode() & 0o7777).to_le_bytes());
001029 |         hasher.update(metadata.uid().to_le_bytes());
001030 |         let acl = access_control(path)?;
001031 |         hasher.update((acl.len() as u64).to_le_bytes());
001032 |         *bytes = bytes
001033 |             .checked_add(acl.len() as u64)
001034 |             .and_then(|value| value.checked_add(4096))
001035 |             .ok_or_else(|| invalid("account metadata size overflow"))?;
001036 |         hasher.update(acl);
001037 |         let attrs = extended_attributes(path)?;
001038 |         let encoded =
001039 |             serde_json::to_vec(&attrs.into_iter().collect::<Vec<_>>()).map_err(io::Error::other)?;
001040 |         hasher.update((encoded.len() as u64).to_le_bytes());
001041 |         *bytes = bytes
001042 |             .checked_add(encoded.len() as u64)
001043 |             .ok_or_else(|| invalid("account attribute size overflow"))?;
001044 |         hasher.update(encoded);
001045 |         // Only the exact live-root health payload is volatile. Metadata, ACL and xattrs bind.
001046 |         if migration_source == 2 && relative_path == Path::new("v2/guardian-health.json") {
001047 |             if !metadata.is_file() || metadata.mode() & 0o077 != 0 {
001048 |                 return Err(denied("unsafe Guardian health"));
001049 |             }
001050 |             let file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
001051 |                 .read(true)
001052 |                 .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW | libc::O_NONBLOCK | libc::O_CLOEXEC)
001053 |                 .open(path)?;
001054 |             let opened = file.metadata()?;
001055 |             if opened.ino() != metadata.ino()
001056 |                 || opened.dev() != metadata.dev()
001057 |                 || opened.mode() != metadata.mode()
001058 |                 || opened.uid() != metadata.uid()
001059 |                 || opened.nlink() != 1
001060 |             {
001061 |                 return Err(invalid("Guardian health changed during scan"));
001062 |             }
001063 |             return Ok(());
001064 |         }
001065 |         if metadata.is_dir() {
001066 |             let mut children = fs::read_dir(path)?.collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
001067 |             children.sort_by_key(|entry| entry.file_name());
001068 |             for entry in children {
001069 |                 self.scan(root, &entry.path(), hasher, bytes, migration_source)?;
001070 |             }
001071 |         } else {
001072 |             *bytes = bytes
001073 |                 .checked_add(metadata.len())
001074 |                 .ok_or_else(|| invalid("account size overflow"))?;
001075 |             let mut file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
001076 |                 .read(true)
001077 |                 .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW | libc::O_CLOEXEC)
001078 |                 .open(path)?;
001079 |             let opened = file.metadata()?;
001080 |             if opened.ino() != metadata.ino() || opened.dev() != metadata.dev() {
001081 |                 return Err(invalid("account file changed during scan"));
001082 |             }
001083 |             hasher.update(metadata.len().to_le_bytes());
001084 |             let mut buffer = [0u8; 65536];
001085 |             loop {
001086 |                 let count = file.read(&mut buffer)?;
001087 |                 if count == 0 {
001088 |                     break;
001089 |                 }
001090 |                 hasher.update(&buffer[..count]);
001091 |             }
001092 |         }
001093 |         Ok(())
001094 |     }
001095 | }

001098 | /// Ask Claude to quit and wait up to 15 seconds before any account directory write.
001099 | pub fn quit_claude(owner: u32) -> io::Result<()> {
001100 |     quit_claude_with(
001101 |         &|| ensure_claude_stopped(owner),
001102 |         &|| {
001103 |             let mut child = Command::new("/usr/bin/osascript")
001104 |                 .args(["-e", "tell application \"Claude\" to quit"])
001105 |                 .stdin(std::process::Stdio::null())
001106 |                 .stdout(std::process::Stdio::null())
001107 |                 .stderr(std::process::Stdio::null())
001108 |                 .spawn()?;
001109 |             // AppleScript may wait for an unresponsive application. Bound that request too.
001110 |             let deadline = std::time::Instant::now() + std::time::Duration::from_secs(15);
001111 |             while child.try_wait()?.is_none() {
001112 |                 if std::time::Instant::now() >= deadline {
001113 |                     let _ = child.kill();
001114 |                     let _ = child.wait();
001115 |                     break;
001116 |                 }
001117 |                 std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(50));
001118 |             }
001119 |             Ok(())
001120 |         },
001121 |         &|| std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(1)),
001122 |     )
001123 | }
001124 | fn quit_claude_with(
001125 |     stopped: &dyn Fn() -> io::Result<()>,
001126 |     request: &dyn Fn() -> io::Result<()>,
001127 |     wait: &dyn Fn(),
001128 | ) -> io::Result<()> {
001129 |     match stopped() {
001130 |         Ok(()) => return Ok(()),
001131 |         Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => {}
001132 |         Err(error) => return Err(error),
001133 |     }
001134 |     let deadline = std::time::Instant::now() + std::time::Duration::from_secs(15);
001135 |     request()?;
001136 |     for _ in 0..15 {
001137 |         match stopped() {
001138 |             Ok(()) => return Ok(()),
001139 |             Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => {}
001140 |             Err(error) => return Err(error),
001141 |         }
001142 |         if std::time::Instant::now() >= deadline {
001143 |             break;
001144 |         }
001145 |         wait();
001146 |     }
001147 |     stopped()
001148 | }

001150 | /// Fail closed on process-enumeration failure. No credentials or process arguments are read.
001151 | pub fn ensure_claude_stopped(owner: u32) -> io::Result<()> {
001152 |     let output = Command::new("/bin/ps")
001153 |         .args(["-ww", "-axo", "uid=,comm="])
001154 |         .env_clear()
001155 |         .env("LC_ALL", "C")
001156 |         .output()?;
001157 |     if !output.status.success() {
001158 |         return Err(io::Error::other("cannot inspect Claude processes"));
001159 |     }
001160 |     ensure_claude_stopped_listing(owner, &output.stdout)
001161 | }

001163 | // Share the production parser with isolated tests; tests never create or run an app bundle.
001164 | fn ensure_claude_stopped_listing(owner: u32, listing: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {
001165 |     let listing = std::str::from_utf8(listing).map_err(|_| invalid("invalid process metadata"))?;
001166 |     for line in listing.lines() {

001169 |             .find(char::is_whitespace)
001170 |             .ok_or_else(|| invalid("invalid process record"))?;
001171 |         let uid: u32 = line[..split]
001172 |             .parse()
001173 |             .map_err(|_| invalid("invalid process owner"))?;
001174 |         let command = line[split..].trim_start();
001175 |         if uid == owner && (command.contains("/Claude.app/Contents/") || command == "Claude") {
001176 |             return Err(io::Error::new(
001177 |                 io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock,
001178 |                 "Claude must be completely stopped before account changes",
001179 |             ));
001180 |         }
001181 |     }
001182 |     Ok(())

001188 | fn exchange(left: &Path, right: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {
001189 |     let left = path_cstring(left)?;
001190 |     let right = path_cstring(right)?;
001191 |     // Both paths were checked for ownership, symlinks and a shared device. The kernel exchanges entries atomically.
001192 |     let result = unsafe { libc::renamex_np(left.as_ptr(), right.as_ptr(), libc::RENAME_SWAP) };
001193 |     if result == 0 {
001194 |         Ok(())
001195 |     } else {
001196 |         Err(io::Error::last_os_error())

001206 | fn ensure_space(directory: &Path, required: u64) -> io::Result<()> {
001207 |     let path = path_cstring(directory)?;
001208 |     let mut statistics = std::mem::MaybeUninit::<libc::statvfs>::uninit();
001209 |     if unsafe { libc::statvfs(path.as_ptr(), statistics.as_mut_ptr()) } != 0 {
001210 |         return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());
001211 |     }
001212 |     let statistics = unsafe { statistics.assume_init() };
001213 |     let available = (statistics.f_bavail as u64)
001214 |         .checked_mul(statistics.f_frsize)
001215 |         .ok_or_else(|| invalid("free space overflow"))?;
001216 |     if available < required {
001217 |         return Err(io::Error::new(
001218 |             io::ErrorKind::StorageFull,
001219 |             "insufficient space for staged account copy",
001220 |         ));
001221 |     }
001222 |     Ok(())
001223 | }
001224 | // The ordinary account digest is unchanged; copy proof also binds metadata and identities.
001225 | #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
001226 | struct CopyMetadata {
001227 |     relative: PathBuf,
001228 |     device: u64,
001229 |     inode: u64,
001230 |     gid: u32,
001231 |     links: u64,
001232 |     mtime: i64,
001233 |     mtime_nsec: i64,
001234 | }
001235 | fn copy_metadata(path: &Path) -> io::Result<Vec<CopyMetadata>> {
001236 |     fn walk(root: &Path, path: &Path, output: &mut Vec<CopyMetadata>) -> io::Result<()> {
001237 |         let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path)?;
001238 |         if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
001239 |             return Err(invalid("copy source symlink"));
001240 |         }
001241 |         output.push(CopyMetadata {
001242 |             relative: path.strip_prefix(root).unwrap().to_owned(),
001243 |             device: metadata.dev(),
001244 |             inode: metadata.ino(),
001245 |             gid: metadata.gid(),
001246 |             links: metadata.nlink(),
001247 |             mtime: metadata.mtime(),
001248 |             mtime_nsec: metadata.mtime_nsec(),
001249 |         });
001250 |         if metadata.is_dir() {
001251 |             let mut children = fs::read_dir(path)?
001252 |                 .map(|entry| entry.map(|entry| entry.path()))
001253 |                 .collect::<io::Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
001254 |             children.sort();
001255 |             for child in children {
001256 |                 walk(root, &child, output)?;
001257 |             }
001258 |         }
001259 |         Ok(())
001260 |     }
001261 |     let mut output = Vec::new();
001262 |     walk(path, path, &mut output)?;
001263 |     Ok(output)
001264 | }

001266 | /// A one-time proof for a freshly created, distinct-inode copy. Never use as a durable binding.
001267 | fn verify_copy_tree(from: &Path, to: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {
001268 |     let left = fs::symlink_metadata(from)?;
001269 |     let right = fs::symlink_metadata(to)?;
001270 |     if left.file_type().is_symlink()
001271 |         || right.file_type().is_symlink()
001272 |         || (!left.is_dir() && !left.is_file())
001273 |         || left.is_dir() != right.is_dir()
001274 |         || left.dev() != right.dev()
001275 |         || left.ino() == right.ino()
001276 |         || left.mode() != right.mode()
001277 |         || left.uid() != right.uid()
001278 |         || left.gid() != right.gid()
001279 |         || left.mtime() != right.mtime()
001280 |         || left.mtime_nsec() != right.mtime_nsec()
001281 |         || (left.is_file()
001282 |             && (left.nlink() != 1 || right.nlink() != 1 || left.len() != right.len()))
001283 |         || access_control(from)? != access_control(to)?
001284 |     {
001285 |         return Err(invalid("account copy metadata differs"));
001286 |     }
001287 |     let source_attrs = extended_attributes(from)?;
001288 |     let mut target_attrs = extended_attributes(to)?;
001289 |     if !source_attrs.contains_key(b"com.apple.provenance".as_slice()) {
001290 |         target_attrs.remove(b"com.apple.provenance".as_slice());
001291 |     }
001292 |     if source_attrs != target_attrs {
001293 |         return Err(invalid("account copy attributes differ"));
001294 |     }
001295 |     if left.is_dir() {
001296 |         let mut sources = fs::read_dir(from)?.collect::<io::Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
001297 |         let mut targets = fs::read_dir(to)?.collect::<io::Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
001298 |         sources.sort_by_key(|entry| entry.file_name());
001299 |         targets.sort_by_key(|entry| entry.file_name());
001300 |         if sources.len() != targets.len() {
001301 |             return Err(invalid("account copy paths differ"));
001302 |         }
001303 |         for (source, target) in sources.into_iter().zip(targets) {
001304 |             if source.file_name() != target.file_name() {
001305 |                 return Err(invalid("account copy paths differ"));
001306 |             }
001307 |             verify_copy_tree(&source.path(), &target.path())?;
001308 |         }
001309 |     } else {
001310 |         let open = |path: &Path, metadata: &fs::Metadata| -> io::Result<File> {
001311 |             let file = fs::OpenOptions::new()
001312 |                 .read(true)
001313 |                 .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW | libc::O_CLOEXEC)
001314 |                 .open(path)?;
001315 |             let opened = file.metadata()?;
001316 |             if opened.dev() != metadata.dev() || opened.ino() != metadata.ino() {
001317 |                 return Err(invalid("account copy file replaced during proof"));
001318 |             }
001319 |             Ok(file)
001320 |         };
001321 |         let mut source = open(from, &left)?;
001322 |         let mut target = open(to, &right)?;
001323 |         let mut a = [0; 65536];
001324 |         let mut b = [0; 65536];
001325 |         loop {
001326 |             let count = source.read(&mut a)?;
001327 |             if count == 0 {
001328 |                 if target.read(&mut b[..1])? != 0 {
001329 |                     return Err(invalid("account copy content differs"));
001330 |                 }
001331 |                 break;
001332 |             }
001333 |             target.read_exact(&mut b[..count])?;
001334 |             if a[..count] != b[..count] {
001335 |                 return Err(invalid("account copy content differs"));
001336 |             }
001337 |         }
001338 |     }
001339 |     Ok(())
001340 | }
001341 | fn sync_tree(path: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {
001342 |     let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path)?;
001343 |     if metadata.is_dir() {
001344 |         for entry in fs::read_dir(path)? {
001345 |             sync_tree(&entry?.path())?;
001346 |         }
001347 |         storage::sync_directory(path)
001348 |     } else {
001349 |         File::open(path)?.sync_all()
001350 |     }
001351 | }
001352 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
001353 | pub(crate) fn extended_attributes(path: &Path) -> io::Result<BTreeMap<Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>>> {
001354 |     const LIMIT: usize = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
001355 |     let path = path_cstring(path)?;
001356 |     let count =
001357 |         unsafe { libc::listxattr(path.as_ptr(), std::ptr::null_mut(), 0, libc::XATTR_NOFOLLOW) };
001358 |     if count < 0 {
001359 |         return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());
001360 |     }
001361 |     if count as usize > LIMIT {
001362 |         return Err(invalid("extended attributes too large"));
001363 |     }
001364 |     let mut names = vec![0u8; count as usize];
001365 |     let actual = unsafe {
001366 |         libc::listxattr(
001367 |             path.as_ptr(),
001368 |             names.as_mut_ptr().cast(),
001369 |             names.len(),
001370 |             libc::XATTR_NOFOLLOW,
001371 |         )
001372 |     };
001373 |     if actual < 0 || actual as usize != names.len() {
001374 |         return Err(invalid("extended attributes changed during scan"));
001375 |     }
001376 |     let mut attrs = BTreeMap::new();
001377 |     let mut attribute_bytes = names.len();
001378 |     for name in names
001379 |         .split(|byte| *byte == 0)
001380 |         .filter(|name| !name.is_empty())
001381 |     {
001382 |         let c_name = CString::new(name).map_err(io::Error::other)?;
001383 |         let count = unsafe {
001384 |             libc::getxattr(
001385 |                 path.as_ptr(),
001386 |                 c_name.as_ptr(),
001387 |                 std::ptr::null_mut(),
001388 |                 0,
001389 |                 0,
001390 |                 libc::XATTR_NOFOLLOW,
001391 |             )
001392 |         };
001393 |         if count < 0 {
001394 |             return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());
001395 |         }
001396 |         attribute_bytes = attribute_bytes
001397 |             .checked_add(count as usize)
001398 |             .ok_or_else(|| invalid("extended attributes size overflow"))?;
001399 |         if attribute_bytes > LIMIT {
001400 |             return Err(invalid("extended attributes too large"));
001401 |         }
001402 |         let mut value = vec![0u8; count as usize];
001403 |         let actual = unsafe {
001404 |             libc::getxattr(
001405 |                 path.as_ptr(),
001406 |                 c_name.as_ptr(),
001407 |                 value.as_mut_ptr().cast(),
001408 |                 value.len(),
001409 |                 0,
001410 |                 libc::XATTR_NOFOLLOW,
001411 |             )
001412 |         };
001413 |         if actual < 0 || actual as usize != value.len() {
001414 |             return Err(invalid("extended attribute changed during scan"));
001415 |         }
001416 |         attrs.insert(name.to_vec(), value);
001417 |     }
001418 |     #[cfg(test)]
001419 |     COPY_PROVENANCE.with(|value| {
001420 |         if let Some(map) = value.borrow().as_ref() {
001421 |             attrs.remove(b"com.apple.provenance".as_slice());
001422 |             let path = Path::new(std::ffi::OsStr::from_bytes(path.as_bytes()));
001423 |             let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path).unwrap();
001424 |             if let Some(attribute) = map.get(&(metadata.dev(), metadata.ino())) {
001425 |                 attrs.insert(b"com.apple.provenance".to_vec(), attribute.clone());
001426 |             }
001427 |         }
001428 |     });
001429 |     Ok(attrs)
001430 | }
001431 | #[cfg(not(target_os = "macos"))]
001432 | pub(crate) fn extended_attributes(_: &Path) -> io::Result<BTreeMap<Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>>> {
001433 |     Err(io::Error::new(
001434 |         io::ErrorKind::Unsupported,
001435 |         "account metadata copying requires macOS",
001436 |     ))
001437 | }

001439 | /// Narrow Darwin ACL FFI. Read-only and deny ACLs are preserved; write-grant ACLs require manual review.
001440 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
001441 | pub(crate) fn access_control(path: &Path) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
001442 |     use std::ffi::c_void;
001443 |     unsafe extern "C" {
001444 |         fn acl_get_link_np(path: *const libc::c_char, kind: libc::c_int) -> *mut c_void;
001445 |         fn acl_free(value: *mut c_void) -> libc::c_int;
001446 |         fn acl_valid(acl: *mut c_void) -> libc::c_int;
001447 |         fn acl_get_entry(
001448 |             acl: *mut c_void,
001449 |             index: libc::c_int,
001450 |             entry: *mut *mut c_void,
001451 |         ) -> libc::c_int;
001452 |         fn acl_get_tag_type(entry: *mut c_void, tag: *mut libc::c_int) -> libc::c_int;
001453 |         fn acl_get_permset_mask_np(entry: *mut c_void, mask: *mut u64) -> libc::c_int;
001454 |         fn acl_to_text(acl: *mut c_void, length: *mut libc::ssize_t) -> *mut libc::c_char;
001455 |     }
001456 |     struct Allocation(*mut c_void);
001457 |     impl Drop for Allocation {
001458 |         fn drop(&mut self) {
001459 |             if !self.0.is_null() {
001460 |                 unsafe {
001461 |                     acl_free(self.0);
001462 |                 }
001463 |             }
001464 |         }
001465 |     }
001466 |     let c_path = path_cstring(path)?;
001467 |     let acl = Allocation(unsafe { acl_get_link_np(c_path.as_ptr(), 0x100) }); // ACL_TYPE_EXTENDED, sys/acl.h.
001468 |     if acl.0.is_null() {
001469 |         let error = io::Error::last_os_error();
001470 |         // Darwin reports ENOENT for an existing object without an extended ACL.
001471 |         if error.raw_os_error() == Some(libc::ENOENT) {
001472 |             let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path)?;
001473 |             if !metadata.file_type().is_symlink() && (metadata.is_file() || metadata.is_dir()) {
001474 |                 return Ok(Vec::new());
001475 |             }
001476 |         }
001477 |         return Err(error);
001478 |     }
001479 |     if unsafe { acl_valid(acl.0) } != 0 {
001480 |         return Err(invalid("invalid account ACL"));
001481 |     }
001482 |     let mut index = 0; // ACL_FIRST_ENTRY. Darwin returns EINVAL at the end of a valid ACL.
001483 |     loop {
001484 |         let mut entry = std::ptr::null_mut();
001485 |         if unsafe { acl_get_entry(acl.0, index, &mut entry) } != 0 {
001486 |             let error = io::Error::last_os_error();
001487 |             if error.raw_os_error() == Some(libc::EINVAL) {
001488 |                 break;
001489 |             }
001490 |             return Err(error);
001491 |         }
001492 |         index = -1; // ACL_NEXT_ENTRY.
001493 |         let mut tag = 0;
001494 |         let mut mask = 0u64;
001495 |         if unsafe { acl_get_tag_type(entry, &mut tag) } != 0
001496 |             || unsafe { acl_get_permset_mask_np(entry, &mut mask) } != 0
001497 |         {
001498 |             return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());
001499 |         }
001500 |         const MUTATING: u64 = (1 << 2)
001501 |             | (1 << 4)
001502 |             | (1 << 5)
001503 |             | (1 << 6)
001504 |             | (1 << 8)
001505 |             | (1 << 10)
001506 |             | (1 << 12)
001507 |             | (1 << 13);
001508 |         if tag != 1 && tag != 2 {
001509 |             return Err(invalid("unsupported account ACL entry"));
001510 |         }
001511 |         if tag == 1 && mask & MUTATING != 0 {
001512 |             return Err(denied(
001513 |                 "account ACL grants mutation; manual permission review required",
001514 |             ));
001515 |         }
001516 |     }
001517 |     let mut length = 0;
001518 |     let text = Allocation(unsafe { acl_to_text(acl.0, &mut length) }.cast());
001519 |     if text.0.is_null() {
001520 |         return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());
001521 |     }
001522 |     if !(0..=65536).contains(&length) {
001523 |         return Err(invalid("account ACL text too large"));
001524 |     }
001525 |     Ok(unsafe { std::slice::from_raw_parts(text.0.cast::<u8>(), length as usize) }.to_vec())
001526 | }
001527 | #[cfg(not(target_os = "macos"))]
001528 | pub(crate) fn access_control(_: &Path) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
001529 |     Err(io::Error::new(
001530 |         io::ErrorKind::Unsupported,
001531 |         "account ACL validation requires macOS",
001532 |     ))
001533 | }

001587 |     #[test]

001852 |     fn killed_process_recovers_every_durable_and_physical_checkpoint() {
001853 |         use std::os::unix::process::ExitStatusExt;
001854 |         struct ChildGuard(std::process::Child);
001855 |         impl Drop for ChildGuard {
001856 |             fn drop(&mut self) {
001857 |                 let _ = self.0.kill();
001858 |                 let _ = self.0.wait();
001859 |             }
001860 |         }
001861 |         for point in PROCESS_CRASH_POINTS {
001862 |             let fixture = Fixture::new();
001863 |             fixture.initialize();
001864 |             fixture.add_b();
001865 |             storage::atomic_write(&fixture.store.active.join("session"), b"A-latest").unwrap();
001866 |             for (directory, value) in [
001867 |                 (fixture.store.active.clone(), b"A-attribute".as_slice()),
001868 |                 (
001869 |                     fixture.store.archive(AccountId::B),
001870 |                     b"B-attribute".as_slice(),
001871 |                 ),
001872 |             ] {
001873 |                 fs::set_permissions(&directory, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o750)).unwrap();
001874 |                 let session = directory.join("session");
001875 |                 fs::set_permissions(&session, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o640)).unwrap();
001876 |                 let file = path_cstring(&session).unwrap();
001877 |                 let name = CString::new("com.claude-switcher.crash-test").unwrap();
001878 |                 assert_eq!(
001879 |                     unsafe {
001880 |                         libc::setxattr(
001881 |                             file.as_ptr(),
001882 |                             name.as_ptr(),
001883 |                             value.as_ptr().cast(),
001884 |                             value.len(),
001885 |                             0,
001886 |                             libc::XATTR_NOFOLLOW,
001887 |                         )
001888 |                     },
001889 |                     0
001890 |                 );
001891 |             }
001892 |             let original = identity(&fixture.store.active).unwrap();
001893 |             let target_archive = identity(&fixture.store.archive(AccountId::B)).unwrap();
001894 |             let a_hash = fixture.store.fingerprint(&fixture.store.active).unwrap().0;
001895 |             let b_hash = fixture
001896 |                 .store
001897 |                 .fingerprint(&fixture.store.archive(AccountId::B))
001898 |                 .unwrap()
001899 |                 .0;
001900 |             let a_attrs = extended_attributes(&fixture.store.active.join("session")).unwrap();
001901 |             let b_attrs =
001902 |                 extended_attributes(&fixture.store.archive(AccountId::B).join("session")).unwrap();
001903 |             let mut child = ChildGuard(
001904 |                 Command::new(std::env::current_exe().unwrap())
001905 |                     .args([
001906 |                         "--exact",
001907 |                         "accounts::tests::account_process_crash_child_fixture",
001908 |                         "--nocapture",
001909 |                     ])
001910 |                     .env("SWITCHER_ACCOUNT_CRASH_BASE", &fixture.base)
001911 |                     .env("SWITCHER_ACCOUNT_CRASH_POINT", point)
001912 |                     .stdin(std::process::Stdio::null())
001913 |                     .stdout(std::process::Stdio::null())
001914 |                     .stderr(std::process::Stdio::null())
001915 |                     .spawn()
001916 |                     .unwrap(),
001917 |             );
001918 |             let ready = fixture.base.join("crash-ready");
001919 |             let deadline = std::time::Instant::now() + std::time::Duration::from_secs(15);
001920 |             while !ready.exists() {
001921 |                 assert!(
001922 |                     child.0.try_wait().unwrap().is_none(),
001923 |                     "child exited before {point}"
001924 |                 );
001925 |                 assert!(
001926 |                     std::time::Instant::now() < deadline,
001927 |                     "child timed out before {point}"
001928 |                 );
001929 |                 std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(10));
001930 |             }
001931 |             assert_eq!(fs::read(&ready).unwrap(), point.as_bytes());
001932 |             let journal: Journal = storage::read_json(&fixture.store.journal_path()).unwrap();
001933 |             assert_eq!(journal.original, original);
001934 |             assert_eq!(
001935 |                 LifecycleLock::try_acquire(&fixture.store.v2())
001936 |                     .unwrap_err()
001937 |                     .kind(),
001938 |                 io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock
001939 |             );
001940 |             child.0.kill().unwrap();
001941 |             let status = child.0.wait().unwrap();
001942 |             assert_eq!(status.signal(), Some(libc::SIGKILL), "{point}");
001943 |             // Reopen after process death: no in-memory account state or lock survives.
001944 |             let store = AccountStore::new(
001945 |                 &fixture.store.root,
001946 |                 &fixture.store.active,
001947 |                 fixture.store.owner,
001948 |             )
001949 |             .unwrap();
001950 |             let expected = if matches!(point, "prepared" | "swap_intent") {
001951 |                 AccountId::A
001952 |             } else {
001953 |                 AccountId::B
001954 |             };
001955 |             for _ in 0..2 {
001956 |                 let lock = LifecycleLock::try_acquire(&store.v2()).unwrap();
001957 |                 store
001958 |                     .recover_checked(&lock, &|| Ok(()))
001959 |                     .unwrap_or_else(|error| panic!("{point}: {error}"));
001960 |                 let state = store.state().unwrap().unwrap();
001961 |                 assert_eq!(state.account, expected, "{point}");
001962 |                 assert_eq!(state.directory, identity(&store.active).unwrap(), "{point}");
001963 |                 assert_eq!(
001964 |                     state.generation,
001965 |                     if expected == AccountId::A { 1 } else { 2 }
001966 |                 );
001967 |                 assert_eq!(
001968 |                     identity(&store.active).unwrap(),
001969 |                     if expected == AccountId::A {
001970 |                         original
001971 |                     } else {
001972 |                         journal.staged
001973 |                     }
001974 |                 );
001975 |                 assert_eq!(
001976 |                     store.fingerprint(&store.active).unwrap().0,
001977 |                     if expected == AccountId::A {
001978 |                         &a_hash
001979 |                     } else {
001980 |                         &b_hash
001981 |                     }
001982 |                     .as_str()
001983 |                 );
001984 |                 assert_eq!(
001985 |                     fs::read(store.active.join("session")).unwrap(),
001986 |                     if expected == AccountId::A {
001987 |                         b"A-latest".as_slice()
001988 |                     } else {
001989 |                         b"B-private".as_slice()

001991 |                 );

001994 |                     if expected == AccountId::A {
001995 |                         a_attrs.clone()
001996 |                     } else {
001997 |                         b_attrs.clone()
001998 |                     }
001999 |                 );
002000 |                 assert_eq!(fs::metadata(&store.active).unwrap().mode() & 0o777, 0o750);

002199 |     fn restore_copy_times(path: &Path, before: &fs::Metadata) -> io::Result<()> {
002200 |         let times = [
002201 |             libc::timespec {
002202 |                 tv_sec: before.atime(),
002203 |                 tv_nsec: before.atime_nsec(),
002204 |             },
002205 |             libc::timespec {
002206 |                 tv_sec: before.mtime(),
002207 |                 tv_nsec: before.mtime_nsec(),
002208 |             },
002209 |         ];
002210 |         if unsafe {
002211 |             libc::utimensat(
002212 |                 libc::AT_FDCWD,
002213 |                 path_cstring(path)?.as_ptr(),
002214 |                 times.as_ptr(),
002215 |                 libc::AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW,
002216 |             )
002217 |         } != 0
002218 |         {
002219 |             return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());
002220 |         }
002221 |         Ok(())
002222 |     }

000092 | impl Drop for PendingStages {
000093 |     fn drop(&mut self) {
000094 |         if self.handed_off {
000095 |             return;
000096 |         }
000097 |         if self.journal_attempted {
000098 |             // atomic_json can fail after rename (parent fsync). Keep recovery data

000101 |                 Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {}
000102 |                 _ => return,
000103 |             }
000104 |         }
000105 |         for path in self.paths.iter().rev() {
000106 |             let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(path);

000119 | fn select_with(
000120 |     store: &AccountStore,
000121 |     target: AccountId,
000122 |     lock: &LifecycleLock,
000123 |     stopped: &dyn Fn() -> io::Result<()>,
000124 |     hook: &mut dyn FnMut(&str) -> io::Result<()>,
000125 | ) -> io::Result<()> {
000126 |     check_lock(store, lock)?;
000127 |     stopped()?;
000128 |     if store.journal_path().try_exists()? {
000129 |         store.recover_checked(lock, stopped)?;
000130 |     }
000131 |     recover(store, lock, stopped)?;
000132 |     let current = store.selected_account()?;
000133 |     let first = !store.root.join("current").exists() && store.state()?.is_none();
000134 |     if target == current && !first && store.archive(current).exists() {
000135 |         store.mirror(current)?;
000136 |         return Ok(());
000137 |     }
000138 |     let transaction = format!(
000139 |         "tx-{}-{}-{}",
000140 |         std::time::SystemTime::now()
000141 |             .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
000142 |             .map_err(io::Error::other)?
000143 |             .as_nanos(),
000144 |         std::process::id(),
000145 |         NEXT_TRANSACTION.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed)
000146 |     );
000147 |     let (active_stage, archive_stage) = stages(store, &transaction);
000148 |     let mut pending = PendingStages {
000149 |         paths: Vec::new(),
000150 |         journal: journal_path(store),
000151 |         journal_attempted: false,
000152 |         handed_off: false,
000153 |     };
000154 |     pending.create(&active_stage)?;
000155 |     pending.create(&archive_stage)?;
000156 |     hook("stages_created")?;
000157 |     let incoming = active_stage.join("incoming");
000158 |     let outgoing = archive_stage.join("outgoing");
000159 |     let original = identity(&store.active)?;
000160 |     let original_hash = fingerprint(&store.active)?;
000161 |     copy(&store.active, &outgoing)?;
000162 |     hook("outgoing_copied")?;
000163 |     // First A adoption and same-account archive repair retain the live directory.
000164 |     let in_place = target == current;
000165 |     if in_place {
000166 |         // The outgoing copy is the archive; no replacement live copy is needed.
000167 |     } else if store.archive(target).exists() {
000168 |         copy(&store.archive(target), &incoming)?;
000169 |     } else {
000170 |         storage::create_private_directory(&incoming)?;
000171 |     }
000172 |     hook("incoming_copied")?;
000173 |     stopped()?;
000174 |     if identity(&store.active)? != original || fingerprint(&store.active)? != original_hash {
000175 |         return Err(invalid("live account changed while copying"));
000176 |     }
000177 |     let before = ActiveState {
000178 |         schema: 1,
000179 |         account: current,
000180 |         generation: store.state()?.map(|state| state.generation).unwrap_or(1),
000181 |         directory: original,
000182 |         transaction: None,
000183 |     };
000184 |     let journal = LegacyJournal {
000185 |         schema: 1,
000186 |         in_place,
000187 |         transaction,
000188 |         before,
000189 |         target,
000190 |         active_stage: identity(&active_stage)?,
000191 |         archive_stage: identity(&archive_stage)?,
000192 |         original,
000193 |         incoming: if in_place {
000194 |             original
000195 |         } else {
000196 |             identity(&incoming)?
000197 |         },
000198 |         outgoing: identity(&outgoing)?,
000199 |         previous_archive: optional_identity(&store.archive(current))?,
000200 |         original_hash,
000201 |         incoming_hash: if in_place {
000202 |             fingerprint(&store.active)?
000203 |         } else {
000204 |             fingerprint(&incoming)?
000205 |         },
000206 |         outgoing_hash: fingerprint(&outgoing)?,
000207 |     };

000209 |     pending.journal_attempted = true;
000210 |     storage::atomic_json(&journal_path(store), &journal)?;
000211 |     // This injection point also models a parent fsync error after journal rename.
000212 |     hook("journal_written")?;
000213 |     pending.handed_off = true;
000214 |     hook("prepared")?;
000215 |     finish(store, &journal, lock, stopped, hook)

000229 | fn finish(
000230 |     store: &AccountStore,
000231 |     journal: &LegacyJournal,
000232 |     lock: &LifecycleLock,
000233 |     stopped: &dyn Fn() -> io::Result<()>,
000234 |     hook: &mut dyn FnMut(&str) -> io::Result<()>,
000235 | ) -> io::Result<()> {
000236 |     check_lock(store, lock)?;
000237 |     validate(store, journal)?;
000238 |     stopped()?;
000239 |     let (active_stage, archive_stage) = stages(store, &journal.transaction);
000240 |     let incoming = active_stage.join("incoming");
000241 |     let outgoing = archive_stage.join("outgoing");
000242 |     let archive = store.archive(journal.before.account);
000243 |     let expected = ActiveState {
000244 |         schema: 1,
000245 |         account: journal.target,
000246 |         generation: journal
000247 |             .before
000248 |             .generation
000249 |             .checked_add(1)
000250 |             .ok_or_else(|| invalid("account generation overflow"))?,

000252 |         transaction: Some(journal.transaction.clone()),

000254 |     // A committed transaction may have already removed one or both staging directories.
000255 |     let committed = store.state()?.as_ref() == Some(&expected);
000256 |     if !journal.in_place && identity(&store.active)? == journal.original {
000257 |         if committed
000258 |             || identity(&incoming)? != journal.incoming
000259 |             || fingerprint(&store.active)? != journal.original_hash
000260 |             || fingerprint(&incoming)? != journal.incoming_hash
000261 |         {
000262 |             return Err(invalid("prepared account data changed"));
000263 |         }
000264 |         exchange(&store.active, &incoming)?;
000265 |         storage::sync_directory(store.active.parent().unwrap())?;
000266 |         storage::sync_directory(&active_stage)?;

000268 |     }

000270 |         || fingerprint(&store.active)? != journal.incoming_hash

000272 |         return Err(invalid("selected account changed during recovery"));
000273 |     }

000276 |             || optional_identity(&archive)? != journal.previous_archive

000278 |             || fingerprint(&outgoing)? != journal.outgoing_hash

000288 |         storage::sync_directory(&archive_stage)?;
000289 |         hook("archived")?;
000290 |     }
000291 |     if fingerprint(&archive)? != journal.outgoing_hash {
000292 |         return Err(invalid("outgoing account content changed"));
000293 |     }

000295 |     storage::atomic_json(&store.state_path(), &expected)?;
000296 |     hook("committed")?;
000297 |     store.mirror(journal.target)?;
000298 |     hook("mirrored")?;
000299 |     // remove_dir_all unlinks symbolic links; it never follows their targets.
000300 |     clean_stage(
000301 |         &active_stage,
000302 |         journal.active_stage,
000303 |         "incoming",

000305 |             None
000306 |         } else {
000307 |             Some(journal.original)

000309 |     )?;
000310 |     hook("active_cleaned")?;
000311 |     clean_stage(
000312 |         &archive_stage,
000313 |         journal.archive_stage,
000314 |         "outgoing",

000321 | fn clean_stage(
000322 |     stage: &Path,
000323 |     expected: Identity,
000324 |     child: &str,
000325 |     child_identity: Option<Identity>,
000326 | ) -> io::Result<()> {
000327 |     let Some(id) = optional_identity(stage)? else {

000347 | fn copy(from: &Path, to: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {
000348 |     fn has_special(path: &Path) -> io::Result<bool> {
000349 |         let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path)?;
000350 |         if metadata.is_dir() {
000351 |             for child in fs::read_dir(path)? {
000352 |                 if has_special(&child?.path())? {
000353 |                     return Ok(true);
000354 |                 }
000355 |             }
000356 |             Ok(false)
000357 |         } else {
000358 |             Ok(!metadata.is_file() && !metadata.file_type().is_symlink())
000359 |         }
000360 |     }
000361 |     // Ditto can wait indefinitely on a FIFO. Let it attempt the copy, then report its timeout.
000362 |     let timeout = if has_special(from)? {
000363 |         std::time::Duration::from_secs(15)
000364 |     } else {
000365 |         std::time::Duration::from_secs(30 * 60)
000366 |     };
000367 |     copy_with_timeout(from, to, timeout)
000368 | }
000369 | fn copy_with_timeout(from: &Path, to: &Path, timeout: std::time::Duration) -> io::Result<()> {
000370 |     if to.exists() {
000371 |         return Err(invalid("copy destination exists"));
000372 |     }
000373 |     let before = fingerprint(from)?;
000374 |     let mut child = Command::new("/usr/bin/ditto")
000375 |         .args(["--rsrc", "--extattr", "--acl"])
000376 |         .arg(from)
000377 |         .arg(to)
000378 |         .env_clear()
000379 |         .env("LC_ALL", "C")
000380 |         .stdin(std::process::Stdio::null())
000381 |         .stdout(std::process::Stdio::null())
000382 |         .stderr(std::process::Stdio::null())
000383 |         .spawn()?;
000384 |     let deadline = std::time::Instant::now() + timeout;
000385 |     loop {
000386 |         match child.try_wait() {
000387 |             Ok(Some(status)) if status.success() => break,
000388 |             Ok(Some(_)) => return Err(io::Error::other("ditto could not copy account data")),
000389 |             Ok(None) if std::time::Instant::now() < deadline => {
000390 |                 std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(20))
000391 |             }
000392 |             result => {
000393 |                 let _ = child.kill();
000394 |                 let _ = child.wait();
000395 |                 return Err(match result {
000396 |                     Err(error) => error,
000397 |                     _ => io::Error::new(
000398 |                         io::ErrorKind::TimedOut,
000399 |                         "ditto account copy timed out; original data preserved",
000400 |                     ),
000401 |                 });
000402 |             }
000403 |         }
000404 |     }
000405 |     if fingerprint(from)? != before || fingerprint(to)? != before {
000406 |         return Err(invalid("account copy content differs"));
000407 |     }
000408 |     sync_copy(to)
000409 | }
000410 | fn sync_copy(path: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {
000411 |     let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path)?;
000412 |     if metadata.is_dir() {
000413 |         for entry in fs::read_dir(path)? {
000414 |             sync_copy(&entry?.path())?;
000415 |         }
000416 |         storage::sync_directory(path)
000417 |     } else if metadata.is_file() {
000418 |         fs::OpenOptions::new()
000419 |             .read(true)
000420 |             .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW | libc::O_CLOEXEC)
000421 |             .open(path)?
000422 |             .sync_all()
000423 |     } else {
000424 |         Ok(())
000425 |     }

000427 | /// Content proof, not an owner/mode/ACL policy. Never follows symbolic links or opens devices/FIFOs.
000428 | fn fingerprint(root: &Path) -> io::Result<String> {
000429 |     fn walk(root: &Path, path: &Path, digest: &mut Sha256) -> io::Result<()> {
000430 |         let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path)?;
000431 |         let relative = path
000432 |             .strip_prefix(root)
000433 |             .map_err(io::Error::other)?
000434 |             .as_os_str()
000435 |             .as_bytes();
000436 |         digest.update((relative.len() as u64).to_le_bytes());
000437 |         digest.update(relative);
000438 |         digest.update((metadata.mode() & u32::from(libc::S_IFMT)).to_le_bytes());
000439 |         if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
000440 |             let target = fs::read_link(path)?;
000441 |             let bytes = target.as_os_str().as_bytes();
000442 |             digest.update((bytes.len() as u64).to_le_bytes());
000443 |             digest.update(bytes);
000444 |         } else if metadata.is_dir() {
000445 |             let mut entries = fs::read_dir(path)?.collect::<io::Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
000446 |             entries.sort_by_key(|entry| entry.file_name());
000447 |             for entry in entries {
000448 |                 walk(root, &entry.path(), digest)?;
000449 |             }
000450 |         } else if metadata.is_file() {
000451 |             digest.update(metadata.len().to_le_bytes());
000452 |             let mut file = fs::OpenOptions::new()
000453 |                 .read(true)
000454 |                 .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW | libc::O_CLOEXEC)
000455 |                 .open(path)?;
000456 |             let opened = file.metadata()?;
000457 |             if opened.dev() != metadata.dev() || opened.ino() != metadata.ino() {
000458 |                 return Err(invalid("account file changed while reading"));
000459 |             }
000460 |             let mut buffer = [0; 65536];
000461 |             loop {
000462 |                 let size = file.read(&mut buffer)?;
000463 |                 if size == 0 {
000464 |                     break;
000465 |                 }
000466 |                 digest.update(&buffer[..size]);
000467 |             }
000468 |         } else {
000469 |             digest.update(metadata.rdev().to_le_bytes());
000470 |         }
000471 |         Ok(())
000472 |     }
000473 |     let mut digest = Sha256::new();
000474 |     walk(root, root, &mut digest)?;
000475 |     Ok(digest
000476 |         .finalize()
000477 |         .iter()
000478 |         .map(|byte| format!("{byte:02x}"))
000479 |         .collect())
000480 | }

000099 | struct HttpsFetcher {
000100 |     client: reqwest::blocking::Client,
000101 | }
000102 | impl HttpsFetcher {
000103 |     fn new() -> Result<Self> {
000104 |         let client = reqwest::blocking::Client::builder()
000105 |             .https_only(true)
000106 |             .redirect(reqwest::redirect::Policy::none())
000107 |             .referer(false)
000108 |             .no_proxy()
000109 |             .connect_timeout(Duration::from_secs(5))
000110 |             .timeout(Duration::from_secs(15))
000111 |             .pool_max_idle_per_host(0)
000112 |             .build()
000113 |             .map_err(|_| "ad_transport")?;
000114 |         Ok(Self { client })
000115 |     }
000116 | }
000117 | impl Fetcher for HttpsFetcher {
000118 |     fn get(&mut self, url: &Url, limit: usize) -> Result<Download> {
000119 |         let response = self
000120 |             .client
000121 |             .get(url.clone())
000122 |             .header(
000123 |                 reqwest::header::ACCEPT,
000124 |                 "application/json,image/png,image/jpeg",
000125 |             )
000126 |             .send()
000127 |             .map_err(|_| "ad_network")?;
000128 |         if response.status() != reqwest::StatusCode::OK || response.url() != url {
000129 |             return Err("ad_http_status_or_redirect");
000130 |         }
000131 |         if response
000132 |             .content_length()
000133 |             .is_some_and(|length| length > limit as u64)
000134 |         {
000135 |             return Err("ad_download_size");
000136 |         }
000137 |         let mime = response
000138 |             .headers()
000139 |             .get(reqwest::header::CONTENT_TYPE)
000140 |             .and_then(|value| value.to_str().ok())
000141 |             .map(str::to_owned);
000142 |         let final_url = response.url().clone();
000143 |         let mut bytes = Vec::new();
000144 |         response
000145 |             .take(limit as u64 + 1)
000146 |             .read_to_end(&mut bytes)
000147 |             .map_err(|_| "ad_download")?;
000148 |         if bytes.len() > limit {
000149 |             return Err("ad_download_size");
000150 |         }
000151 |         Ok(Download {
000152 |             bytes,
000153 |             mime,
000154 |             final_url,
000155 |         })
000156 |     }
000157 | }

000159 | fn enabled(preferences: &AdPreferences) -> bool {
000160 |     preferences.request_purpose_acknowledged
000161 |         && preferences.slots_enabled.iter().any(|enabled| *enabled)
000162 | }
000163 | fn utc(sample: &ClockSample) -> Result<u64> {
000164 |     sample.utc_secs.try_into().map_err(|_| "ad_clock")
000165 | }
000166 | fn jitter() -> Result<u8> {
000167 |     for _ in 0..16 {
000168 |         let mut byte = 0u8;
000169 |         // SAFETY: getentropy writes exactly the single-byte buffer and uses the OS CSPRNG.
000170 |         if unsafe { libc::getentropy((&mut byte as *mut u8).cast(), 1) } != 0 {
000171 |             return Err("ad_random");
000172 |         }
000173 |         if byte < 244 {
000174 |             return Ok(byte % 61);
000175 |         }
000176 |     }
000177 |     Err("ad_random")
000178 | }
000179 | fn write_changed(path: &std::path::Path, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {
000180 |     match storage::read_private_bytes(path, STATE_LIMIT) {
000181 |         Ok(previous) if previous == bytes => return Ok(()),
000182 |         Ok(_) => {}
000183 |         Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {}
000184 |         Err(_) => return Err("ad_state_read"),
000185 |     }
000186 |     storage::atomic_write(path, bytes).map_err(|_| "ad_state_write")
000187 | }
