000203 |     fn v2(&self) -> PathBuf {
000204 |         self.root.join("v2")
000205 |     }
000206 |     fn directory(&self) -> PathBuf {
000207 |         self.v2().join(if self.edition == Edition::Personal {
000208 |             "personal"
000209 |         } else {
000210 |             "public"
000211 |         })
000212 |     }
000213 |     fn ads_directory(&self) -> PathBuf {
000214 |         self.directory().join("ads")
000215 |     }
000216 |     fn lock(&self) -> Result<storage::LifecycleLock> {
000217 |         if let Some(error) = self.local_error {
000218 |             return Err(error);
000219 |         }
000220 |         storage::prepare_data_root(&self.root).map_err(|_| "ad_directory")?;
000221 |         storage::create_private_directory(&self.v2()).map_err(|_| "ad_directory")?;
000222 |         let lock = storage::LifecycleLock::try_acquire(&self.v2()).map_err(|_| "lifecycle_busy")?;
000223 |         for directory in [
000224 |             self.directory(),
000225 |             self.ads_directory(),
000226 |             self.ads_directory().join("assets"),
000227 |         ] {
000228 |             storage::create_private_directory(&directory).map_err(|_| "ad_directory")?;
000229 |         }
000230 |         Ok(lock)
000231 |     }
000232 |     fn load(&self, sample: &ClockSample) -> Result<(Persistent, ClockState)> {
000233 |         let path = self.ads_directory().join("state.json");
000234 |         let mut state: Persistent = match storage::read_private_bytes(&path, STATE_LIMIT) {
000235 |             Ok(bytes) => signed::strict_json(&bytes, STATE_LIMIT)?,
000236 |             Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Persistent::new(),
000237 |             Err(_) => return Err("ad_state_read"),
000238 |         };
000239 |         if state.schema != 1
000240 |             || state.consents.len() > 3
000241 |             || state.confirmations.len() > 3
000242 |             || state.cache.highest_revision > state.sequence.highest
000243 |             || (state.cache.highest_revision == state.sequence.highest
000244 |                 && state.cache.highest_payload_hash != state.sequence.payload_hash)
000245 |             || state
000246 |                 .cache
000247 |                 .cached_wire
000248 |                 .as_ref()
000249 |                 .is_some_and(|wire| wire.len() > ads::MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES)
000250 |         {
000251 |             return Err("ad_state_shape");
000252 |         }
000253 |         let mut clock: ClockState = match storage::read_json(&self.directory().join("clock.json")) {
000254 |             Ok(value) => value,
000255 |             Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => ClockState::default(),
000256 |             Err(_) => return Err("ad_clock_read"),
000257 |         };
000258 |         clock.observe_passive(sample.clone());
000259 |         if let Some(pins) = &self.pins {
000260 |             // Expiry or an untrusted clock hides content without deleting either watermark.
000261 |             let _ = state.cache.restore_verified(
000262 |                 &pins.key,
000263 |                 pins.channel,
000264 |                 &pins.key_id,
000265 |                 utc(sample)?,
000266 |                 clock.trusted(),
000267 |             );
000268 |         }
000269 |         Ok((state, clock))
000270 |     }
000271 |     fn save(&self, state: &Persistent, clock: &ClockState) -> Result<()> {
000272 |         let bytes = serde_json::to_vec(state).map_err(|_| "ad_state_json")?;
000273 |         if bytes.len() > STATE_LIMIT {
000274 |             return Err("ad_state_size");
000275 |         }
000276 |         write_changed(&self.ads_directory().join("state.json"), &bytes)?;
000277 |         write_changed(
000278 |             &self.directory().join("clock.json"),
000279 |             &serde_json::to_vec(clock).map_err(|_| "ad_clock_json")?,
000280 |         )
000281 |     }
000282 |     fn verified_image(&self, asset: &ImageAsset) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {
000283 |         ads::validate_asset(asset)?;
000284 |         let bytes = storage::read_private_bytes(
000285 |             &self.ads_directory().join("assets").join(&asset.sha256),
000286 |             ads::MAX_IMAGE_BYTES,
000287 |         )
000288 |         .map_err(|_| "ad_image_read")?;
000289 |         ads::validate_image(&bytes, asset)?;
000290 |         Ok(bytes)
000291 |     }
000292 |     fn visible(
000293 |         &self,
000294 |         state: &Persistent,
000295 |         clock: &ClockState,
000296 |         preferences: &AdPreferences,
000297 |         now: u64,
000298 |     ) -> Option<AdManifest> {
000299 |         if self.pins.is_none()
000300 |             || !clock.trusted()
000301 |             || state.cache.highest_revision != state.sequence.highest
000302 |         {
000303 |             return None;
000304 |         }
000305 |         if self.pins.as_ref().is_some_and(|pins| pins.local)
000306 |             && local::current_digest(&self.root).ok().flatten().as_ref()
000307 |                 != state.local_wire_hash.as_ref()
000308 |         {
000309 |             return None;
000310 |         }
000311 |         let mut visible = state.cache.manifest()?.clone();
000312 |         for slot in &mut visible.slots {
000313 |             let current = state
000314 |                 .cache
000315 |                 .current_campaign(slot.slot, now, preferences, true)
000316 |                 .filter(|campaign| self.verified_image(&campaign.image).is_ok())
000317 |                 .cloned();

000319 |             slot.campaigns = current.into_iter().collect();
000320 |         }
000321 |         if visible.slots.iter().all(|slot| slot.campaigns.is_empty()) {
000322 |             None
000323 |         } else {
000324 |             Some(visible)
000325 |         }
000326 |     }
000327 |     fn local_changed(&self, state: &Persistent) -> Result<bool> {
000328 |         if !self.pins.as_ref().is_some_and(|pins| pins.local) {
000329 |             return Ok(false);
000330 |         }
000331 |         Ok(local::current_digest(&self.root)?
000332 |             .is_some_and(|hash| state.local_attempt_hash.as_ref() != Some(&hash)))
000333 |     }
000334 |     pub fn snapshot(&self, preferences: &AdPreferences) -> Result<Option<AdManifest>> {
000335 |         let _lock = self.lock()?;
000336 |         let mut sample = time::sample()?;
000337 |         if self.pins.as_ref().is_some_and(|pins| pins.local) && enabled(preferences) {
000338 |             self.refresh_locked(preferences, false, sample.clone(), None, None)?;
000339 |             sample = time::sample()?;
000340 |         }
000341 |         let (state, clock) = self.load(&sample)?;
000342 |         self.save(&state, &clock)?;
000343 |         Ok(self.visible(&state, &clock, preferences, utc(&sample)?))
000344 |     }
000345 |     pub fn refresh_if_due(
000346 |         &self,
000347 |         preferences: &AdPreferences,
000348 |         manual: bool,
000349 |     ) -> Result<RefreshResult> {
000350 |         let _lock = self.lock()?;
000351 |         let sample = time::sample()?;
000352 |         self.refresh_locked(preferences, manual, sample, None, None)
000353 |     }
000354 |     fn refresh_locked(
000355 |         &self,
000356 |         preferences: &AdPreferences,
000357 |         manual: bool,
000358 |         sample: ClockSample,
000359 |         supplied: Option<&mut dyn Fetcher>,
000360 |         fixed_jitter: Option<u8>,
000361 |     ) -> Result<RefreshResult> {
000362 |         let (mut state, mut clock) = self.load(&sample)?;
000363 |         let now = utc(&sample)?;
000364 |         let local_empty = enabled(preferences)
000365 |             && self.pins.as_ref().is_some_and(|pins| pins.local)
000366 |             && local::current_digest(&self.root)?.is_none();
000367 |         let reason = if local_empty {
000368 |             Some("local_ad_not_published")
000369 |         } else if !enabled(preferences) {
000370 |             Some("ads_disabled")
000371 |         } else if self.pins.is_none() {
000372 |             Some("wait_ad_content_materials")
000373 |         } else if !clock.allows_verified_refresh() {
000374 |             Some("clock_recovery_required")
000375 |         } else if !self.local_changed(&state)?
000376 |             && !state.schedule.begin(now, preferences, true, manual)
000377 |         {
000378 |             Some("ad_refresh_not_due_or_merged")
000379 |         } else {
000380 |             None
000381 |         };
000382 |         if let Some(reason) = reason {
000383 |             self.save(&state, &clock)?;
000384 |             // Keep a failed local release visible as a diagnostic during backoff,
000385 |             // including when the background tick performed the first attempt.
000386 |             if reason == "ad_refresh_not_due_or_merged"
000387 |                 && self.pins.as_ref().is_some_and(|pins| pins.local)
000388 |                 && state.local_attempt_hash.is_some()
000389 |                 && state.local_attempt_hash != state.local_wire_hash
000390 |             {
000391 |                 return Err("local_ad_previous_content_verification_failed");
000392 |             }
000393 |             return Ok(RefreshResult {
000394 |                 refreshed: false,
000395 |                 reason,
000396 |                 next_check_at: state.schedule.next_check_at,
000397 |             });
000398 |         }
000399 |         // Only an actual refresh advances the normal observation baseline.
000400 |         clock.observe(sample.clone());
000401 |         if self.pins.as_ref().is_some_and(|pins| pins.local) {
000402 |             state.local_attempt_hash = local::current_digest(&self.root)?;
000403 |         }
000404 |         self.save(&state, &clock)?;
000405 |         let pins = self.pins.as_ref().ok_or("wait_ad_content_materials")?;
000406 |         let supplied_clock = supplied.is_some();
000407 |         let result = (|| -> Result<ClockSample> {
000408 |             let mut owned;
000409 |             let mut local_fetcher = local::LocalFetcher {
000410 |                 root: local::directory(&self.root),
000411 |             };
000412 |             let fetcher: &mut dyn Fetcher = if let Some(fetcher) = supplied {
000413 |                 fetcher
000414 |             } else if pins.local {
000415 |                 &mut local_fetcher
000416 |             } else {
000417 |                 owned = HttpsFetcher::new()?;
000418 |                 &mut owned
000419 |             };
000420 |             let refresh_jitter = match fixed_jitter {
000421 |                 Some(value) => value,
000422 |                 None => jitter()?,
000423 |             };
000424 |             let request = pins
000425 |                 .source
000426 |                 .manifest_request(preferences, pins.channel)
000427 |                 .ok_or("ads_disabled")?;
000428 |             let response = fetcher.get(&request, ads::MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES)?;
000429 |             if !pins
000430 |                 .source
000431 |                 .permits_response_url(&request, &response.final_url)
000432 |             {
000433 |                 return Err("ad_redirect");
000434 |             }
000435 |             if response
000436 |                 .mime
000437 |                 .as_deref()
000438 |                 .and_then(|value| value.split(';').next())
000439 |                 .is_none_or(|mime| mime.trim() != "application/json")
000440 |             {
000441 |                 return Err("ad_manifest_mime");
000442 |             }
000443 |             let (manifest, hash) = ads::verify_manifest(
000444 |                 &response.bytes,
000445 |                 &pins.key,
000446 |                 pins.channel,
000447 |                 &pins.key_id,
000448 |                 now,
000449 |                 true,
000450 |             )?;
000451 |             state.sequence.remember(manifest.content_revision, hash)?;
000452 |             // Preserve authenticated revision even if an asset subsequently fails.
000453 |             self.save(&state, &clock)?;
000454 |             for slot in &manifest.slots {
000455 |                 if !slot.enabled || !preferences.slots_enabled[ads::slot_index(slot.slot)] {
000456 |                     continue;
000457 |                 }
000458 |                 for campaign in slot
000459 |                     .campaigns
000460 |                     .iter()
000461 |                     .filter(|campaign| campaign.enabled && campaign.ends_at > now)
000462 |                 {
000463 |                     if self.verified_image(&campaign.image).is_ok() {
000464 |                         continue;
000465 |                     }
000466 |                     let request = pins
000467 |                         .source
000468 |                         .asset_request(slot.slot, &campaign.image, preferences, pins.channel)?
000469 |                         .ok_or("ads_disabled")?;
000470 |                     let response = fetcher.get(&request, ads::MAX_IMAGE_BYTES)?;
000471 |                     if !pins
000472 |                         .source
000473 |                         .permits_response_url(&request, &response.final_url)
000474 |                     {
000475 |                         return Err("ad_redirect");
000476 |                     }
000477 |                     if response.mime.as_deref() != Some(&campaign.image.mime) {
000478 |                         return Err("ad_image_mime");
000479 |                     }
000480 |                     ads::validate_image(&response.bytes, &campaign.image)?;
000481 |                     storage::atomic_write(
000482 |                         &self
000483 |                             .ads_directory()
000484 |                             .join("assets")
000485 |                             .join(&campaign.image.sha256),
000486 |                         &response.bytes,
000487 |                     )
000488 |                     .map_err(|_| "ad_image_write")?;
000489 |                 }
000490 |             }
000491 |             let final_sample = if supplied_clock {
000492 |                 sample.clone()
000493 |             } else {
000494 |                 time::sample()?
000495 |             };
000496 |             clock.observe(final_sample.clone());
000497 |             if !clock.allows_verified_refresh() {
000498 |                 return Err("clock_recovery_required");
000499 |             }
000500 |             state.cache.accept(
000501 |                 &response.bytes,
000502 |                 &pins.key,
000503 |                 pins.channel,
000504 |                 &pins.key_id,
000505 |                 utc(&final_sample)?,
000506 |                 true,
000507 |             )?;
000508 |             if pins.local {
000509 |                 state.local_wire_hash = Some(signed::digest(&response.bytes));
000510 |             }
000511 |             clock.record_verified_success(final_sample.clone())?;
000512 |             state
000513 |                 .schedule
000514 |                 .complete_success(utc(&final_sample)?, refresh_jitter)?;
000515 |             Ok(final_sample)
000516 |         })();
000517 |         let reason = match result {
000518 |             Ok(_) => "ad_refreshed",
000519 |             Err(reason) => {
000520 |                 state.schedule.complete_failure(now)?;
000521 |                 self.save(&state, &clock)?;
000522 |                 return Err(reason);
000523 |             }
000524 |         };
000525 |         self.save(&state, &clock)?;
000526 |         Ok(RefreshResult {
000527 |             refreshed: true,
000528 |             reason,
000529 |             next_check_at: state.schedule.next_check_at,
000530 |         })
000531 |     }
000532 |     pub fn click_target(
000533 |         &self,
000534 |         slot: AdSlot,
000535 |         confirmed: bool,
000536 |         preferences: &AdPreferences,
000537 |     ) -> Result<ClickDecision> {
000538 |         if self.pins.as_ref().is_some_and(|pins| pins.local) && enabled(preferences) {
000539 |             self.refresh_if_due(preferences, false)?;
000540 |         }
000541 |         let _lock = self.lock()?;
000542 |         let sample = time::sample()?;
000543 |         self.click_locked(slot, confirmed, preferences, &sample)
000544 |     }
000545 |     fn click_locked(
000546 |         &self,
000547 |         slot: AdSlot,
000548 |         confirmed: bool,
000549 |         preferences: &AdPreferences,
000550 |         sample: &ClockSample,
000551 |     ) -> Result<ClickDecision> {
000552 |         let (mut state, mut clock) = self.load(sample)?;
000553 |         clock.observe(sample.clone());
000554 |         let now = utc(sample)?;
000555 |         // A rejected click must still persist a detected clock anomaly.
000556 |         self.save(&state, &clock)?;
000557 |         let visible = self
000558 |             .visible(&state, &clock, preferences, now)
000559 |             .ok_or("ad_not_current")?;
000560 |         let campaign = visible
000561 |             .slots
000562 |             .iter()
000563 |             .find(|content| content.slot == slot)
000564 |             .and_then(|content| content.campaigns.first())
000565 |             .ok_or("ad_not_current")?;
000566 |         let (url, host) = ads::normalize_merchant_url(&campaign.target_url)?;
000567 |         if ads::click_requires_confirmation(&state.consents, slot, campaign)? {
000568 |             let matches = state.confirmations.iter().any(|confirmation| {
000569 |                 confirmation.slot == slot
000570 |                     && confirmation.merchant_id == campaign.merchant_id
000571 |                     && confirmation.normalized_host == host
000572 |                     && confirmation.campaign_id == campaign.campaign_id
000573 |                     && confirmation.release_id == visible.release_id
000574 |                     && confirmation.requested_at <= now
000575 |                     && now < confirmation.requested_at.saturating_add(300)
000576 |             });
000577 |             if !confirmed || !matches {
000578 |                 state
000579 |                     .confirmations
000580 |                     .retain(|confirmation| confirmation.slot != slot);
000581 |                 state.confirmations.push(Confirmation {
000582 |                     slot,
000583 |                     merchant_id: campaign.merchant_id.clone(),
000584 |                     normalized_host: host.clone(),
000585 |                     campaign_id: campaign.campaign_id.clone(),
000586 |                     release_id: visible.release_id,
000587 |                     requested_at: now,
000588 |                 });
000589 |                 self.save(&state, &clock)?;
000590 |                 return Ok(ClickDecision::NeedsConfirmation {
000591 |                     merchant_name: campaign.merchant_name.clone(),
000592 |                     normalized_host: host,
000593 |                 });
000594 |             }
000595 |             ads::record_click_consent(&mut state.consents, slot, campaign)?;
000596 |         }
000597 |         state
000598 |             .confirmations
000599 |             .retain(|confirmation| confirmation.slot != slot);
000600 |         self.save(&state, &clock)?;
000601 |         Ok(ClickDecision::Ready { url })
000602 |     }
000603 |     pub fn image_bytes(
000604 |         &self,
000605 |         slot: AdSlot,
000606 |         preferences: &AdPreferences,
000607 |     ) -> Result<Option<(ImageAsset, Vec<u8>)>> {
000608 |         if self.pins.as_ref().is_some_and(|pins| pins.local) && enabled(preferences) {
000609 |             self.refresh_if_due(preferences, false)?;
000610 |         }
000611 |         let _lock = self.lock()?;
000612 |         let sample = time::sample()?;
000613 |         let (state, clock) = self.load(&sample)?;
000614 |         self.save(&state, &clock)?;
000615 |         let Some(visible) = self.visible(&state, &clock, preferences, utc(&sample)?) else {
000616 |             return Ok(None);
000617 |         };
000618 |         let Some(campaign) = visible
000619 |             .slots
000620 |             .iter()
000621 |             .find(|content| content.slot == slot)
000622 |             .and_then(|content| content.campaigns.first())
000623 |         else {
000624 |             return Ok(None);
000625 |         };
000626 |         Ok(Some((
000627 |             campaign.image.clone(),
000628 |             self.verified_image(&campaign.image)?,
000629 |         )))
000630 |     }
000631 | }

000354 | fn response_once(response: &'static [u8]) -> (Url, std::thread::JoinHandle<String>) {
000355 |     use std::io::{Read, Write};
000356 |     let listener = std::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
000357 |     let address = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
000358 |     let handle = std::thread::spawn(move || {
000359 |         let (mut stream, _) = listener.accept().unwrap();
000360 |         stream
000361 |             .set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(2)))
000362 |             .unwrap();
000363 |         let mut buffer = [0u8; 4096];
000364 |         let count = stream.read(&mut buffer).unwrap();
000365 |         stream.write_all(response).unwrap();
000366 |         String::from_utf8_lossy(&buffer[..count]).into_owned()
000367 |     });
000368 |     (
000369 |         Url::parse(&format!("http://{address}/content/")).unwrap(),
000370 |         handle,
000371 |     )
000372 | }

000756 | fn passive_file_snapshot(path: &std::path::Path) -> (Vec<u8>, u64, i64, i64) {
000757 |     use std::os::unix::fs::MetadataExt;
000758 |     let m = std::fs::symlink_metadata(path).unwrap();
000759 |     (
000760 |         std::fs::read(path).unwrap(),
000761 |         m.ino(),
000762 |         m.mtime(),
000763 |         m.mtime_nsec(),
000764 |     )

000852 |         let path = runtime.directory().join("clock.json");

000855 |         for now in [1001, 1002] {
000856 |             let preferences = if configured {
000857 |                 AdPreferences::default()
000858 |             } else {

000861 |             let result = runtime
000862 |                 .refresh_locked(
000863 |                     &preferences,
000864 |                     false,
000865 |                     sample(now),
000866 |                     Some(&mut fetcher),
000867 |                     Some(0),
000868 |                 )
000869 |                 .unwrap();
000870 |             assert!(!result.refreshed);
000871 |         }
000872 |         assert!(fetcher.requests.is_empty());
000873 |         assert_eq!(before, passive_file_snapshot(&path));

000161 | pub fn validate_manifest(

000163 |     channel: AdChannel,

000166 | ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {

000515 | fn png_is_static(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000516 |     let mut offset = 8usize;
000517 |     let mut first = true;
000518 |     while offset < bytes.len() {
000519 |         let header = bytes
000520 |             .get(offset..offset.checked_add(8).ok_or("image_chunk")?)
000521 |             .ok_or("image_chunk")?;
000522 |         let length =
000523 |             u32::from_be_bytes(header[..4].try_into().map_err(|_| "image_chunk")?) as usize;
000524 |         let kind = &header[4..8];
000525 |         if first && (kind != b"IHDR" || length != 13) {
000526 |             return Err("image_chunk");
000527 |         }
000528 |         first = false;
000529 |         if matches!(kind, b"acTL" | b"fcTL" | b"fdAT") {
000530 |             return Err("image_animation");
000531 |         }
000532 |         offset = offset
000533 |             .checked_add(12)
000534 |             .and_then(|n| n.checked_add(length))
000535 |             .ok_or("image_chunk")?;
000536 |         if offset > bytes.len() {
000537 |             return Err("image_chunk");
000538 |         }
000539 |         if kind == b"IEND" {
000540 |             return if length == 0 && offset == bytes.len() {
000541 |                 Ok(())
000542 |             } else {
000543 |                 Err("image_chunk")
000544 |             };
000545 |         }
000546 |     }
000547 |     Err("image_chunk")
000548 | }

000550 | fn decode_image(bytes: &[u8], mime: &str) -> Result<DynamicImage, &'static str> {
000551 |     if bytes.is_empty() || bytes.len() > MAX_IMAGE_BYTES {
000552 |         return Err("image_size");
000553 |     }
000554 |     let format = match mime {
000555 |         "image/png" if bytes.starts_with(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n") => {
000556 |             png_is_static(bytes)?;
000557 |             ImageFormat::Png
000558 |         }
000559 |         "image/jpeg" if bytes.starts_with(b"\xff\xd8\xff") => ImageFormat::Jpeg,
000560 |         _ => return Err("image_mime"),
000561 |     };
000562 |     let mut header = ImageReader::with_format(Cursor::new(bytes), format);
000563 |     let mut header_limits = Limits::default();
000564 |     header_limits.max_image_width = Some(MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS as u32);
000565 |     header_limits.max_image_height = Some(MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS as u32);
000566 |     header_limits.max_alloc = Some(32 * 1024 * 1024);
000567 |     header.limits(header_limits);
000568 |     let (width, height) = header.into_dimensions().map_err(|_| "image_header")?;
000569 |     if !valid_dimensions(width, height) {
000570 |         return Err("image_dimensions");
000571 |     }
000572 |     let mut reader = ImageReader::with_format(Cursor::new(bytes), format);
000573 |     let mut limits = Limits::default();
000574 |     limits.max_image_width = Some(width);
000575 |     limits.max_image_height = Some(height);
000576 |     limits.max_alloc = Some(32 * 1024 * 1024);
000577 |     reader.limits(limits);
000578 |     reader.decode().map_err(|_| "image_decode")
000579 | }
000580 | 
000581 | pub fn validate_image(bytes: &[u8], asset: &ImageAsset) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000582 |     validate_asset(asset)?;
000583 |     if bytes.len() != asset.bytes as usize || bytes.len() > MAX_IMAGE_BYTES {
000584 |         return Err("image_size");
000585 |     }
000586 |     if signed::digest(bytes) != asset.sha256 {
000587 |         return Err("image_hash");
000588 |     }
000589 |     let _guard = IMAGE_DECODE
000590 |         .lock()
000591 |         .map_err(|_| "image_decoder_unavailable")?;
000592 |     let decoded = decode_image(bytes, &asset.mime)?;
000593 |     if decoded.dimensions() != (asset.width, asset.height) {
000594 |         return Err("image_dimensions");
000595 |     }
000596 |     Ok(())
000597 | }
000598 | 
000599 | /// Decode and re-encode pixels, so input EXIF/text/profile metadata is not copied.
000600 | pub fn normalize_image(bytes: &[u8], mime: &str) -> Result<(Vec<u8>, ImageAsset), &'static str> {
000601 |     let _guard = IMAGE_DECODE
000602 |         .lock()
000603 |         .map_err(|_| "image_decoder_unavailable")?;
000604 |     let decoded = decode_image(bytes, mime)?;
000605 |     let (width, height) = decoded.dimensions();
000606 |     let format = if mime == "image/png" {
000607 |         ImageFormat::Png
000608 |     } else {
000609 |         ImageFormat::Jpeg
000610 |     };
000611 |     let pixels = if format == ImageFormat::Png {
000612 |         DynamicImage::ImageRgba8(decoded.into_rgba8())
000613 |     } else {
000614 |         DynamicImage::ImageRgb8(decoded.into_rgb8())
000615 |     };
000616 |     let mut normalized = Vec::new();
000617 |     pixels
000618 |         .write_to(&mut Cursor::new(&mut normalized), format)
000619 |         .map_err(|_| "image_encode")?;
000620 |     if normalized.len() > MAX_IMAGE_BYTES {
000621 |         return Err("image_size");
000622 |     }
000623 |     let asset = ImageAsset {
000624 |         sha256: signed::digest(&normalized),
000625 |         mime: mime.into(),
000626 |         bytes: normalized.len() as u32,
000627 |         width,
000628 |         height,
000629 |     };
000630 |     Ok((normalized, asset))
000631 | }

000022 | pub fn evaluate_launch(report: &CheckReport, _now: u64, _generation: &str) -> LaunchDecision {
000023 |     let mut reasons = Vec::new();
000024 |     if report.schema_version != 1 {
000025 |         reasons.push("检查报告版本无效".into());
000026 |     }
000027 |     let mut seen = HashSet::new();
000028 |     for row in &report.checks {
000029 |         if !seen.insert(row.id) {
000030 |             reasons.push("检查报告包含重复项".into());
000031 |         }
000032 |         if row.status != CheckStatus::Pass
000033 |             && (row.id.required() || row.status != CheckStatus::Warning)
000034 |         {
000035 |             reasons.push(format!("{}未通过", row.id.name()));
000036 |         }
000037 |     }
000038 |     if report.checks.len() != CheckId::ALL.len() || CheckId::ALL.iter().any(|id| !seen.contains(id))
000039 |     {
000040 |         reasons.push("检查报告缺少必需项目".into());
000041 |     }
000042 |     let expected = summarize(&report.checks);
000043 |     if report.summary.passed != expected.passed
000044 |         || report.summary.advisory != expected.advisory
000045 |         || report.summary.blocking != expected.blocking
000046 |     {
000047 |         reasons.push("检查摘要与逐项结果不一致".into());
000048 |     }
000049 |     reasons.sort();
000050 |     reasons.dedup();
000051 |     LaunchDecision {
000052 |         allowed: reasons.is_empty(),
000053 |         reasons,
000054 |     }
000055 | }

000124 | fn transport_evidence(label: &str, probe: &TransportProbe) -> String {
000125 |     let transport = match probe.transport {
000126 |         TransportState::Reached => "已到达",
000127 |         TransportState::DnsFailure => "DNS 失败",
000128 |         TransportState::TlsFailure => "TLS 失败",

000130 |         TransportState::Timeout => "超时",
000131 |         TransportState::ProxyAuthentication => "代理需要鉴权",
000132 |         TransportState::InvalidResponse => "无效响应",
000133 |     };

000135 |         AccessState::Available => "服务已响应",

000140 |         AccessState::Unknown => "待确认",

000225 | #[derive(Default, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
000226 | struct EgressHistory {
000227 |     previous: Option<String>,
000228 |     entries: Vec<(String, u64)>,
000229 | }
000230 | impl EgressHistory {
000231 |     fn record(&mut self, hash: String, now: u64) -> Outcome {
000232 |         let changed = self
000233 |             .previous
000234 |             .as_ref()
000235 |             .is_some_and(|previous| previous != &hash);
000236 |         self.previous = Some(hash.clone());
000237 |         self.entries
000238 |             .retain(|(_, time)| *time >= now.saturating_sub(172_800));
000239 |         self.entries.push((hash, now));
000240 |         let distinct = self
000241 |             .entries
000242 |             .iter()
000243 |             .map(|(hash, _)| hash)
000244 |             .collect::<HashSet<_>>()
000245 |             .len();
000246 |         if distinct >= 3 {
000247 |             result(
000248 |                 CheckStatus::Warning,
000249 |                 "48 小时内出口地址达到三个，请固定节点",
000250 |             )
000251 |         } else if changed {
000252 |             result(CheckStatus::Warning, "出口地址与上次不同")
000253 |         } else {
000254 |             result(CheckStatus::Pass, "出口地址一致或首次记录")
000255 |         }
000256 |     }
000257 | }
000258 | fn egress_hash(ip: IpAddr) -> String {
000259 |     Sha256::digest(ip.to_string().as_bytes())
000260 |         .iter()
000261 |         .map(|byte| format!("{byte:02x}"))
000262 |         .collect()
000263 | }
000264 | fn legacy_history(home: &std::path::Path) -> EgressHistory {
000265 |     use std::{io::Read, os::unix::fs::OpenOptionsExt};
000266 |     let read = |name: &str| -> Option<String> {
000267 |         let file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
000268 |             .read(true)
000269 |             .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW | libc::O_NONBLOCK)
000270 |             .open(home.join(".claude-switcher").join(name))
000271 |             .ok()?;
000272 |         if !file.metadata().ok()?.is_file() {
000273 |             return None;
000274 |         }
000275 |         let mut text = String::new();
000276 |         file.take(1024 * 1024).read_to_string(&mut text).ok()?;
000277 |         Some(text)
000278 |     };
000279 |     EgressHistory {
000280 |         previous: read("lastip")
000281 |             .and_then(|text| text.trim().parse().ok())
000282 |             .map(egress_hash),
000283 |         entries: read("iphistory.log")
000284 |             .unwrap_or_default()
000285 |             .lines()
000286 |             .filter_map(|line| {
000287 |                 let mut fields = line.split_whitespace();
000288 |                 Some((
000289 |                     egress_hash(fields.next()?.parse().ok()?),
000290 |                     fields.next()?.parse().ok()?,
000291 |                 ))
000292 |             })
000293 |             .collect(),
000294 |     }
000295 | }
000296 | fn record_egress(ip: IpAddr, previous: Option<&str>) -> Outcome {
000297 |     let Ok(home) = crate::config::home_dir() else {
000298 |         return result(CheckStatus::Warning, "无法保存出口历史");
000299 |     };
000300 |     record_egress_at(&home, ip, previous)
000301 | }
000302 | fn record_egress_at(home: &std::path::Path, ip: IpAddr, previous: Option<&str>) -> Outcome {
000303 |     let path = home.join(".claude-switcher/v2/egress-history.json");
000304 |     let mut history: EgressHistory = crate::storage::read_private_bytes(&path, 1024 * 1024)
000305 |         .ok()
000306 |         .and_then(|data| serde_json::from_slice(&data).ok())
000307 |         .unwrap_or_else(|| legacy_history(home));
000308 |     if history.previous.is_none() {
000309 |         history.previous = previous.map(str::to_owned);
000310 |     }
000311 |     let hash = egress_hash(ip);
000312 |     let outcome = history.record(hash, unix_now());
000313 |     let save = || -> std::io::Result<()> {
000314 |         crate::storage::prepare_data_root(&home.join(".claude-switcher"))?;
000315 |         crate::storage::create_private_directory(path.parent().unwrap())?;
000316 |         crate::storage::atomic_json(&path, &history)
000317 |     };
000318 |     if save().is_err() {
000319 |         return result(CheckStatus::Warning, "无法保存出口历史");
000320 |     }
000321 |     outcome
000322 | }

000325 |     use CheckId::*;
000326 |     match id {

000333 |             macos::tunnel_route().await,
000334 |             "外网路由经过隧道",

000336 |         ),
000337 |         EgressRegion => {
000338 |             let mut geo = context.geo().await;
000339 |             if geo.country.is_none() {
000340 |                 geo = context.geo_details().await;
000341 |             }
000342 |             match (&context.config.country_target, geo.country) {
000343 |                 (Some(target), Some(country)) if country == *target && country != "CN" => {
000344 |                     result(CheckStatus::Pass, "出口地区符合已保存目标")
000345 |                 }
000346 |                 (Some(_), Some(_)) => result(CheckStatus::Fail, "出口地区与已保存目标不一致"),
000347 |                 _ => result(CheckStatus::Unknown, "出口地区或地区目标无法确认"),
000348 |             }
000349 |         }
000350 |         IpContinuity => match context.geo().await.ip {
000351 |             Some(ip) => record_egress(ip, context.config.previous_egress_hash.as_deref()),
000352 |             None => result(CheckStatus::Fail, "未获取到出口地址"),
000353 |         },
000354 |         Timezone => {
000355 |             let actual = std::fs::read_link("/etc/localtime")
000356 |                 .ok()
000357 |                 .map(|p| p.to_string_lossy().into_owned());
000358 |             match (&context.config.timezone_target, actual) {
000359 |                 (Some(target), Some(path)) => compare(
000360 |                     Ok(path.ends_with(&format!("/zoneinfo/{target}"))),
000361 |                     "时区符合已保存目标",
000362 |                     "时区与已保存目标不一致",
000363 |                 ),
000364 |                 _ => result(CheckStatus::Unknown, "时区或时区目标无法确认"),
000365 |             }
000366 |         }
000367 |         Locale => {

000370 |                 macos::read_command("/usr/bin/defaults", &["read", "-g", "AppleLocale"]).await,
000371 |             ) {
000372 |                 (Some(target), Ok(actual)) => compare(
000373 |                     Ok(actual.trim() == target),
000374 |                     "地区格式符合已保存目标",
000375 |                     "地区格式与已保存目标不一致",
000376 |                 ),
000377 |                 _ => result(CheckStatus::Unknown, "地区格式或目标无法确认"),
000378 |             }
000379 |         }
000380 |         Ipv6Policy => {
000381 |             match macos::read_command("/usr/sbin/networksetup", &["-getinfo", "Wi-Fi"]).await {
000382 |                 Ok(s) => compare(
000383 |                     Ok(s.lines().any(|line| {
000384 |                         line.trim().to_ascii_lowercase().starts_with("ipv6:")
000385 |                             && line.to_ascii_lowercase().contains("off")
000386 |                     })),
000387 |                     "所选网络服务已关闭 IPv6",
000388 |                     "所选网络服务未关闭 IPv6",
000389 |                 ),
000390 |                 Err(_) => result(CheckStatus::Unknown, "无法确认 IPv6 策略"),
000391 |             }
000392 |         }
000393 |         DnsRoute => match macos::dns_addresses("claude.ai").await {
000394 |             Ok(addresses) => compare(
000395 |                 Ok(addresses.first().is_some_and(fake_ip)),
000396 |                 "claude.ai 首个解析结果为 Fake-IP",
000397 |                 "claude.ai 首个解析结果未走隧道",
000398 |             ),
000399 |             Err(_) => result(CheckStatus::Fail, "无法取得 claude.ai 首个解析结果"),
000400 |         },
000401 |         StunPath => {
000402 |             // STUN has its own bounded probes. No exposed address needs no geo comparison.
000403 |             let results = network::stun_all().await;
000404 |             if results.iter().all(Result::is_err) {
000405 |                 stun_outcome(&results, None)
000406 |             } else {
000407 |                 // The shared geo lookup keeps its independent 21-second budget.
000408 |                 stun_outcome(&results, context.geo().await.ip)
000409 |             }
000410 |         }
000411 | 
000412 |         Guardian => {
000413 |             if macos::read_command(
000414 |                 "/bin/launchctl",
000415 |                 &["print", "system/local.claude-bodyguard"],
000416 |             )
000417 |             .await
000418 |             .is_ok()

000420 |                 result(CheckStatus::Pass, "旧版保镖服务已注册")
000421 |             } else {

000423 |                     "gui/{}/{}",
000424 |                     unsafe { libc::geteuid() },

000429 |                         .await

000432 |                     "保镖未注册",
000433 |                 )
000434 |             }
000435 |         }
000436 |         ServiceRoutes => {
000437 |             if context.config.proxy_mode == "clash-verge" && merge_config_ok() {
000438 |                 return result(CheckStatus::Pass, "Clash 配置包含已保存代理组的置顶规则");
000439 |             }
000440 |             compare(
000441 |                 Ok(context.dns().await.is_some_and(|addresses| {
000442 |                     addresses.len() == 3 && addresses.iter().all(fake_ip)

000448 |         ClientLanguage => {

000450 |                 macos::read_command(

000458 |                     app.as_deref().ok(),

000463 |             )
000464 |         }
000465 |         AsnInfo => match context.geo_details().await.organization {
000466 |             Some(org) if residential_asn(&org) => {
000467 |                 result(CheckStatus::Pass, "出口属于已收录的住宅运营商")
000468 |             }
000469 |             Some(_) => result(CheckStatus::Warning, "出口疑似机房网络"),
000470 |             None => result(CheckStatus::Warning, "未获得网络运营商信息"),
000471 |         },
000472 |         ServiceTransport => {

000475 |             };
000476 |             let (a, b) = tokio::join!(
000477 |                 network::transport_probe(

000505 | pub fn stun_outcome(
000506 |     results: &[Result<IpAddr, network::StunError>],
000507 |     egress: Option<IpAddr>,
000508 | ) -> Outcome {
000509 |     let successful: Vec<_> = results.iter().filter_map(|r| r.as_ref().ok()).collect();
000510 |     let finish = |status, reason| {
000511 |         let evidence = vec![
000512 |             format!("有效 STUN 响应：{}", successful.len()),
000513 |             format!(
000514 |                 "STUN 超时：{}",
000515 |                 results
000516 |                     .iter()
000517 |                     .filter(|r| matches!(r, Err(network::StunError::Timeout)))
000518 |                     .count()
000519 |             ),
000520 |             format!(
000521 |                 "STUN 网络或 DNS 失败：{}",
000522 |                 results
000523 |                     .iter()
000524 |                     .filter(|r| matches!(r, Err(network::StunError::Dns | network::StunError::Io)))
000525 |                     .count()
000526 |             ),
000527 |             format!(
000528 |                 "STUN 来源、事务或解析失败：{}",
000529 |                 results
000530 |                     .iter()
000531 |                     .filter(|r| matches!(
000532 |                         r,
000533 |                         Err(network::StunError::WrongSource
000534 |                             | network::StunError::Header
000535 |                             | network::StunError::Transaction
000536 |                             | network::StunError::Length
000537 |                             | network::StunError::AddressFamily
000538 |                             | network::StunError::MissingAddress)
000539 |                     ))
000540 |                     .count()
000541 |             ),
000542 |         ];
000543 |         (status, reason, evidence)
000544 |     };
000545 |     if successful.is_empty() {
000546 |         return finish(CheckStatus::Pass, "STUN 未返回出口地址，UDP 无暴露");
000547 |     }
000548 |     let Some(egress) = egress else {
000549 |         return finish(
000550 |             CheckStatus::Unknown,
000551 |             "缺少 HTTPS 出口地址，无法比较 STUN 路径",
000552 |         );
000553 |     };
000554 |     if successful.iter().any(|ip| **ip != egress) {
000555 |         return finish(CheckStatus::Fail, "STUN 出口与 HTTPS 出口不一致");
000556 |     }
000557 |     finish(CheckStatus::Pass, "已返回 STUN 出口均与 HTTPS 出口一致")
000558 | }

000560 | pub fn summarize(checks: &[CheckResult]) -> CheckSummary {
000561 |     CheckSummary {
000562 |         passed: checks
000563 |             .iter()
000564 |             .filter(|r| r.status == CheckStatus::Pass)
000565 |             .count() as u32,
000566 |         advisory: checks
000567 |             .iter()
000568 |             .filter(|r| !r.id.required() && r.status == CheckStatus::Warning)
000569 |             .count() as u32,
000570 |         blocking: checks
000571 |             .iter()
000572 |             .filter(|r| {
000573 |                 r.status != CheckStatus::Pass
000574 |                     && (r.id.required() || r.status != CheckStatus::Warning)
000575 |             })
000576 |             .count() as u32,
000577 |     }
000578 | }

000580 | async fn collect_reports(
000581 |     mut tasks: tokio::task::JoinSet<CheckResult>,
000582 |     deadline: Option<tokio::time::Instant>,
000583 |     observed_at: u64,
000584 |     generation: &str,
000585 | ) -> Vec<CheckResult> {
000586 |     let mut checks = Vec::new();
000587 |     while !tasks.is_empty() {
000588 |         let next = match deadline {
000589 |             Some(deadline) => tokio::time::timeout_at(deadline, tasks.join_next()).await,
000590 |             None => Ok(tasks.join_next().await),
000591 |         };
000592 |         match next {
000593 |             Ok(Some(Ok(row))) => checks.push(row),
000594 |             Ok(Some(Err(_))) => {}
000595 |             _ => {
000596 |                 tasks.abort_all();
000597 |                 break;
000598 |             }
000599 |         }
000600 |     }
000601 |     for id in CheckId::ALL {
000602 |         if !checks.iter().any(|r| r.id == id) {
000603 |             checks.push(CheckResult {
000604 |                 id,
000605 |                 status: CheckStatus::Timeout,
000606 |                 reason: "检查到达总截止时间或任务未完成".into(),
000607 |                 observed_at,
000608 |                 duration_ms: 30_000,
000609 |                 valid_until: observed_at + EVIDENCE_TTL_SECONDS,
000610 |                 network_generation: generation.into(),
000611 |                 evidence: vec![],
000612 |             });
000613 |         }
000614 |     }
000615 |     checks.sort_by_key(|r| CheckId::ALL.iter().position(|id| *id == r.id));
000616 |     checks
000617 | }

000619 | pub async fn run_checks(config: CheckConfig) -> CheckReport {
000620 |     let start = Instant::now();
000621 |     let observed_at = unix_now();
000622 |     let generation = "legacy-check".to_string();
000623 |     let valid = config.validate().is_ok();
000624 |     let context = Arc::new(Context {
000625 |         config,
000626 |         client: network::inherited_client().ok(),
000627 |         geo: OnceCell::new(),
000628 |         geo_details: OnceCell::new(),
000629 |         dns: OnceCell::new(),
000630 |     });
000631 |     let mut tasks = tokio::task::JoinSet::new();
000632 |     for id in CheckId::ALL {
000633 |         let context = context.clone();
000634 |         let generation = generation.clone();
000635 |         tasks.spawn(async move {
000636 |             let start = Instant::now();
000637 |             let observed = unix_now();
000638 |             let (status, reason, evidence) = if valid {
000639 |                 observe(id, &context).await
000640 |             } else {
000641 |                 result(CheckStatus::Unknown, "保存的检查配置无效")
000642 |             };
000643 |             CheckResult {
000644 |                 id,
000645 |                 status,
000646 |                 reason: reason.into(),
000647 |                 observed_at: observed,
000648 |                 duration_ms: start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64,

000651 |                 evidence,

000658 |         schema_version: 1,

000660 |         completed_at: unix_now(),
000661 |         duration_ms: start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64,
000662 |         network_generation: generation.clone(),

000665 |         launch: LaunchDecision {
000666 |             allowed: false,

000113 |         options.custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW | libc::O_NONBLOCK);
000114 |     }

000116 |     if !file
000117 |         .metadata()
000118 |         .map_err(|_| "configuration_unreadable")?
000119 |         .is_file()
000120 |     {

000152 |             ] {

000154 |                     *target = Some(value);
000155 |                 }
000156 |             }

000159 |             }

000161 |     }
000162 |     config.validate()?;

000166 | pub(crate) fn literal_assignment(line: &str, key: &str) -> Option<String> {
000167 |     let source = line.strip_prefix(key)?.strip_prefix('=')?;
000168 |     let (value, tail) = if source.starts_with('\'') {
000169 |         // Decode only the single-quoted literal form emitted by the local installer.
000170 |         let mut remaining = source;
000171 |         let mut value = String::new();
000172 |         loop {
000173 |             let quoted = remaining.strip_prefix('\'')?;
000174 |             let (part, tail) = quoted.split_once('\'')?;
000175 |             value.push_str(part);
000176 |             if let Some(next) = tail.strip_prefix("\\'") {
000177 |                 value.push('\'');
000178 |                 remaining = next;
000179 |             } else {
000180 |                 break (value, tail);
000181 |             }
000182 |         }
000183 |     } else {
000184 |         let (value, tail) = source.strip_prefix('"')?.split_once('"')?;
000185 |         if key != "PROXY_GROUP" && value.contains(['$', '`', '\\']) {
000186 |             return None;
000187 |         }
000188 |         (value.to_owned(), tail)
000189 |     };
000190 |     if !tail.trim_start().is_empty() && !tail.trim_start().starts_with('#') {
000191 |         return None;
000192 |     }
000193 |     Some(value)
000194 | }

000019 |         if !matches!(url.scheme(), "http" | "https" | "socks5" | "socks5h")

000022 |             || url.query().is_some()

000025 |             return Err("invalid_or_missing_proxy");
000026 |         }

000029 |             .ok_or("invalid_or_missing_proxy")?

000033 |             .ok_or("invalid_or_missing_proxy")?;

000047 |             "socks5h" => "remote",
000048 |             _ => "proxy_connect",

000100 | /// Apply the same redaction to preview, persistence and export. Avoid raw platform output in the first place.
000101 | pub fn redact(text: &str) -> String {
000102 |     text.lines()
000103 |         .map(|line| {
000104 |             let lower = line.to_ascii_lowercase();
000105 |             if [
000106 |                 "authorization",
000107 |                 "cookie",
000108 |                 "password",
000109 |                 "secret",
000110 |                 "token",
000111 |                 "api_key",
000112 |                 "proxy_url",
000113 |             ]
000114 |             .iter()
000115 |             .any(|key| lower.contains(key))
000116 |             {
000117 |                 return "[敏感字段已隐藏]".into();
000118 |             }
000119 |             let mut line = line.to_owned();
000120 |             if let Some(home) = std::env::var_os("HOME") {
000121 |                 let home = home.to_string_lossy();
000122 |                 if !home.is_empty() {
000123 |                     line = line.replace(home.as_ref(), "[本机目录]");
000124 |                 }
000125 |             }
000126 |             line.split_whitespace()
000127 |                 .map(|word| {
000128 |                     if word.contains("://") {
000129 |                         if let Ok(url) = url::Url::parse(word.trim_matches(['(', ')', ',', ';'])) {
000130 |                             let public = matches!(
000131 |                                 url.host_str(),
000132 |                                 Some(
000133 |                                     "claude.ai"
000134 |                                         | "api.anthropic.com"
000135 |                                         | "ipinfo.io"
000136 |                                         | "ipwho.is"
000137 |                                         | "api.ip.sb"
000138 |                                         | "www.cloudflare.com"
000139 |                                 )
000140 |                             );
000141 |                             if !public
000142 |                                 || !url.username().is_empty()
000143 |                                 || url.query().is_some()
000144 |                                 || url.fragment().is_some()
000145 |                             {
000146 |                                 return "[网络地址已隐藏]".to_owned();
000147 |                             }
000148 |                         } else {
000149 |                             return "[网络地址已隐藏]".to_owned();
000150 |                         }
000151 |                     }
000152 |                     let trimmed = word.trim_matches(['[', ']', '(', ')', ',', ';']);
000153 |                     if trimmed.parse::<IpAddr>().is_ok()
000154 |                         || trimmed.parse::<std::net::SocketAddr>().is_ok()
000155 |                         || word
000156 |                             .split(['=', '/', ',', ';', '(', ')', '→'])
000157 |                             .any(|s| s.trim_matches(['[', ']']).parse::<IpAddr>().is_ok())
000158 |                     {
000159 |                         "[网络地址已隐藏]".to_owned()
000160 |                     } else {
000161 |                         redact_ip_literals(word)
000162 |                     }
000163 |                 })
000164 |                 .collect::<Vec<_>>()
000165 |                 .join(" ")
000166 |         })
000167 |         .collect::<Vec<_>>()
000168 |         .join("\n")
000169 | }

000171 | fn redact_ip_literals(value: &str) -> String {
000172 |     let mut output = String::new();
000173 |     let mut token = String::new();
000174 |     let flush = |token: &mut String, output: &mut String| {
000175 |         if token.is_empty() {
000176 |             return;
000177 |         }
000178 |         let candidate = token.trim_matches(['[', ']']).trim_end_matches('.');
000179 |         if candidate.parse::<IpAddr>().is_ok() || token.parse::<std::net::SocketAddr>().is_ok() {
000180 |             output.push_str("[网络地址已隐藏]");
000181 |         } else {
000182 |             output.push_str(token);
000183 |         }
000184 |         token.clear();
000185 |     };
000186 |     for character in value.chars() {
000187 |         if character.is_ascii_hexdigit() || matches!(character, ':' | '.' | '[' | ']') {
000188 |             token.push(character);
000189 |         } else {
000190 |             flush(&mut token, &mut output);
000191 |             output.push(character);
000192 |         }
000193 |     }
000194 |     flush(&mut token, &mut output);
000195 |     output
000196 | }

000041 |     if health.owner_uid != expected_uid
000042 |         || health.pid <= 1
000043 |         || health.heartbeat_at > now
000044 |         || now.saturating_sub(health.heartbeat_at) > 30
000045 |         || health.started_at > health.heartbeat_at
000046 |     {
000047 |         return Err("guardian_stale");
000048 |     }
000049 |     validate_health_policy(path, &health)?;
000050 |     let record = read_install_record()?;
000051 |     if record.owner_uid != expected_uid {
000052 |         return Err("guardian_install_owner");
000053 |     }
000054 |     verify_process_requirement(
000055 |         health.pid,
000056 |         expected_uid,
000057 |         &record.client_requirement(switcher_domain::system::ClientRole::Guardian)?,
000058 |         None,
000059 |     )?;
000060 |     if read_install_record()? != record {
000061 |         return Err("guardian_install_identity_changed");
000062 |     }
000063 |     Ok(health)
000064 | }
000065 | 
000066 | pub(crate) fn read_install_record() -> Result<switcher_domain::system::InstallRecord, &'static str>
000067 | {
000068 |     use std::{
000069 |         io::Read,
000070 |         os::unix::fs::{MetadataExt, OpenOptionsExt},
000071 |     };
000072 |     let path = Path::new(switcher_domain::system::INSTALL_RECORD);
000073 |     let mut parent = path.parent();
000074 |     while let Some(p) = parent {
000075 |         let m = std::fs::symlink_metadata(p).map_err(|_| "install_record_parent")?;
000076 |         if !m.is_dir() || m.uid() != 0 || m.mode() & 0o022 != 0 {
000077 |             return Err("install_record_permissions");
000078 |         }
000079 |         parent = p.parent();
000080 |     }
000081 |     let file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
000082 |         .read(true)
000083 |         .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW | libc::O_NONBLOCK | libc::O_CLOEXEC)
000084 |         .open(path)
000085 |         .map_err(|_| "install_record_missing")?;
000086 |     let m = file.metadata().map_err(|_| "install_record_metadata")?;
000087 |     if !m.is_file() || m.uid() != 0 || m.mode() & 0o022 != 0 || m.len() > 16384 {
000088 |         return Err("install_record_permissions");
000089 |     }
000090 |     let mut bytes = Vec::new();
000091 |     file.take(16385)
000092 |         .read_to_end(&mut bytes)
000093 |         .map_err(|_| "install_record_read")?;
000094 |     let record: switcher_domain::system::InstallRecord =
000095 |         serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).map_err(|_| "install_record_invalid")?;
000096 |     record.validate()?;
000097 |     Ok(record)
000098 | }

000115 | impl Guardian {
000116 |     pub fn new(owner_uid: u32) -> Result<Self, &'static str> {
000117 |         if owner_uid == 0 {
000118 |             return Err("guardian_owner_root");
000119 |         }

000121 |             owner_uid,
000122 |             report: None,
000123 |         })
000124 |     }

000127 |     }
000128 |     pub fn evaluate(
000129 |         &mut self,
000130 |         event: ProtectionEvent,
000131 |         now: u64,
000132 |         generation: &str,
000133 |     ) -> Option<StopRequest> {
000134 |         let _ = (event, now, generation);
000135 |         // The legacy bodyguard only acts on an observed proxy or TUN failure.
000136 |         let failed = self.report.as_ref().is_some_and(|report| {
000137 |             report.checks.iter().any(|row| {
000138 |                 matches!(
000139 |                     row.id,
000140 |                     switcher_domain::checks::CheckId::ProxyProcess
000141 |                         | switcher_domain::checks::CheckId::TunRoute
000142 |                 ) && row.status == switcher_domain::checks::CheckStatus::Fail
000143 |             })
000144 |         });
000145 |         failed.then_some(StopRequest {
000146 |             owner_uid: self.owner_uid,
000147 |             reason: "proxy_or_tun_offline",
000148 |         })
000149 |     }
000150 | }
000151 | /// Concrete independent stop consumer. Never accepts a caller-supplied identity boolean.
000152 | /// Production callers must be the user-session guardian, not the root helper.
000153 | pub fn stop_verified_claude(request: &StopRequest) -> Result<usize, &'static str> {
000154 |     if unsafe { libc::geteuid() } != request.owner_uid || request.owner_uid == 0 {
000155 |         return Err("stop_owner_uid");
000156 |     }
000157 |     let mut inventory = std::process::Command::new("/bin/ps");
000158 |     inventory
000159 |         .args(["-axo", "pid=,command="])
000160 |         .env_clear()
000161 |         .env("LC_ALL", "C");
000162 |     let output = bounded_inventory(&mut inventory, Duration::from_secs(1))?;
000163 |     if !output.status.success() {
000164 |         return Err("process_inventory");
000165 |     }
000166 |     signal_legacy_claude(&String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout), |pid| {
000167 |         if unsafe { libc::kill(pid, libc::SIGTERM) } == 0
000168 |             || std::io::Error::last_os_error().raw_os_error() == Some(libc::ESRCH)
000169 |         {
000170 |             Ok(())
000171 |         } else {
000172 |             Err("stop_signal_failed")
000173 |         }
000174 |     })
000175 | }
000176 | 
000177 | fn signal_legacy_claude(
000178 |     inventory: &str,
000179 |     mut terminate: impl FnMut(i32) -> Result<(), &'static str>,
000180 | ) -> Result<usize, &'static str> {
000181 |     let mut stopped = 0;
000182 |     let mut failure = None;
000183 |     for line in inventory.lines() {
000184 |         let line = line.trim_start();
000185 |         let Some((pid, command)) = line.split_once(char::is_whitespace) else {
000186 |             continue;
000187 |         };
000188 |         let Some(pid) = pid.parse::<i32>().ok().filter(|pid| *pid > 1) else {
000189 |             continue;
000190 |         };
000191 |         if command.contains("/Applications/Claude.app/Contents/MacOS/Claude") {
000192 |             match terminate(pid) {
000193 |                 Ok(()) => stopped += 1,
000194 |                 Err(error) => failure = Some(error),
000195 |             }
000196 |         }
000197 |     }
000198 |     failure.map_or(Ok(stopped), Err)
000199 | }
000200 | 
000201 | /// Poll the exact inventory child with nonblocking stdout and a size/deadline budget.
000202 | /// After SIGKILL, OS reaping is still synchronous; the single stop slot supervises that boundary too.
000203 | fn bounded_inventory(
000204 |     command: &mut std::process::Command,
000205 |     budget: Duration,
000206 | ) -> Result<std::process::Output, &'static str> {
000207 |     use std::{io::Read, os::fd::AsRawFd, process::Stdio};
000208 |     let mut child = command
000209 |         .stdin(Stdio::null())
000210 |         .stdout(Stdio::piped())
000211 |         .stderr(Stdio::null())
000212 |         .spawn()
000213 |         .map_err(|_| "process_inventory")?;
000214 |     let mut stdout = child.stdout.take().ok_or("process_inventory")?;
000215 |     let descriptor = stdout.as_raw_fd();
000216 |     let flags = unsafe { libc::fcntl(descriptor, libc::F_GETFL) };
000217 |     if flags < 0 || unsafe { libc::fcntl(descriptor, libc::F_SETFL, flags | libc::O_NONBLOCK) } < 0
000218 |     {
000219 |         let _ = child.kill();
000220 |         let _ = child.wait();
000221 |         return Err("process_inventory");
000222 |     }
000223 |     let deadline = std::time::Instant::now() + budget;
000224 |     let mut bytes = Vec::new();
000225 |     let mut eof = false;
000226 |     loop {
000227 |         let mut chunk = [0u8; 4096];
000228 |         let mut idle = false;
000229 |         match stdout.read(&mut chunk) {
000230 |             Ok(0) => {
000231 |                 eof = true;
000232 |                 idle = true;
000233 |             }
000234 |             Ok(length) => bytes.extend_from_slice(&chunk[..length]),
000235 |             Err(error)
000236 |                 if matches!(
000237 |                     error.kind(),
000238 |                     std::io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock | std::io::ErrorKind::Interrupted
000239 |                 ) =>
000240 |             {
000241 |                 idle = true;
000242 |             }
000243 |             Err(_) => {
000244 |                 let _ = child.kill();
000245 |                 let _ = child.wait();
000246 |                 return Err("process_inventory");
000247 |             }
000248 |         }
000249 |         if bytes.len() > 1024 * 1024 || std::time::Instant::now() >= deadline {
000250 |             let _ = child.kill();
000251 |             let _ = child.wait();
000252 |             return Err("process_inventory_budget");
000253 |         }
000254 |         match child.try_wait() {
000255 |             Ok(Some(status)) if eof => {
000256 |                 return Ok(std::process::Output {
000257 |                     status,
000258 |                     stdout: bytes,
000259 |                     stderr: Vec::new(),
000260 |                 });
000261 |             }
000262 |             Ok(_) => {}
000263 |             Err(_) => {
000264 |                 let _ = child.kill();
000265 |                 let _ = child.wait();
000266 |                 return Err("process_inventory");
000267 |             }
000268 |         }
000269 |         if idle {
000270 |             std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(5));
000271 |         }
000272 |     }
000273 | }
000274 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000275 | fn verify_process_requirement(
000276 |     pid: i32,
000277 |     uid: u32,
000278 |     requirement: &str,
000279 |     path: Option<&str>,
000280 | ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000281 |     use std::ffi::{CString, c_void};
000282 |     type Obj = *mut c_void;
000283 |     #[link(name = "proc")]
000284 |     unsafe extern "C" {
000285 |         fn proc_pidpath(pid: i32, buf: *mut c_void, size: u32) -> i32;
000286 |         fn proc_pidinfo(pid: i32, flavor: i32, arg: u64, buf: *mut c_void, size: i32) -> i32;
000287 |     }
000288 |     #[link(name = "CoreFoundation", kind = "framework")]
000289 |     unsafe extern "C" {
000290 |         fn CFNumberCreate(a: Obj, t: i32, v: *const c_void) -> Obj;
000291 |         fn CFStringCreateWithCString(a: Obj, s: *const i8, e: u32) -> Obj;
000292 |         fn CFDictionaryCreate(
000293 |             a: Obj,
000294 |             k: *const Obj,
000295 |             v: *const Obj,
000296 |             n: isize,
000297 |             kcb: Obj,
000298 |             vcb: Obj,
000299 |         ) -> Obj;
000300 |         fn CFRelease(o: Obj);
000301 |     }
000302 |     #[link(name = "Security", kind = "framework")]
000303 |     unsafe extern "C" {
000304 |         static kSecGuestAttributePid: Obj;
000305 |         fn SecCodeCopyGuestWithAttributes(
000306 |             host: Obj,
000307 |             attributes: Obj,
000308 |             flags: u32,
000309 |             code: *mut Obj,
000310 |         ) -> i32;
000311 |         fn SecRequirementCreateWithString(s: Obj, flags: u32, r: *mut Obj) -> i32;
000312 |         fn SecCodeCheckValidity(code: Obj, flags: u32, r: Obj) -> i32;
000313 |     }
000314 |     if pid <= 1 {
000315 |         return Err("process_pid");
000316 |     }
000317 |     // PROC_PIDTBSDINFO: fixed Darwin proc_bsdinfo prefix includes real/effective UID.
000318 |     let mut bsd = [0u8; 136];
000319 |     let len = unsafe { proc_pidinfo(pid, 3, 0, bsd.as_mut_ptr().cast(), bsd.len() as i32) };
000320 |     if len < 24 || u32::from_ne_bytes(bsd[20..24].try_into().unwrap()) != uid {
000321 |         return Err("process_owner");
000322 |     }
000323 |     if let Some(expected) = path {
000324 |         let mut buf = [0u8; 4096];
000325 |         let n = unsafe { proc_pidpath(pid, buf.as_mut_ptr().cast(), buf.len() as u32) };
000326 |         if n <= 0 || buf.split(|b| *b == 0).next() != Some(expected.as_bytes()) {
000327 |             return Err("process_path");
000328 |         }
000329 |     }
000330 |     unsafe {
000331 |         let number = CFNumberCreate(std::ptr::null_mut(), 3, (&pid as *const i32).cast());
000332 |         if number.is_null() {
000333 |             return Err("process_identity");
000334 |         }
000335 |         let attrs = CFDictionaryCreate(
000336 |             std::ptr::null_mut(),
000337 |             &kSecGuestAttributePid,
000338 |             &number,
000339 |             1,
000340 |             std::ptr::null_mut(),
000341 |             std::ptr::null_mut(),
000342 |         );
000343 |         let mut code = std::ptr::null_mut();
000344 |         let status = SecCodeCopyGuestWithAttributes(std::ptr::null_mut(), attrs, 0, &mut code);
000345 |         CFRelease(attrs);
000346 |         CFRelease(number);
000347 |         if status != 0 || code.is_null() {
000348 |             return Err("process_identity");
000349 |         }
000350 |         let text = CString::new(requirement).map_err(|_| "process_requirement")?;
000351 |         let string = CFStringCreateWithCString(std::ptr::null_mut(), text.as_ptr(), 0x08000100);
000352 |         let mut req = std::ptr::null_mut();
000353 |         let made = SecRequirementCreateWithString(string, 0, &mut req);
000354 |         CFRelease(string);
000355 |         let valid = made == 0 && !req.is_null() && SecCodeCheckValidity(code, 0, req) == 0;
000356 |         if !req.is_null() {
000357 |             CFRelease(req);
000358 |         }
000359 |         CFRelease(code);
000360 |         if valid {
000361 |             Ok(())
000362 |         } else {
000363 |             Err("process_signature")
000364 |         }
000365 |     }
000366 | }

000371 |     _: &str,

000373 | ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {

000419 | /// A snapshot binds both policy values and the exact committed configuration file.
000420 | /// File identity also invalidates an A -> B -> A replacement between observations.
000421 | #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
000422 | pub(crate) struct PolicySnapshot {
000423 |     pub(crate) config: crate::config::CheckConfig,
000424 |     fingerprint: String,
000425 | }
000426 | impl PolicySnapshot {
000427 |     pub(crate) fn load(v2: &Path) -> Result<Self, &'static str> {
000428 |         use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
000429 |         use std::{
000430 |             io::Read,
000431 |             os::unix::fs::{MetadataExt, OpenOptionsExt},
000432 |         };
000433 |         crate::storage::validate_no_symlinks(v2).map_err(|_| "guardian_configuration_directory")?;
000434 |         let directory = std::fs::metadata(v2).map_err(|_| "guardian_configuration_directory")?;
000435 |         if directory.uid() != unsafe { libc::geteuid() } || directory.mode() & 0o077 != 0 {
000436 |             return Err("guardian_configuration_directory");
000437 |         }
000438 |         if crate::regions::recovery_pending_v2(v2)? {
000439 |             return Err("guardian_repair_pending");
000440 |         }
000441 |         let file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
000442 |             .read(true)
000443 |             .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW | libc::O_NONBLOCK | libc::O_CLOEXEC)
000444 |             .open(v2.join("config.json"))
000445 |             .map_err(|_| "guardian_configuration_missing")?;
000446 |         let metadata = file
000447 |             .metadata()
000448 |             .map_err(|_| "guardian_configuration_metadata")?;
000449 |         if !metadata.is_file()
000450 |             || metadata.uid() != unsafe { libc::geteuid() }
000451 |             || metadata.mode() & 0o077 != 0
000452 |             || metadata.len() > 16 * 1024
000453 |         {
000454 |             return Err("guardian_configuration_permissions");
000455 |         }
000456 |         let mut bytes = Vec::new();
000457 |         (&file)
000458 |             .take(16 * 1024 + 1)
000459 |             .read_to_end(&mut bytes)
000460 |             .map_err(|_| "guardian_configuration_read")?;
000461 |         if bytes.len() > 16 * 1024 {
000462 |             return Err("guardian_configuration_size");
000463 |         }
000464 |         let config: crate::config::CheckConfig =
000465 |             serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).map_err(|_| "guardian_configuration_invalid")?;
000466 |         config.validate()?;
000467 |         if config.country_target.is_none()
000468 |             || config.timezone_target.is_none()
000469 |             || config
000470 |                 .locale_target
000471 |                 .as_ref()
000472 |                 .is_none_or(|value| value.is_empty())
000473 |         {
000474 |             return Err("guardian_configuration_incomplete");
000475 |         }
000476 |         let identity = |m: &std::fs::Metadata| {
000477 |             (
000478 |                 m.dev(),
000479 |                 m.ino(),
000480 |                 m.len(),
000481 |                 m.mtime(),
000482 |                 m.mtime_nsec(),
000483 |                 m.ctime(),
000484 |                 m.ctime_nsec(),
000485 |             )
000486 |         };
000487 |         let after = file
000488 |             .metadata()
000489 |             .map_err(|_| "guardian_configuration_metadata")?;
000490 |         let named = std::fs::symlink_metadata(v2.join("config.json"))
000491 |             .map_err(|_| "guardian_configuration_missing")?;
000492 |         if identity(&metadata) != identity(&after)
000493 |             || identity(&metadata) != identity(&named)
000494 |             || named.file_type().is_symlink()
000495 |             || crate::regions::recovery_pending_v2(v2)?
000496 |         {
000497 |             return Err("guardian_configuration_changed");
000498 |         }
000499 |         let mut digest = Sha256::new();
000500 |         digest.update(format!("{:?}", identity(&metadata)).as_bytes());
000501 |         digest.update(&bytes);
000502 |         Ok(Self {
000503 |             config,
000504 |             fingerprint: digest
000505 |                 .finalize()
000506 |                 .iter()
000507 |                 .map(|byte| format!("{byte:02x}"))
000508 |                 .collect(),
000509 |         })
000510 |     }
000511 | }

000526 | /// Runs the guardian in its owner session. Configuration always comes from fixed v2/config.json.
000527 | /// Stop work runs independently from checks and the lifecycle writer lock.
000528 | pub async fn run(
000529 |     config: crate::config::CheckConfig,
000530 |     state_path: &Path,
000531 |     events: tokio::sync::mpsc::Receiver<ProtectionEvent>,
000532 |     shutdown: tokio::sync::watch::Receiver<bool>,
000533 | ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000534 |     let timezone_guard = crate::timezone_guard::spawn(state_path, shutdown.clone())?;
000535 |     let mut installation_probe = crate::installation_health::GuardianProbe::default();
000536 |     let result = run_driver(
000537 |         (state_path, config),
000538 |         events,
000539 |         shutdown,
000540 |         DriverTiming::PRODUCTION,
000541 |         observe_legacy_guardian,
000542 |         stop_verified_claude,
000543 |         (
000544 |             || async {
000545 |                 tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(1), crate::macos::network_generation())
000546 |                     .await
000547 |                     .ok()
000548 |                     .and_then(Result::ok)
000549 |                     .unwrap_or_default()
000550 |             },
000551 |             move |sequence| installation_probe.tick(sequence),
000552 |         ),
000553 |     )
000554 |     .await;
000555 |     timezone_guard.abort();
000556 |     result
000557 | }

000570 |     #[cfg(test)]
