000591 |     result: Result<usize, &'static str>,
000592 | }
000593 | /// Exactly one blocking execution slot. Timeout revokes health; it does not cancel an OS thread.
000594 | /// A timed-out synchronous Security call keeps this slot occupied until it actually returns.
000595 | struct StopSupervisor {
000596 |     consumer: std::sync::Arc<StopConsumer>,
000597 |     job: Option<StopJob>,
000598 |     pending: Option<(u64, StopRequest)>,
000599 |     confirmed_epoch: Option<u64>,
000600 |     failed: bool,
000601 |     timeout: Duration,
000602 |     retry: Duration,
000603 |     retry_at: tokio::time::Instant,
000604 | }
000605 | impl StopSupervisor {
000606 |     fn new(
000607 |         consumer: impl Fn(&StopRequest) -> Result<usize, &'static str> + Send + Sync + 'static,
000608 |         timeout: Duration,
000609 |         retry: Duration,
000610 |     ) -> Self {
000611 |         Self {
000612 |             consumer: std::sync::Arc::new(consumer),
000613 |             job: None,
000614 |             pending: None,
000615 |             confirmed_epoch: None,
000616 |             failed: false,
000617 |             timeout,
000618 |             retry,
000619 |             retry_at: tokio::time::Instant::now(),
000620 |         }
000621 |     }
000622 |     fn request(&mut self, epoch: u64, request: StopRequest) {
000623 |         self.confirmed_epoch = None;
000624 |         if self.job.as_ref().is_some_and(|job| job.epoch == epoch) {
000625 |             return;
000626 |         }
000627 |         self.pending = Some((epoch, request));
000628 |     }
000629 |     fn start_ready(&mut self) {
000630 |         if self.job.is_some() || tokio::time::Instant::now() < self.retry_at {
000631 |             return;
000632 |         }
000633 |         if let Some((epoch, request)) = self.pending.take() {
000634 |             let consumer = self.consumer.clone();
000635 |             let operation = request.clone();
000636 |             self.job = Some(StopJob {
000637 |                 epoch,
000638 |                 request,
000639 |                 deadline: tokio::time::Instant::now() + self.timeout,
000640 |                 timed_out: false,
000641 |                 handle: tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || consumer(&operation)),
000642 |             });
000643 |         }
000644 |     }
000645 |     async fn join(&mut self) -> StopCompletion {
000646 |         let result = (&mut self.job.as_mut().expect("active stop slot").handle)
000647 |             .await
000648 |             .unwrap_or(Err("guardian_stop_worker_join"));
000649 |         let job = self.job.take().expect("completed stop slot");
000650 |         StopCompletion {
000651 |             epoch: job.epoch,
000652 |             request: job.request,
000653 |             timed_out: job.timed_out || tokio::time::Instant::now() >= job.deadline,
000654 |             result,
000655 |         }
000656 |     }
000657 |     fn finish(&mut self, completion: StopCompletion, current_epoch: u64) -> bool {
000658 |         if !completion.timed_out
000659 |             && completion.result.is_ok()
000660 |             && completion.epoch == current_epoch
000661 |             && self.pending.is_none()
000662 |         {
000663 |             self.failed = false;
000664 |             self.confirmed_epoch = Some(current_epoch);
000665 |             true
000666 |         } else {
000667 |             self.failed = true;
000668 |             self.confirmed_epoch = None;
000669 |             // A late success from a timed-out or old epoch cannot acknowledge a newer request.
000670 |             if self.pending.is_none() && completion.epoch == current_epoch {
000671 |                 self.pending = Some((current_epoch, completion.request));
000672 |             }
000673 |             self.retry_at = tokio::time::Instant::now() + self.retry;
000674 |             false
000675 |         }
000676 |     }
000677 | }
000678 | async fn run_driver<C, CF, S, G, GF, H>(
000679 |     state: (&Path, crate::config::CheckConfig),
000680 |     mut events: tokio::sync::mpsc::Receiver<ProtectionEvent>,
000681 |     mut shutdown: tokio::sync::watch::Receiver<bool>,
000682 |     timing: DriverTiming,
000683 |     check: C,
000684 |     stop: S,
000685 |     hooks: (G, H),
000686 | ) -> Result<(), &'static str>
000687 | where
000688 |     C: Fn(crate::config::CheckConfig) -> CF,
000689 |     CF: std::future::Future<Output = CheckReport> + Send + 'static,
000690 |     S: Fn(&StopRequest) -> Result<usize, &'static str> + Send + Sync + 'static,
000691 |     G: Fn() -> GF,
000692 |     GF: std::future::Future<Output = String>,
000693 |     H: FnMut(u64),
000694 | {
000695 |     let (state_path, mut config) = state;
000696 |     let (_, mut installation_tick) = hooks;
000697 |     let uid = unsafe { libc::geteuid() };
000698 |     let v2 = state_path.parent().ok_or("guardian_state_directory")?;
000699 |     let mut guardian = Guardian::new(uid)?;
000700 |     let mut ticker = tokio::time::interval(timing.tick);
000701 |     ticker.set_missed_tick_behavior(tokio::time::MissedTickBehavior::Skip);
000702 |     let mut checks = tokio::task::JoinSet::new();
000703 |     let mut stop = StopSupervisor::new(stop, timing.stop_timeout, timing.retry);
000704 |     let started = crate::checks::unix_now();
000705 |     let mut sequence = 0;
000706 |     let mut events_open = true;
000707 |     let mut fingerprint = String::new();
000708 |     #[cfg(all(target_os = "macos", not(test)))]
000709 |     let mut update_checked = 0;
000710 |     loop {
000711 |         let stop_running = stop.job.is_some();
000712 |         let event = tokio::select! {
000713 |             result = shutdown.changed() => {
000714 |                 if result.is_err() || *shutdown.borrow() { checks.abort_all(); return Ok(()); }
000715 |                 continue;
000716 |             },
000717 |             report = checks.join_next(), if !checks.is_empty() => {
000718 |                 if let Some(Ok(report)) = report {
000719 |                     guardian.update(report);
000720 |                     if let Some(request) = guardian.evaluate(ProtectionEvent::Timer, 0, "") {
000721 |                         stop.request(0, request);
000722 |                     } else {
000723 |                         stop.pending = None;
000724 |                     }
000725 |                 }
000726 |                 false
000727 |             },
000728 |             result = stop.join(), if stop_running => {
000729 |                 stop.finish(result, 0);
000730 |                 if guardian.evaluate(ProtectionEvent::Timer, 0, "").is_none() { stop.pending = None; }
000731 |                 false
000732 |             },
000733 |             event = events.recv(), if events_open => {
000734 |                 if event.is_none() { events_open = false; continue; }
000735 |                 true
000736 |             },
000737 |             _ = ticker.tick() => {
000738 |                 sequence += 1;
000739 |                 installation_tick(sequence);
000740 |                 #[cfg(all(target_os = "macos", not(test)))]
000741 |                 {
000742 |                     let now = crate::checks::unix_now();
000743 |                     if now.saturating_sub(update_checked) >= 60 {
000744 |                         update_checked = now;
000745 |                         tokio::task::spawn_blocking(spawn_public_update_check);
000746 |                     }
000747 |                 }
000748 |                 true
000749 |             },
000750 |         };
000751 |         if event && checks.is_empty() {
000752 |             // Keep the previous proxy mode if configuration is temporarily unavailable.
000753 |             if let Some(home) = v2.parent().and_then(Path::parent)
000754 |                 && (home.join(".claude-switcher/v2/config.json").exists()
000755 |                     || home.join(".local/bin/claude-switch.sh").exists())
000756 |                 && let Ok(current) = crate::config::load_read_only(home)
000757 |             {
000758 |                 config = current;
000759 |                 // The snapshot is optional heartbeat diagnostics, never a refresh gate.
000760 |                 fingerprint = PolicySnapshot::load(v2)
000761 |                     .map(|snapshot| snapshot.fingerprint)
000762 |                     .unwrap_or_default();
000763 |             }
000764 |             let future = check(config.clone());
000765 |             checks.spawn(future);
000766 |         }
000767 |         stop.start_ready();
000768 |         let health = GuardianHealth {
000769 |             owner_uid: uid,
000770 |             pid: std::process::id() as i32,
000771 |             heartbeat_at: crate::checks::unix_now(),
000772 |             started_at: started,
000773 |             policy: config.clone(),
000774 |             policy_fingerprint: fingerprint.clone(),
000775 |             degraded: stop.failed,
000776 |         };
000777 |         // Heartbeats are diagnostics. Snapshot contention cannot disable the bodyguard.
000778 |         if let Ok(_lock) = crate::storage::GuardianSnapshotLock::try_acquire(v2, true) {
000779 |             let _ = crate::storage::atomic_json(state_path, &health);
000780 |         }
000781 |     }
000782 | }

000855 | /// Invalidate before attempting the bounded notification queue. Overflow may
000856 | /// coalesce guardian work, but it must never preserve old launch evidence.
000857 | #[cfg(any(target_os = "macos", test))]
000858 | fn publish_native_event(
000859 |     sender: &tokio::sync::mpsc::Sender<ProtectionEvent>,
000860 |     event: ProtectionEvent,
000861 |     invalidate: impl FnOnce(),
000862 | ) {
000863 |     invalidate();
000864 |     let _ = sender.try_send(event);

000868 | pub struct NativeEvents {
000869 |     stop: std::sync::Arc<std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool>,
000870 |     thread: Option<std::thread::JoinHandle<()>>,
000871 | }
000872 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000873 | impl NativeEvents {
000874 |     pub(crate) fn is_running(&self) -> bool {
000875 |         self.thread
000876 |             .as_ref()
000877 |             .is_some_and(|thread| !thread.is_finished())
000878 |     }

000880 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000881 | impl Drop for NativeEvents {
000882 |     fn drop(&mut self) {
000883 |         self.stop.store(true, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Release);
000884 |         if let Some(thread) = self.thread.take() {
000885 |             let _ = thread.join();
000886 |         }
000887 |     }

000889 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000890 | pub fn native_events()
000891 | -> Result<(NativeEvents, tokio::sync::mpsc::Receiver<ProtectionEvent>), &'static str> {
000892 |     use std::ffi::c_void;
000893 |     type Obj = *mut c_void;
000894 |     #[repr(C)]
000895 |     struct StoreContext {
000896 |         version: isize,
000897 |         info: Obj,
000898 |         retain: Obj,
000899 |         release: Obj,
000900 |         copy_description: Obj,
000901 |     }
000902 |     struct PowerContext {
000903 |         sender: tokio::sync::mpsc::Sender<ProtectionEvent>,
000904 |         port: u32,
000905 |     }
000906 |     #[link(name = "CoreFoundation", kind = "framework")]
000907 |     unsafe extern "C" {
000908 |         static kCFRunLoopDefaultMode: Obj;
000909 |         fn CFRunLoopGetCurrent() -> Obj;
000910 |         fn CFRunLoopAddSource(runloop: Obj, source: Obj, mode: Obj);
000911 |         fn CFRunLoopRemoveSource(runloop: Obj, source: Obj, mode: Obj);
000912 |         fn CFRunLoopRunInMode(mode: Obj, seconds: f64, return_after_source: bool) -> i32;
000913 |         fn CFStringCreateWithCString(a: Obj, s: *const i8, e: u32) -> Obj;
000914 |         fn CFArrayCreate(a: Obj, values: *const Obj, count: isize, callbacks: Obj) -> Obj;
000915 |         fn CFRelease(o: Obj);
000916 |     }
000917 |     #[link(name = "SystemConfiguration", kind = "framework")]
000918 |     unsafe extern "C" {
000919 |         fn SCDynamicStoreCreate(
000920 |             a: Obj,
000921 |             name: Obj,
000922 |             callback: unsafe extern "C" fn(Obj, Obj, Obj),
000923 |             context: *mut StoreContext,
000924 |         ) -> Obj;
000925 |         fn SCDynamicStoreSetNotificationKeys(store: Obj, keys: Obj, patterns: Obj) -> bool;
000926 |         fn SCDynamicStoreCreateRunLoopSource(a: Obj, store: Obj, order: isize) -> Obj;
000927 |     }
000928 |     #[link(name = "IOKit", kind = "framework")]
000929 |     unsafe extern "C" {
000930 |         fn IORegisterForSystemPower(
000931 |             context: Obj,
000932 |             notification_port: *mut Obj,
000933 |             callback: unsafe extern "C" fn(Obj, u32, u32, Obj),
000934 |             notifier: *mut u32,
000935 |         ) -> u32;
000936 |         fn IONotificationPortGetRunLoopSource(port: Obj) -> Obj;
000937 |         fn IODeregisterForSystemPower(notifier: *mut u32) -> i32;
000938 |         fn IONotificationPortDestroy(port: Obj);
000939 |         fn IOServiceClose(port: u32) -> i32;
000940 |         fn IOAllowPowerChange(port: u32, id: isize) -> i32;
000941 |     }
000942 |     unsafe extern "C" fn changed(_: Obj, _: Obj, context: Obj) {
000943 |         let sender = unsafe { &*context.cast::<tokio::sync::mpsc::Sender<ProtectionEvent>>() };
000944 |         publish_native_event(
000945 |             sender,
000946 |             ProtectionEvent::NetworkChanged,
000947 |             crate::macos::invalidate_network_generation,
000948 |         );
000949 |     }
000950 |     unsafe extern "C" fn power(context: Obj, _service: u32, kind: u32, argument: Obj) {
000951 |         let context = unsafe { &*context.cast::<PowerContext>() };
000952 |         if kind == 0xe0000300 {
000953 |             publish_native_event(
000954 |                 &context.sender,
000955 |                 ProtectionEvent::Wake,
000956 |                 crate::macos::invalidate_network_generation,
000957 |             );
000958 |         } else if kind == 0xe0000270 || kind == 0xe0000280 {
000959 |             unsafe { IOAllowPowerChange(context.port, argument as isize) };
000960 |         }
000961 |     }
000962 |     let (tx, rx) = tokio::sync::mpsc::channel(16);
000963 |     let (ready_tx, ready_rx) = std::sync::mpsc::sync_channel(1);
000964 |     let stop = std::sync::Arc::new(std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool::new(false));
000965 |     let thread_stop = stop.clone();
000966 |     let thread = std::thread::Builder::new()
000967 |         .name("switcher-network-observer".into())
000968 |         .spawn(move || unsafe {
000969 |             let null = std::ptr::null_mut();
000970 |             let name =
000971 |                 CFStringCreateWithCString(null, c"ClaudeSwitcherGuardian".as_ptr(), 0x08000100);
000972 |             let mut context = StoreContext {
000973 |                 version: 0,
000974 |                 info: (&tx as *const tokio::sync::mpsc::Sender<ProtectionEvent>)
000975 |                     .cast_mut()
000976 |                     .cast(),
000977 |                 retain: null,
000978 |                 release: null,
000979 |                 copy_description: null,
000980 |             };
000981 |             let store = SCDynamicStoreCreate(null, name, changed, &mut context);
000982 |             CFRelease(name);
000983 |             if store.is_null() {
000984 |                 let _ = ready_tx.send(Err("network_events_unavailable"));
000985 |                 return;
000986 |             }
000987 |             let keys = [
000988 |                 c"State:/Network/Global/IPv4",
000989 |                 c"State:/Network/Global/IPv6",
000990 |                 c"State:/Network/Global/DNS",
000991 |             ]
000992 |             .map(|s| CFStringCreateWithCString(null, s.as_ptr(), 0x08000100));
000993 |             let array = CFArrayCreate(null, keys.as_ptr(), keys.len() as isize, null);
000994 |             // Global route/resolver keys alone miss interface and per-service changes.
000995 |             let patterns = [
000996 |                 c"State:/Network/Interface/.*/.*",
000997 |                 c"State:/Network/Service/.*/.*",
000998 |             ]
000999 |             .map(|s| CFStringCreateWithCString(null, s.as_ptr(), 0x08000100));
001000 |             let pattern_array =
001001 |                 CFArrayCreate(null, patterns.as_ptr(), patterns.len() as isize, null);
001002 |             let configured = SCDynamicStoreSetNotificationKeys(store, array, pattern_array);
001003 |             CFRelease(pattern_array);
001004 |             for pattern in patterns {
001005 |                 CFRelease(pattern);
001006 |             }
001007 |             CFRelease(array);
001008 |             for key in keys {
001009 |                 CFRelease(key);
001010 |             }
001011 |             let source = SCDynamicStoreCreateRunLoopSource(null, store, 0);
001012 |             if !configured || source.is_null() {
001013 |                 if !source.is_null() {
001014 |                     CFRelease(source);
001015 |                 }
001016 |                 CFRelease(store);
001017 |                 let _ = ready_tx.send(Err("network_events_unavailable"));
001018 |                 return;
001019 |             }
001020 |             let mut notification_port: Obj = std::ptr::null_mut();
001021 |             let mut notifier = 0;
001022 |             let mut context = Box::new(PowerContext {
001023 |                 sender: tx.clone(),
001024 |                 port: 0,
001025 |             });
001026 |             context.port = IORegisterForSystemPower(
001027 |                 (&mut *context as *mut PowerContext).cast(),
001028 |                 &mut notification_port,
001029 |                 power,
001030 |                 &mut notifier,
001031 |             );
001032 |             if context.port == 0 || notification_port.is_null() {
001033 |                 if notifier != 0 {
001034 |                     IODeregisterForSystemPower(&mut notifier);
001035 |                 }
001036 |                 if context.port != 0 {
001037 |                     IOServiceClose(context.port);
001038 |                 }
001039 |                 if !notification_port.is_null() {
001040 |                     IONotificationPortDestroy(notification_port);
001041 |                 }
001042 |                 CFRelease(source);
001043 |                 CFRelease(store);
001044 |                 let _ = ready_tx.send(Err("power_events_unavailable"));
001045 |                 return;
001046 |             }
001047 |             let runloop = CFRunLoopGetCurrent();
001048 |             let power_source = IONotificationPortGetRunLoopSource(notification_port);
001049 |             if power_source.is_null() {
001050 |                 IODeregisterForSystemPower(&mut notifier);
001051 |                 IOServiceClose(context.port);
001052 |                 IONotificationPortDestroy(notification_port);
001053 |                 CFRelease(source);
001054 |                 CFRelease(store);
001055 |                 let _ = ready_tx.send(Err("power_events_unavailable"));
001056 |                 return;
001057 |             }
001058 |             CFRunLoopAddSource(runloop, source, kCFRunLoopDefaultMode);
001059 |             CFRunLoopAddSource(runloop, power_source, kCFRunLoopDefaultMode);
001060 |             let _ = ready_tx.send(Ok(()));
001061 |             while !thread_stop.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Acquire) && !tx.is_closed() {
001062 |                 CFRunLoopRunInMode(kCFRunLoopDefaultMode, 0.25, true);
001063 |             }
001064 |             CFRunLoopRemoveSource(runloop, source, kCFRunLoopDefaultMode);
001065 |             CFRunLoopRemoveSource(runloop, power_source, kCFRunLoopDefaultMode);
001066 |             IODeregisterForSystemPower(&mut notifier);
001067 |             IOServiceClose(context.port);
001068 |             IONotificationPortDestroy(notification_port);
001069 |             CFRelease(source);
001070 |             CFRelease(store);
001071 |         })
001072 |         .map_err(|_| "native_events_thread_unavailable")?;
001073 |     let guard = NativeEvents {
001074 |         stop,
001075 |         thread: Some(thread),
001076 |     };
001077 |     ready_rx
001078 |         .recv_timeout(Duration::from_secs(3))
001079 |         .map_err(|_| "native_events_timeout")??;
001080 |     Ok((guard, rx))
001081 | }
001082 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
001083 | pub async fn run_native(
001084 |     config: crate::config::CheckConfig,
001085 |     state_path: &Path,
001086 |     shutdown: tokio::sync::watch::Receiver<bool>,
001087 | ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
001088 |     match native_events() {
001089 |         Ok((_native, events)) => run(config, state_path, events, shutdown).await,
001090 |         Err(_) => {
001091 |             // Native notifications are optional accelerators for the ten-second poll.
001092 |             let (_sender, events) = tokio::sync::mpsc::channel(1);
001093 |             run(config, state_path, events, shutdown).await
001094 |         }
001095 |     }
001096 | }

001118 |         let (guard, receiver) = super::native_events().unwrap();
001119 |         assert!(guard.is_running());
001120 |         std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(300));
001121 |         assert!(guard.is_running());

001162 | fn spawn_public_update_check() -> Result<(), &'static str> {
001163 |     let record = read_install_record()?;
001164 |     if record.owner_uid != unsafe { libc::geteuid() } {
001165 |         return Err("update_owner_uid");
001166 |     }
001167 |     if record.edition != switcher_domain::Edition::Public {
001168 |         return Ok(());
001169 |     }
001170 |     record.developer_team()?;
001171 |     let app = Path::new("/Applications/Claude 切换器 Public.app");
001172 |     let status = std::process::Command::new("/usr/bin/codesign")
001173 |         .args([
001174 |             "--verify",
001175 |             "--strict",
001176 |             "--test-requirement",
001177 |             &format!(
001178 |                 "={}",
001179 |                 record.client_requirement(switcher_domain::system::ClientRole::Gui)?
001180 |             ),
001181 |         ])
001182 |         .arg(app)
001183 |         .status()
001184 |         .map_err(|_| "update_app_signature_unavailable")?;
001185 |     if !status.success() {
001186 |         return Err("update_app_signature");
001187 |     }
001188 |     if read_install_record()? != record {
001189 |         return Err("update_install_identity_changed");
001190 |     }
001191 |     std::process::Command::new(app.join("Contents/MacOS/switcher-desktop"))
001192 |         .args(["--update-task", "check"])
001193 |         .stdin(std::process::Stdio::null())
001194 |         .stdout(std::process::Stdio::null())
001195 |         .stderr(std::process::Stdio::null())
001196 |         .spawn()
001197 |         .map_err(|_| "update_task_spawn")?;
001198 |     Ok(())

000020 | fn safe_file(path: &Path, contents: Option<&[u8]>) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000021 |     use std::os::unix::fs::{MetadataExt, OpenOptionsExt};
000022 |     for parent in path.ancestors().skip(1) {
000023 |         let m = std::fs::symlink_metadata(parent).map_err(|_| REINSTALL)?;
000024 |         if !m.is_dir() || m.uid() != 0 || m.mode() & 0o022 != 0 {
000025 |             return Err(REINSTALL);
000026 |         }
000027 |     }
000028 |     let file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
000029 |         .read(true)
000030 |         .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW | libc::O_NONBLOCK | libc::O_CLOEXEC)
000031 |         .open(path)
000032 |         .map_err(|_| REINSTALL)?;
000033 |     let m = file.metadata().map_err(|_| REINSTALL)?;
000034 |     if !m.is_file() || m.uid() != 0 || m.mode() & 0o022 != 0 || m.nlink() != 1 {
000035 |         return Err(REINSTALL);
000036 |     }
000037 |     if let Some(expected) = contents {
000038 |         let mut bytes = Vec::new();
000039 |         file.take(expected.len() as u64 + 1)
000040 |             .read_to_end(&mut bytes)
000041 |             .map_err(|_| REINSTALL)?;
000042 |         validate_plist(&bytes)?;
000043 |     }
000044 |     Ok(())
000045 | }
000046 | fn validate_plist(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000047 |     if bytes == TEMPLATE {
000048 |         Ok(())
000049 |     } else {
000050 |         Err(REINSTALL)

000100 | fn bound_health<R: PartialEq>(
000101 |     expected: &R,
000102 |     mut current: impl FnMut() -> Result<R, &'static str>,
000103 |     healthy: impl FnOnce() -> bool,
000104 | ) -> Result<bool, &'static str> {
000105 |     if current()? != *expected {
000106 |         return Err(INCOMPLETE);
000107 |     }
000108 |     let result = healthy();
000109 |     if current()? != *expected {
000110 |         return Err(INCOMPLETE);
000111 |     }
000112 |     Ok(result)
000113 | }
000114 | 
000115 | fn repair_with<T>(
000116 |     validate: impl FnOnce() -> Result<T, &'static str>,
000117 |     mut healthy: impl FnMut() -> bool,
000118 |     registered: impl FnOnce() -> Result<bool, &'static str>,
000119 |     restart: impl FnOnce(bool) -> Result<(), &'static str>,
000120 |     mut wait: impl FnMut() -> bool,
000121 | ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000122 |     let guard = validate().map_err(|_| INCOMPLETE)?;
000123 |     if healthy() {
000124 |         return Ok(());
000125 |     }
000126 |     restart(registered().map_err(|_| INCOMPLETE)?).map_err(|_| INCOMPLETE)?;
000127 |     drop(guard); // Guardian needs the lifecycle lock to publish current health.
000128 |     loop {
000129 |         if healthy() {
000130 |             return Ok(());
000131 |         }
000132 |         if !wait() {
000133 |             return Err(INCOMPLETE);
000134 |         }
000135 |     }
000136 | }
000137 | /// Caller has committed and released the lifecycle lock before waiting for health.
000138 | pub(crate) fn restore_after_commit(edition: Edition) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000139 |     let uid = unsafe { libc::geteuid() };
000140 |     let domain = format!("gui/{uid}");
000141 |     let target = format!("{domain}/{GUARDIAN_LABEL}");
000142 |     let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(10);
000143 |     let expected = std::cell::RefCell::new(None);
000144 |     let identity_changed = std::cell::Cell::new(false);
000145 |     repair_with(
000146 |         || {
000147 |             let home = crate::migration::account_home(uid).map_err(|_| INCOMPLETE)?;
000148 |             let lock =
000149 |                 crate::storage::LifecycleLock::try_acquire(&home.join(".claude-switcher/v2"))
000150 |                     .map_err(|_| INCOMPLETE)?;
000151 |             *expected.borrow_mut() = Some(validate(edition)?);
000152 |             Ok(lock)
000153 |         },
000154 |         || {
000155 |             if identity_changed.get() {
000156 |                 return false;
000157 |             }
000158 |             expected.borrow().as_ref().is_some_and(|record| {
000159 |                 bound_health(record, crate::guardian::read_install_record, || {
000160 |                     crate::install::validate_installed_health(uid).is_ok()
000161 |                 })
000162 |                 .unwrap_or_else(|_| {
000163 |                     identity_changed.set(true);
000164 |                     false
000165 |                 })
000166 |             })
000167 |         },
000168 |         || {
000169 |             if identity_changed.get() {
000170 |                 Err(INCOMPLETE)
000171 |             } else {
000172 |                 command("/bin/launchctl", &["print", &target])
000173 |             }
000174 |         },
000175 |         |registered| {
000176 |             let ok = if registered {
000177 |                 command("/bin/launchctl", &["kickstart", "-k", &target])?
000178 |             } else {
000179 |                 command("/bin/launchctl", &["bootstrap", &domain, PLIST])?
000180 |             };
000181 |             if ok { Ok(()) } else { Err(INCOMPLETE) }
000182 |         },
000183 |         || {
000184 |             if identity_changed.get() || Instant::now() >= deadline {
000185 |                 false
000186 |             } else {
000187 |                 std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100));
000188 |                 true
000189 |             }
000190 |         },
000191 |     )
000192 | }

000340 | /// Restore only existing root-owned daemon plists and fixed protected executables.
000341 | /// Missing artifacts are reported; no user-writable program is copied or elevated.
000342 | pub(crate) fn legacy_admin_commands() -> (Vec<String>, bool) {
000343 |     legacy_admin_commands_with(
000344 |         |label| command("/bin/launchctl", &["print", &format!("system/{label}")]),
000345 |         |plist, executable, template| {
000346 |             if !Path::new(plist).exists() {
000347 |                 return Ok(false);
000348 |             }
000349 |             safe_file(Path::new(plist), None)?;
000350 |             if std::fs::read(plist).map_err(|_| REINSTALL)? != template {
000351 |                 return Err(REINSTALL);
000352 |             }
000353 |             safe_file(Path::new(executable), None)?;
000354 |             Ok(true)
000355 |         },
000356 |         || {
000357 |             if !Path::new(PLIST).exists() {
000358 |                 return Ok(false);
000359 |             }
000360 |             safe_file(Path::new(PLIST), Some(TEMPLATE))?;
000361 |             safe_file(Path::new(BINARY), None)?;
000362 |             let domain = format!("gui/{}", unsafe { libc::geteuid() });
000363 |             let target = format!("{domain}/{GUARDIAN_LABEL}");
000364 |             if command("/bin/launchctl", &["print", &target])?
000365 |                 || command("/bin/launchctl", &["bootstrap", &domain, PLIST])?
000366 |             {
000367 |                 Ok(true)
000368 |             } else {
000369 |                 Err(REINSTALL)
000370 |             }
000371 |         },
000372 |     )
000373 | }
000374 | 
000375 | fn legacy_admin_commands_with(
000376 |     mut registered: impl FnMut(&str) -> Result<bool, &'static str>,
000377 |     mut components: impl FnMut(&str, &str, &[u8]) -> Result<bool, &'static str>,
000378 |     user_guardian: impl FnOnce() -> Result<bool, &'static str>,
000379 | ) -> (Vec<String>, bool) {
000380 |     let mut commands = Vec::new();
000381 |     let mut bodyguard_available = false;
000382 |     let mut failed = false;
000383 |     for (label, plist, executable, template) in [
000384 |         (
000385 |             "local.claude-bodyguard",
000386 |             "/Library/LaunchDaemons/local.claude-bodyguard.plist",
000387 |             "/Library/Application Support/claude-switcher/claude-bodyguard.sh",
000388 |             &include_bytes!("../../../daemons/local.claude-bodyguard.plist")[..],
000389 |         ),
000390 |         (
000391 |             "local.tz-watchdog",
000392 |             "/Library/LaunchDaemons/local.tz-watchdog.plist",
000393 |             "/Library/Application Support/claude-switcher/tz-watchdog.sh",
000394 |             &include_bytes!("../../../daemons/local.tz-watchdog.plist")[..],
000395 |         ),
000396 |     ] {
000397 |         let available = match registered(label) {
000398 |             Ok(true) => true,
000399 |             result => {
000400 |                 failed |= result.is_err();
000401 |                 match components(plist, executable, template) {
000402 |                     Ok(true) => {
000403 |                         commands.push(format!("/bin/launchctl bootstrap system '{plist}'"));
000404 |                         true
000405 |                     }
000406 |                     Ok(false) => false,
000407 |                     Err(_) => {
000408 |                         failed = true;
000409 |                         false
000410 |                     }
000411 |                 }
000412 |             }
000413 |         };
000414 |         if label == "local.claude-bodyguard" {
000415 |             bodyguard_available = available;
000416 |         }
000417 |     }
000418 |     let user_available = match user_guardian() {
000419 |         Ok(available) => available,
000420 |         Err(_) => {
000421 |             failed = true;
000422 |             false
000423 |         }
000424 |     };
000425 |     (commands, !failed && (bodyguard_available || user_available))
000426 | }

000150 |         backend: &mut impl InstallBackend,
000151 |     ) -> Result<InstallJournal, &'static str> {
000152 |         let _lock = LifecycleLock::try_acquire(&self.directory).map_err(|_| "lifecycle_busy")?;
000153 |         self.ensure_no_pending()?;
000154 |         // Rebuild the preview from fixed fields; never trust serialized lists of privileged paths.
000155 |         let expected = self.preview(
000156 |             preview.owner_uid,
000157 |             preview.edition,
000158 |             preview.previous_edition,
000159 |             preview.intent,
000160 |         )?;
000161 |         if serde_json::to_vec(&expected).ok() != serde_json::to_vec(&preview).ok() {
000162 |             return Err("install_preview_changed");
000163 |         }
000164 |         let mut journal = InstallJournal {
000165 |             schema_version: 1,
000166 |             preview,
000167 |             stage: Stage::Preview,
000168 |             completed: vec![],
000169 |             pending: Some("authorize".into()),
000170 |             errors: vec![],
000171 |         };
000172 |         self.save(&journal)?;
000173 |         if let Err(code) = backend.authorize() {
000174 |             journal.stage = Stage::Cancelled;
000175 |             journal.pending = None;
000176 |             journal.errors.push(code.into());
000177 |             self.save(&journal)?;
000178 |             return Ok(journal);
000179 |         }
000180 |         journal.stage = Stage::Authorized;
000181 |         self.save(&journal)?;
000182 |         for (operation, stage) in [
000183 |             ("backup", Stage::BackupSaved),
000184 |             ("stage", Stage::ComponentsStaged),
000185 |             ("health", Stage::HealthVerified),
000186 |             ("commit", Stage::Committed),
000187 |         ] {
000188 |             journal.pending = Some(operation.into());
000189 |             self.save(&journal)?;
000190 |             let result = match operation {
000191 |                 "backup" => backend.backup(),
000192 |                 "stage" => backend.stage_signed_components(&journal.preview),
000193 |                 "health" => backend.verify_health(&journal.preview),
000194 |                 "commit" => backend.commit_root_record(&journal.preview),
000195 |                 _ => unreachable!(),
000196 |             };
000197 |             if let Err(code) = result {
000198 |                 if operation == "commit" && backend.is_committed(&journal.preview)? {
000199 |                     journal.stage = Stage::Committed;
000200 |                     journal.pending = None;
000201 |                     self.save(&journal)?;
000202 |                     return Ok(journal);
000203 |                 }
000204 |                 journal.errors.push(code.into());
000205 |                 journal.stage = Stage::RollingBack;
000206 |                 self.save(&journal)?;
000207 |                 return self.rollback(journal, backend);
000208 |             }
000209 |             journal.completed.push(operation.into());
000210 |             journal.pending = None;
000211 |             journal.stage = stage;
000212 |             self.save(&journal)?;
000213 |         }
000214 |         Ok(journal)
000215 |     }
000216 |     fn rollback(
000217 |         &self,
000218 |         mut journal: InstallJournal,
000219 |         backend: &mut impl InstallBackend,
000220 |     ) -> Result<InstallJournal, &'static str> {
000221 |         // Even a partially completed backup must support idempotent restore.
000222 |         journal.pending = Some("restore".into());
000223 |         self.save(&journal)?;
000224 |         match backend.restore_backup(&journal.preview) {
000225 |             Ok(()) => {
000226 |                 journal.stage = Stage::Recovered;
000227 |                 journal.pending = None;
000228 |             }
000229 |             Err(code) => {
000230 |                 journal.stage = Stage::RecoveryRequired;
000231 |                 journal.errors.push(code.into());
000232 |             }
000233 |         }
000234 |         self.save(&journal)?;
000235 |         Ok(journal)
000236 |     }
000237 |     pub fn recover(
000238 |         &self,
000239 |         backend: &mut impl InstallBackend,
000240 |     ) -> Result<InstallJournal, &'static str> {
000241 |         let _lock = LifecycleLock::try_acquire(&self.directory).map_err(|_| "lifecycle_busy")?;
000242 |         let mut journal = self.inspect()?;
000243 |         if journal.pending.as_deref() == Some("commit") && backend.is_committed(&journal.preview)? {
000244 |             journal.stage = Stage::Committed;
000245 |             journal.pending = None;
000246 |             self.save(&journal)?;
000247 |             return Ok(journal);
000248 |         }
000249 |         if matches!(
000250 |             journal.stage,
000251 |             Stage::Committed | Stage::Recovered | Stage::Cancelled
000252 |         ) {
000253 |             return Ok(journal);
000254 |         }
000255 |         self.rollback(journal, backend)
000256 |     }
000257 |     pub fn directory(&self) -> &Path {
000258 |         &self.directory
000259 |     }
000260 | }

000616 | /// Production backend. Both forward and recovery PKGs must be signed by the pinned team.
000617 | /// No mutation occurs during construction or package verification.
000618 | pub struct SignedPkgBackend {
000619 |     package: PathBuf,
000620 |     recovery_package: PathBuf,
000621 |     team: String,
000622 |     state: PathBuf,
000623 |     authorization: usize,
000624 |     window: Option<switcher_helper::root_operation::RootWindow>,
000625 |     expected_hash: Option<String>,
000626 |     previous: Option<Edition>,
000627 |     target: Option<Edition>,
000628 |     uid: u32,
000629 | }
000630 | impl SignedPkgBackend {
000631 |     pub fn new(
000632 |         package: PathBuf,
000633 |         recovery_package: PathBuf,
000634 |         team: String,
000635 |         state: PathBuf,
000636 |     ) -> Result<Self, &'static str> {
000637 |         if team.len() != 10
000638 |             || !team
000639 |                 .bytes()
000640 |                 .all(|b| b.is_ascii_uppercase() || b.is_ascii_digit())
000641 |         {
000642 |             return Err("installer_team");
000643 |         }
000644 |         if !package.is_absolute() || !recovery_package.is_absolute() || package == recovery_package
000645 |         {
000646 |             return Err("installer_package_path");
000647 |         }
000648 |         storage::create_private_directory(&state).map_err(|_| "installer_state")?;
000649 |         Ok(Self {
000650 |             package,
000651 |             recovery_package,
000652 |             team,
000653 |             state,
000654 |             authorization: 0,
000655 |             window: None,
000656 |             expected_hash: None,
000657 |             previous: None,
000658 |             target: None,
000659 |             uid: unsafe { libc::geteuid() },
000660 |         })

000662 |     pub fn verify_package(path: &Path, team: &str) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000663 |         let meta = std::fs::symlink_metadata(path).map_err(|_| "package_missing")?;
000664 |         if !meta.is_file() || meta.file_type().is_symlink() {
000665 |             return Err("package_type");
000666 |         }
000667 |         let output = std::process::Command::new("/usr/sbin/pkgutil")
000668 |             .arg("--check-signature")
000669 |             .arg(path)
000670 |             .env("LC_ALL", "C")
000671 |             .output()
000672 |             .map_err(|_| "package_signature_unavailable")?;
000673 |         let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);
000674 |         if !output.status.success()
000675 |             || !text.lines().any(|s| {
000676 |                 s.contains("Developer ID Installer:") && s.trim().ends_with(&format!("({team})"))
000677 |             })
000678 |         {
000679 |             return Err("package_signature");
000680 |         }
000681 |         let status = std::process::Command::new("/usr/sbin/spctl")
000682 |             .args(["--assess", "--type", "install"])
000683 |             .arg(path)
000684 |             .status()
000685 |             .map_err(|_| "package_assessment_unavailable")?;
000686 |         if status.success() {
000687 |             Ok(())
000688 |         } else {
000689 |             Err("package_notarization")
000690 |         }

000927 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000928 | fn run_root_operation(
000929 |     op: &switcher_helper::root_operation::RootOperation,
000930 |     team: &str,
000931 | ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000932 |     let installed = Path::new("/Library/PrivilegedHelperTools/local.claudeswitcher.helper");
000933 |     let binary = if installed.exists() {
000934 |         installed.to_owned()
000935 |     } else {
000936 |         std::env::current_exe()
000937 |             .map_err(|_| "wait_signed_bootstrap")?
000938 |             .parent()
000939 |             .and_then(|p| p.parent())
000940 |             .ok_or("wait_signed_bootstrap")?
000941 |             .join("Resources/components/switcher-helper")
000942 |     };
000943 |     if !binary.is_file() {
000944 |         return Err("wait_signed_bootstrap");
000945 |     }
000946 |     verify_binary_signature(&binary, team, switcher_domain::system::HELPER_LABEL)?;
000947 |     let body = serde_json::to_string(op).map_err(|_| "root_operation_encoding")?;
000948 |     if body.len() > 16384 {
000949 |         return Err("root_operation_size");
000950 |     }
000951 |     run_administrator(&root_operation_script(&binary, &body, team)?)
000952 | }
000953 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000954 | fn root_operation_script(binary: &Path, body: &str, team: &str) -> Result<String, &'static str> {
000955 |     let requirement = format!(
000956 |         "=anchor apple generic and certificate leaf[subject.OU] = \"{team}\" and identifier \"local.claudeswitcher.helper\""
000957 |     );
000958 |     let script = format!(
000959 |         r#"set -eu
000960 | base='/Library/Application Support/claude-switcher'
000961 | for p in '/Library' '/Library/Application Support' "$base"; do
000962 | [ ! -L "$p" ] || exit 72
000963 | if [ -e "$p" ]; then
000964 | [ "$(/usr/bin/stat -f %u "$p")" = 0 ] || exit 73
000965 | /usr/bin/find "$p" -maxdepth 0 -perm +022 | /usr/bin/grep -q . && exit 74
000966 | fi
000967 | done
000968 | /bin/mkdir -p "$base"
000969 | /usr/sbin/chown root:wheel "$base"
000970 | /bin/chmod 755 "$base"
000971 | stage=$(/usr/bin/mktemp -d "$base/.bootstrap-XXXXXX")
000972 | /bin/chmod 700 "$stage"
000973 | trap '/bin/rm -rf "$stage"' EXIT
000974 | /bin/cp {} "$stage/runner"
000975 | /usr/sbin/chown root:wheel "$stage/runner"
000976 | /bin/chmod 700 "$stage/runner"
000977 | /usr/bin/codesign --verify --strict --test-requirement {} "$stage/runner"
000978 | "$stage/runner" --root-operation {}
000979 | "#,
000980 |         shell_literal(binary.to_str().ok_or("bootstrap_path_encoding")?),
000981 |         shell_literal(&requirement),
000982 |         shell_literal(body)
000983 |     );
000984 |     Ok(script)
000985 | }
000986 | /// A lock capability is retained for the complete native update transaction.
000987 | /// The desktop adapter persists its aggregate state; this journal survives its process dying.
000988 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000989 | pub struct NativeUpdateCoordinator<'a> {
000990 |     root: PathBuf,
000991 |     lock: &'a LifecycleLock,
000992 |     clock: crate::time::ClockState,
000993 | }
000994 | #[derive(Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
000995 | #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
000996 | struct UpdateTransaction {
000997 |     schema: u32,
000998 |     edition: Edition,
000999 |     team: String,
001000 |     old_app: String,
001001 |     old_helper: String,
001002 |     app: String,
001003 |     helper_changed: bool,
001004 |     helper_pending: bool,
001005 |     app_pending: bool,
001006 |     committed: bool,
001007 |     updates: crate::updates::UpdateState,
001008 | }
001009 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
001010 | impl<'a> NativeUpdateCoordinator<'a> {
001011 |     pub fn new(
001012 |         root: &Path,
001013 |         lock: &'a LifecycleLock,
001014 |         clock: crate::time::ClockState,
001015 |     ) -> Result<Self, &'static str> {
001016 |         if !lock.protects(root) {
001017 |             return Err("lifecycle_lock_required");
001018 |         }
001019 |         Ok(Self {
001020 |             root: root.to_owned(),
001021 |             lock,
001022 |             clock,
001023 |         })
001024 |     }
001025 |     fn path(&self) -> PathBuf {
001026 |         self.root.join("update-install-transaction.json")
001027 |     }
001028 |     fn save(&self, journal: &UpdateTransaction) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
001029 |         if !self.lock.protects(&self.root) {
001030 |             return Err("lifecycle_lock_required");
001031 |         }
001032 |         let bytes = serde_json::to_vec(journal).map_err(|_| "update_transaction_encoding")?;
001033 |         if bytes.len() > crate::updates::STATE_LIMIT + 16384 {
001034 |             return Err("update_transaction_size");
001035 |         }
001036 |         storage::atomic_write(&self.path(), &bytes).map_err(|_| "update_transaction_write")
001037 |     }
001038 |     /// Real recovery keeps RecoveryRequired until both old signed components verify.
001039 |     /// Call under the same lock before accepting another candidate.
001040 |     pub fn recover(&mut self, state: &mut crate::updates::UpdateState) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
001041 |         let mut journal: UpdateTransaction = match read_update_transaction(&self.path()) {
001042 |             Ok(j) => j,
001043 |             Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok(()),
001044 |             Err(_) => return Err("update_transaction_read"),
001045 |         };
001046 |         if journal.schema != 1 {
001047 |             return Err("update_transaction_schema");
001048 |         }
001049 |         if journal.committed {
001050 |             if state.candidate.as_ref().map(|c| &c.payload_hash)
001051 |                 == journal.updates.candidate.as_ref().map(|c| &c.payload_hash)
001052 |             {
001053 |                 *state = journal.updates;
001054 |             }
001055 |             return Ok(());
001056 |         }
001057 |         let uid = unsafe { libc::geteuid() };
001058 |         crate::accounts::ensure_claude_stopped(uid).map_err(|_| "claude_running")?;
001059 |         let record = switcher_helper::platform::load_root_record(Path::new(INSTALL_RECORD))?;
001060 |         if record.owner_uid != uid
001061 |             || record.edition != journal.edition
001062 |             || record.developer_team()? != journal.team
001063 |         {
001064 |             return Err("update_recovery_identity");
001065 |         }
001066 |         if self
001067 |             .root
001068 |             .join("account-journal.json")
001069 |             .try_exists()
001070 |             .map_err(|_| "account_journal")?
001071 |         {
001072 |             return Err("account_recovery_required");
001073 |         }
001074 |         journal.updates.recover_interrupted();
001075 |         self.save(&journal)?;
001076 |         if journal.helper_pending
001077 |             && (record.helper_version != journal.old_helper
001078 |                 || Path::new(switcher_domain::system::SYSTEM_ROOT)
001079 |                     .join("component-pending")
001080 |                     .exists())
001081 |         {
001082 |             let old = switcher_helper::platform::load_root_record(
001083 |                 &Path::new(switcher_domain::system::SYSTEM_ROOT)
001084 |                     .join("component-backup/install.json"),
001085 |             )?;
001086 |             if old.helper_version != journal.old_helper
001087 |                 || old.edition != journal.edition
001088 |                 || old.developer_team()? != journal.team
001089 |                 || old.owner_uid != uid
001090 |             {
001091 |                 return Err("update_recovery_snapshot");
001092 |             }
001093 |             let recovery = self.recovery_pkg(journal.edition);
001094 |             let backend = SignedPkgBackend::new(
001095 |                 self.root.join("unused-forward.pkg"),
001096 |                 recovery.clone(),
001097 |                 journal.team.clone(),
001098 |                 self.root.clone(),
001099 |             )?;
001100 |             backend.install_package(&recovery)?;
001101 |         }
001102 |         if journal.app_pending {
001103 |             run_root_operation(
001104 |                 &switcher_helper::root_operation::RootOperation::RestoreApp {
001105 |                     edition: journal.edition,
001106 |                     team: journal.team.clone(),
001107 |                     old: journal.old_app.clone(),
001108 |                     new: journal.app.clone(),
001109 |                 },
001110 |                 &journal.team,
001111 |             )?;
001112 |         }
001113 |         let restored = wait_installed(journal.edition, uid)?;
001114 |         if restored.helper_version != journal.old_helper {
001115 |             return Err("update_recovery_helper_version");
001116 |         }
001117 |         verify_app_version(
001118 |             &installed_app(journal.edition),
001119 |             &journal.team,
001120 |             record.bundle_id(switcher_domain::system::ClientRole::Gui),
001121 |             &journal.old_app,
001122 |         )?;
001123 |         if journal
001124 |             .updates
001125 |             .candidate
001126 |             .as_ref()
001127 |             .is_some_and(|c| c.stage == crate::updates::InstallStage::RecoveryRequired)
001128 |         {
001129 |             journal.updates.advance_install(
001130 |                 crate::updates::InstallStage::RecoveryRequired,
001131 |                 crate::updates::InstallStage::RolledBack,
001132 |             )?;
001133 |         }
001134 |         *state = journal.updates.clone();
001135 |         journal.committed = true;
001136 |         self.save(&journal)
001137 |     }
001138 |     fn fresh_gate(
001139 |         &mut self,
001140 |         metadata: &crate::updates::Metadata,
001141 |         uid: u32,
001142 |     ) -> Result<u64, &'static str> {
001143 |         if !self.lock.protects(&self.root) {
001144 |             return Err("lifecycle_lock_required");
001145 |         }
001146 |         let sample = crate::time::sample()?;
001147 |         self.clock.observe(sample.clone());
001148 |         let now: u64 = sample.utc_secs.try_into().map_err(|_| "update_clock")?;
001149 |         validate_update_time(&self.clock, metadata.issued_at, metadata.expires_at, now)?;
001150 |         crate::accounts::ensure_claude_stopped(uid).map_err(|_| "claude_running")?;
001151 |         if self
001152 |             .root
001153 |             .join("account-journal.json")
001154 |             .try_exists()
001155 |             .map_err(|_| "account_journal")?
001156 |         {
001157 |             return Err("account_recovery_required");
001158 |         }
001159 |         Ok(now)
001160 |     }
001161 |     fn recovery_pkg(&self, edition: Edition) -> PathBuf {
001162 |         self.root
001163 |             .join(match edition {
001164 |                 Edition::Personal => "personal",
001165 |                 Edition::Public => "public",
001166 |             })
001167 |             .join("update-recovery/helper.pkg")

001170 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
001171 | impl crate::updates::UpdateInstallCoordinator for NativeUpdateCoordinator<'_> {
001172 |     fn install(
001173 |         &mut self,
001174 |         prepared: &crate::updates::PreparedInstallation,
001175 |         state: &mut crate::updates::UpdateState,
001176 |     ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
001177 |         use crate::updates::{InstallOrder, InstallReadiness, InstallStage as UStage};
001178 |         if !self.lock.protects(&self.root) {
001179 |             return Err("lifecycle_lock_required");
001180 |         }
001181 |         if self.path().exists() {
001182 |             let previous: UpdateTransaction =
001183 |                 read_update_transaction(&self.path()).map_err(|_| "update_transaction_read")?;
001184 |             if !previous.committed {
001185 |                 return Err("update_recovery_required");
001186 |             }
001187 |         }
001188 |         let sample = crate::time::sample()?;
001189 |         self.clock.observe(sample.clone());
001190 |         if !self.clock.trusted() {
001191 |             return Err("clock_recovery_required");
001192 |         }
001193 |         let uid = unsafe { libc::geteuid() };
001194 |         let metadata = prepared.candidate().metadata();
001195 |         let installed = validate_installed_identity(metadata.edition, uid)?;
001196 |         let installed_team = installed.developer_team()?.to_owned();
001197 |         validate_installed_health(uid)?;
001198 |         if self
001199 |             .root
001200 |             .join("account-journal.json")
001201 |             .try_exists()
001202 |             .map_err(|_| "account_journal")?
001203 |         {
001204 |             return Err("account_recovery_required");
001205 |         }
001206 |         crate::accounts::ensure_claude_stopped(uid).map_err(|_| "claude_running")?;
001207 |         let app = installed_app(metadata.edition);
001208 |         verify_binary_signature(
001209 |             &app,
001210 |             &installed_team,
001211 |             installed.bundle_id(switcher_domain::system::ClientRole::Gui),
001212 |         )?;
001213 |         let old_app = app_version(&app)?;
001214 |         let _app_version = semver::Version::parse(&old_app).map_err(|_| "installed_app_version")?;
001215 |         let helper_version = semver::Version::parse(&installed.helper_version)
001216 |             .map_err(|_| "installed_helper_version")?;
001217 |         let final_helper = metadata
001218 |             .helper
001219 |             .as_ref()
001220 |             .map(|h| &h.version)
001221 |             .unwrap_or(&helper_version);
001222 |         if metadata.app.team_id != installed_team
001223 |             || !metadata.app.compatible_with.matches(final_helper)
001224 |             || metadata.helper.as_ref().is_some_and(|h| {
001225 |                 h.team_id != installed_team || !h.compatible_with.matches(&metadata.app.version)
001226 |             })
001227 |         {
001228 |             return Err("components_incompatible");
001229 |         }
001230 |         let recovery = self.recovery_pkg(metadata.edition);
001231 |         if prepared.helper_path().is_some() {
001232 |             if !recovery.is_file() {
001233 |                 return Err("wait_update_recovery_pkg");
001234 |             }
001235 |             SignedPkgBackend::verify_package(&recovery, &installed_team)?;
001236 |         }
001237 |         let mut pkg = prepared
001238 |             .helper_path()
001239 |             .map(|p| {
001240 |                 SignedPkgBackend::new(
001241 |                     p.to_owned(),
001242 |                     recovery.clone(),
001243 |                     installed_team.clone(),
001244 |                     self.root.clone(),
001245 |                 )
001246 |             })
001247 |             .transpose()?;
001248 |         // Authorize before changing the update stage or touching the old healthy App.
001249 |         if let Some(pkg) = &mut pkg {
001250 |             pkg.authorize()?;
001251 |         } else {
001252 |             run_administrator(":")?;
001253 |         }
001254 |         verify_app_version(
001255 |             prepared.app_path(),
001256 |             &installed_team,
001257 |             &metadata.app.bundle_id,
001258 |             &metadata.app.version.to_string(),
001259 |         )?;
001260 |         let now = self.fresh_gate(metadata, uid)?;
001261 |         let mut stage = prepared.begin(
001262 |             state,
001263 |             InstallReadiness {
001264 |                 clock_trusted: self.clock.trusted(),
001265 |                 claude_exited: true,
001266 |                 account_idle: true,
001267 |                 components_compatible: true,
001268 |                 now,
001269 |             },
001270 |         )?;
001271 |         let mut journal = UpdateTransaction {
001272 |             schema: 1,
001273 |             edition: metadata.edition,
001274 |             team: installed_team.clone(),
001275 |             old_app,
001276 |             old_helper: installed.helper_version.clone(),
001277 |             app: metadata.version.to_string(),
001278 |             helper_changed: pkg.is_some(),
001279 |             helper_pending: false,
001280 |             app_pending: false,
001281 |             committed: false,
001282 |             updates: state.clone(),
001283 |         };
001284 |         self.save(&journal)?;
001285 |         let result = (|| {
001286 |             loop {
001287 |                 self.fresh_gate(metadata, uid)?;
001288 |                 match stage {
001289 |                     UStage::InstallingHelper => {
001290 |                         journal.helper_pending = true;
001291 |                         self.save(&journal)?;
001292 |                         let package = pkg.as_mut().ok_or("update_helper_missing")?;
001293 |                         package.window = Some(update_window(metadata)?);
001294 |                         package.expected_hash = metadata.helper.as_ref().map(|h| h.sha256.clone());
001295 |                         package.install_package(
001296 |                             prepared.helper_path().ok_or("update_helper_missing")?,
001297 |                         )?;
001298 |                         let next = if prepared.candidate().install_order()
001299 |                             == InstallOrder::HelperThenApp
001300 |                         {
001301 |                             UStage::InstallingApp
001302 |                         } else {
001303 |                             UStage::AwaitingHealth
001304 |                         };
001305 |                         state.advance_install(stage, next)?;
001306 |                         stage = next;
001307 |                     }
001308 |                     UStage::InstallingApp => {
001309 |                         journal.app_pending = true;
001310 |                         self.save(&journal)?;
001311 |                         run_root_operation(
001312 |                             &switcher_helper::root_operation::RootOperation::ReplaceApp {
001313 |                                 source: prepared.app_path().to_owned(),
001314 |                                 cdhash: prepared.app_cdhash().to_owned(),
001315 |                                 edition: journal.edition,
001316 |                                 team: journal.team.clone(),
001317 |                                 old: journal.old_app.clone(),
001318 |                                 new: journal.app.clone(),
001319 |                                 window: update_window(metadata)?,
001320 |                             },
001321 |                             &journal.team,
001322 |                         )?;
001323 |                         let next = if prepared.candidate().install_order()
001324 |                             == InstallOrder::AppThenHelper
001325 |                         {
001326 |                             UStage::InstallingHelper
001327 |                         } else {
001328 |                             UStage::AwaitingHealth
001329 |                         };
001330 |                         state.advance_install(stage, next)?;
001331 |                         stage = next;
001332 |                     }
001333 |                     UStage::AwaitingHealth => break,
001334 |                     _ => return Err("update_install_stage"),
001335 |                 }
001336 |                 journal.updates = state.clone();
001337 |                 self.save(&journal)?;
001338 |             }
001339 |             let healthy = wait_installed(metadata.edition, uid)?;
001340 |             if healthy.helper_version != final_helper.to_string() {
001341 |                 return Err("updated_helper_version");
001342 |             }
001343 |             verify_app_version(
001344 |                 &app,
001345 |                 &installed_team,
001346 |                 &metadata.app.bundle_id,
001347 |                 &metadata.version.to_string(),
001348 |             )?;
001349 |             if let Some(pkg) = &mut pkg {
001350 |                 let installer = Installer::new(self.root.clone())?;
001351 |                 let preview = installer.preview(
001352 |                     uid,
001353 |                     metadata.edition,
001354 |                     Some(metadata.edition),
001355 |                     InstallIntent::Install,
001356 |                 )?;
001357 |                 pkg.commit_root_record(&preview)?;
001358 |             }
001359 |             state.advance_install(UStage::AwaitingHealth, UStage::Healthy)?;
001360 |             journal.updates = state.clone();
001361 |             journal.committed = true;
001362 |             self.save(&journal)
001363 |         })();
001364 |         if let Err(reason) = result {
001365 |             state.record_failure(prepared.candidate(), reason, now)?;
001366 |             journal.updates = state.clone();
001367 |             self.save(&journal)?;
001368 |             // The rollback is real, not a state-only success. Failure leaves the journal pending.
001369 |             let _ = self.recover(state);
001370 |             return Err(reason);
001371 |         }
001372 |         Ok(())
001373 |     }
001374 | }
001375 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
001376 | fn wait_installed(
001377 |     edition: Edition,
001378 |     uid: u32,
001379 | ) -> Result<switcher_domain::system::InstallRecord, &'static str> {
001380 |     let deadline = std::time::Instant::now() + std::time::Duration::from_secs(10);
001381 |     loop {
001382 |         match validate_installed(edition, uid) {
001383 |             Ok(record) => return Ok(record),
001384 |             Err(reason) if std::time::Instant::now() >= deadline => return Err(reason),
001385 |             Err(_) => std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(250)),
001386 |         }
001387 |     }
001388 | }

001397 | fn app_version(path: &Path) -> Result<String, &'static str> {
001398 |     let output = std::process::Command::new("/usr/bin/plutil")
001399 |         .args(["-extract", "CFBundleShortVersionString", "raw", "-o", "-"])
001400 |         .arg(path.join("Contents/Info.plist"))
001401 |         .output()
001402 |         .map_err(|_| "app_version_read")?;
001403 |     if !output.status.success() {
001404 |         return Err("app_version_read");
001405 |     }
001406 |     let version = String::from_utf8(output.stdout)
001407 |         .map_err(|_| "app_version_read")?
001408 |         .trim()
001409 |         .to_owned();
001410 |     semver::Version::parse(&version).map_err(|_| "app_version_invalid")?;
001411 |     Ok(version)
001412 | }

000023 | fn load_context(edition: Option<Edition>) -> Result<InstallHealthChallenge, &'static str> {
000024 |     use std::path::Path;
000025 |     use switcher_domain::system::INSTALL_RECORD;
000026 |     let record = switcher_helper::platform::load_root_record(Path::new(INSTALL_RECORD))?;
000027 |     let challenge = switcher_helper::installation_health::load_challenge()?;
000028 |     let boot = switcher_helper::installation_health::boot_session_uuid()?;
000029 |     validate_context(
000030 |         &challenge,
000031 |         &record,
000032 |         edition.unwrap_or(record.edition),
000033 |         unsafe { libc::geteuid() },
000034 |         &boot,
000035 |         crate::checks::unix_now(),
000036 |     )?;
000037 |     Ok(challenge)

000041 | fn report(
000042 |     challenge: InstallHealthChallenge,
000043 |     role: switcher_domain::system::ClientRole,
000044 |     loop_sequence: u64,
000045 | ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000046 |     use switcher_domain::system::HelperAction;
000047 |     // connect performs the real BeginSession on this authenticated connection.
000048 |     let mut client = switcher_helper::xpc::NativeClient::connect(&challenge.record, role)?;
000049 |     let response = client.call(HelperAction::InstallationHealth {
000050 |         generation: challenge.generation,

000061 | /// A fixed GUI-role probe. stdout from the caller is diagnostic, never a commit receipt.
000062 | pub fn gui_probe(edition: Edition, generation: &str, nonce: &str) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000063 |     #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000064 |     {
000065 |         let challenge = load_context(Some(edition))?;
000066 |         if challenge.generation != generation || challenge.nonce != nonce {
000067 |             return Err("installation_health_challenge_mismatch");
000068 |         }
000069 |         report(challenge, switcher_domain::system::ClientRole::Gui, 0)
000070 |     }
000071 |     #[cfg(not(target_os = "macos"))]
000072 |     {
000073 |         let _ = (edition, generation, nonce);
000074 |         Err("macos_required")
000075 |     }
000076 | }

000078 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000079 | fn guardian_challenge(loop_sequence: u64) -> Result<InstallHealthChallenge, &'static str> {
000080 |     use std::{os::unix::fs::MetadataExt, path::Path};
000081 |     use switcher_domain::system::SOURCE_LOCAL_TRANSACTION;
000082 |     if loop_sequence == 0 {
000083 |         return Err("installation_health_loop_sequence");
000084 |     }
000085 |     let pending = std::fs::symlink_metadata(Path::new(SOURCE_LOCAL_TRANSACTION))
000086 |         .map_err(|_| "installation_health_not_pending")?;
000087 |     if !pending.is_file()
000088 |         || pending.uid() != 0
000089 |         || pending.mode() & 0o7777 != 0o600
000090 |         || pending.nlink() != 1
000091 |     {
000092 |         return Err("installation_health_pending_permissions");
000093 |     }
000094 |     load_context(None)
000095 | }

000097 | /// A fixed Guardian-role probe. Only the driver's actual timer tick supplies this sequence.
000098 | pub fn guardian_tick(loop_sequence: u64) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000099 |     if loop_sequence == 0 {
000100 |         return Err("installation_health_loop_sequence");
000101 |     }
000102 |     #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000103 |     {
000104 |         report(
000105 |             guardian_challenge(loop_sequence)?,
000106 |             switcher_domain::system::ClientRole::Guardian,
000107 |             loop_sequence,
000108 |         )
000109 |     }
000110 |     #[cfg(not(target_os = "macos"))]
000111 |     Err("macos_required")
000112 | }

000114 | /// At most one bounded XPC call may be in flight. A slow helper cannot block protection ticks.
000115 | #[derive(Default)]
000116 | pub(crate) struct GuardianProbe {
000117 |     flight: Option<tokio::task::JoinHandle<()>>,
000118 |     next_attempt: Option<std::time::Instant>,
000119 | }
000120 | impl GuardianProbe {
000121 |     pub(crate) fn tick(&mut self, sequence: u64) {
000122 |         self.tick_at(sequence, std::time::Instant::now(), move |sequence| {
000123 |             #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000124 |             {
000125 |                 // A successful response only acknowledges one role. Keep reporting while
000126 |                 // pending, so a restarted helper can collect both roles again.
000127 |                 let _ = guardian_tick(sequence);
000128 |             }
000129 |             #[cfg(not(target_os = "macos"))]
000130 |             let _ = sequence;
000131 |         });
000132 |     }
000133 |     fn tick_at<F>(&mut self, sequence: u64, now: std::time::Instant, report: F)
000134 |     where
000135 |         F: FnOnce(u64) + Send + 'static,
000136 |     {
000137 |         if self.next_attempt.is_some_and(|next| now < next) {
000138 |             return;
000139 |         }
000140 |         self.next_attempt = Some(now + std::time::Duration::from_secs(10));
000141 |         self.tick_with(sequence, report);
000142 |     }
000143 |     fn tick_with<F>(&mut self, sequence: u64, report: F)
000144 |     where
000145 |         F: FnOnce(u64) + Send + 'static,
000146 |     {
000147 |         if self
000148 |             .flight
000149 |             .as_ref()
000150 |             .is_some_and(|flight| !flight.is_finished())
000151 |         {
000152 |             return;
000153 |         }
000154 |         self.flight = Some(tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || report(sequence)));
000155 |     }
000156 | }

000036 |     fn installed(&self, edition: Edition) -> Result<PathBuf, &'static str>;
000037 |     fn lock(&self, home: &Path) -> Result<Self::Lock, &'static str>;

000044 | struct NativeLaunch;
000045 | impl LaunchEnvironment for NativeLaunch {
000046 |     type Lock = LifecycleLock;
000047 |     fn installed(&self, _edition: Edition) -> Result<PathBuf, &'static str> {
000048 |         crate::migration::account_home(unsafe { libc::geteuid() }).map_err(|_| "用户目录无法读取")
000049 |     }
000050 |     fn lock(&self, home: &Path) -> Result<Self::Lock, &'static str> {
000051 |         for directory in [
000052 |             home.join(".claude-switcher"),
000053 |             home.join(".claude-switcher/v2"),
000054 |         ] {
000055 |             if !directory.exists() {
000056 |                 crate::storage::create_private_directory(&directory)
000057 |                     .map_err(|_| "无法创建账号锁目录")?;
000058 |             }
000059 |         }
000060 |         LifecycleLock::try_acquire(&home.join(".claude-switcher/v2"))
000061 |             .map_err(|_| "生命周期锁被占用或目录身份无效")
000062 |     }
000063 |     fn account_ready(&self, home: &Path, lock: &Self::Lock) -> Result<AccountId, &'static str> {
000064 |         let root = home.join(".claude-switcher");
000065 |         if !lock.protects(&root.join("v2")) {
000066 |             return Err("生命周期锁身份已变化");
000067 |         }
000068 |         let active = home.join("Library/Application Support/Claude");
000069 |         let status = AccountStore::inspect(&root, &active, unsafe { libc::geteuid() })
000070 |             .map_err(|_| "账号状态无法验证")?;
000071 |         if status.recovery_pending {
000072 |             return Err("账号事务尚未恢复完成");
000073 |         }
000074 |         Ok(status.current.unwrap_or(AccountId::A))
000075 |     }
000076 |     async fn check(&self, home: &Path) -> Result<CheckReport, &'static str> {
000077 |         let configuration = config::load_read_only(home).map_err(|_| "地区目标配置无效")?;
000078 |         Ok(checks::run_checks(configuration).await)
000079 |     }
000080 |     fn now(&self) -> u64 {
000081 |         checks::unix_now()
000082 |     }
000083 |     async fn select(&self, edition: Edition, target: AccountId) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000084 |         tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
000085 |             let coordinator = crate::migration::MigrationCoordinator::for_current_user(edition)
000086 |                 .map_err(|_| "账号目录不可用")?;
000087 |             match target {
000088 |                 AccountId::A => coordinator.select_a(),
000089 |                 AccountId::B => coordinator.select_b(),
000090 |             }
000091 |             .map_err(|_| "Claude 未能退出或账号事务未完成；资料已保留")
000092 |         })
000093 |         .await
000094 |         .map_err(|_| "账号切换任务中断")?
000095 |     }
000096 |     async fn open(&self) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000097 |         // The application and executable selectors are fixed. No shell, URL, or caller path.
000098 |         bounded_status("/usr/bin/open", &["-a", "Claude"], Duration::from_secs(5)).await
000099 |     }
000100 | }

000117 | async fn switch_with<E: LaunchEnvironment>(
000118 |     environment: &E,
000119 |     edition: Edition,
000120 |     target: AccountId,
000121 | ) -> LaunchOutcome {
000122 |     let home = match environment.installed(edition) {
000123 |         Ok(home) => home,
000124 |         Err(message) => return blocked(None, message, "检查用户目录后重试"),
000125 |     };
000126 |     let mut report = match environment.check(&home).await {
000127 |         Ok(report) => report,
000128 |         Err(message) => return blocked(None, message, "修复地区配置后重试"),
000129 |     };
000130 |     report.launch = checks::evaluate_launch(&report, environment.now(), &report.network_generation);
000131 |     if !report.launch.allowed {
000132 |         return blocked(
000133 |             Some(report),
000134 |             "环境检查未通过，尚未切换账号",
000135 |             "修复阻塞项后重试",
000136 |         );
000137 |     }
000138 |     if let Err(message) = environment.select(edition, target).await {
000139 |         return blocked(
000140 |             Some(report),
000141 |             message,
000142 |             "退出 Claude 后重试；未完成事务会自动恢复",
000143 |         );
000144 |     }

000147 | fn verify_account<E: LaunchEnvironment>(
000148 |     environment: &E,
000149 |     home: &Path,
000150 |     lock: &E::Lock,
000151 |     expected: Option<AccountId>,
000152 | ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {

000154 |     if expected.is_some_and(|account| account != current) {

000159 | async fn launch_expected_with<E: LaunchEnvironment>(
000160 |     environment: &E,
000161 |     edition: Edition,
000162 |     expected: Option<AccountId>,
000163 | ) -> LaunchOutcome {
000164 |     let home = match environment.installed(edition) {
000165 |         Ok(home) => home,
000166 |         Err(_) => {
000167 |             return blocked(None, "无法读取当前用户目录", "检查当前用户目录后重试");
000168 |         }
000169 |     };
000170 |     let lock = match environment.lock(&home) {
000171 |         Ok(lock) => lock,
000172 |         Err(message) => return blocked(None, message, "等待账号、安装或更新事务完成后重试"),
000173 |     };
000174 |     if let Err(message) = verify_account(environment, &home, &lock, expected) {
000175 |         return blocked(None, message, "等待账号事务完成后重试");
000176 |     }
000177 |     let mut report = match environment.check(&home).await {
000178 |         Ok(report) => report,
000179 |         Err(message) => return blocked(None, message, "修复地区配置后重新执行完整检查"),
000180 |     };
000181 |     let generation = report.network_generation.clone();
000182 |     report.launch = checks::evaluate_launch(&report, environment.now(), &generation);
000183 |     if !report.launch.allowed {
000184 |         return blocked(
000185 |             Some(report),
000186 |             "环境检查未授予启动许可",
000187 |             "修复阻塞项后重新执行完整检查",
000188 |         );
000189 |     }
000190 |     if expected.is_some()
000191 |         && let Err(message) = verify_account(environment, &home, &lock, expected)
000192 |     {
000193 |         return blocked(
000194 |             Some(report),
000195 |             message,
000196 |             "重新选择目标账号，再执行完整检查与启动",
000197 |         );
000198 |     }
000199 |     match environment.open().await {
000200 |         Ok(()) => LaunchOutcome {
000201 |             report: Some(report),
000202 |             outcome: outcome(true, "已向系统提交 Claude 启动请求", None),
000203 |         },
000204 |         Err(_) => blocked(
000205 |             Some(report),
000206 |             "系统启动请求失败或超时",
000207 |             "检查 Claude 应用与系统响应，再执行完整检查",
000208 |         ),
000209 |     }
000210 | }

000233 | async fn bounded_status(
000234 |     program: &str,
000235 |     arguments: &[&str],
000236 |     timeout: Duration,
000237 | ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000238 |     let mut child = tokio::process::Command::new(program)
000239 |         .args(arguments)
000240 |         .env_clear()
000241 |         .env("PATH", "/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin")
000242 |         .env("LC_ALL", "C")
000243 |         .stdin(Stdio::null())
000244 |         .stdout(Stdio::null())
000245 |         .stderr(Stdio::null())
000246 |         .kill_on_drop(true)
000247 |         .spawn()
000248 |         .map_err(|_| "固定系统命令无法执行")?;
000249 |     match tokio::time::timeout(timeout, child.wait()).await {
000250 |         Ok(Ok(status)) if status.success() => Ok(()),
000251 |         _ => {
000252 |             let _ = child.kill().await;
000253 |             let _ = child.wait().await;
000254 |             Err("固定系统命令失败或超时")
000255 |         }
000256 |     }

000008 | struct Generation {
000009 |     fingerprint: Option<String>,
000010 |     revision: u64,
000011 | }
000012 | impl Generation {
000013 |     fn observe(
000014 |         &mut self,
000015 |         fingerprint: String,
000016 |         expected_revision: u64,
000017 |     ) -> Result<String, &'static str> {
000018 |         if self.revision != expected_revision {
000019 |             return Err("network_changed_during_observation");
000020 |         }
000021 |         if self
000022 |             .fingerprint
000023 |             .as_ref()
000024 |             .is_some_and(|previous| previous != &fingerprint)
000025 |         {
000026 |             self.revision = self.revision.saturating_add(1);
000027 |         }
000028 |         self.fingerprint = Some(fingerprint.clone());
000029 |         Ok(format!("{}:{fingerprint}", self.revision))
000030 |     }
000031 | }

000033 |     fingerprint: None,
000034 |     revision: 0,
000035 | });

000044 | /// A process keeps its registration and receiver for its entire lifetime. A failed
000045 | /// registration is sticky: evidence must never outlive the observer that protects it.
000046 | struct ProcessObserver<T> {
000047 |     registration: std::sync::OnceLock<Result<T, &'static str>>,
000048 | }
000049 | impl<T> ProcessObserver<T> {
000050 |     const fn new() -> Self {
000051 |         Self {
000052 |             registration: std::sync::OnceLock::new(),
000053 |         }
000054 |     }
000055 |     fn ensure(
000056 |         &self,
000057 |         register: impl FnOnce() -> Result<T, &'static str>,
000058 |         healthy: impl FnOnce(&T) -> bool,
000059 |     ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000060 |         let registration = self
000061 |             .registration
000062 |             .get_or_init(register)
000063 |             .as_ref()
000064 |             .map_err(|e| *e)?;
000065 |         if !healthy(registration) {
000066 |             return Err("network_observer_stopped");
000067 |         }
000068 |         Ok(())
000069 |     }
000070 | }
