000079 | /// Synchronously install both native subscriptions before collecting any evidence.
000080 | /// Reuse one observer rather than starting threads for individual checks or launches.
000081 | pub(crate) fn ensure_network_observation() -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000082 |     #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000083 |     {
000084 |         NETWORK_OBSERVER.ensure(
000085 |             || {
000086 |                 let (native, receiver) = crate::guardian::native_events()?;
000087 |                 Ok(NetworkObserver {
000088 |                     native,
000089 |                     receiver: Mutex::new(receiver),
000090 |                 })
000091 |             },
000092 |             |observer| {
000093 |                 observer.native.is_running()
000094 |                     && observer
000095 |                         .receiver
000096 |                         .lock()
000097 |                         .is_ok_and(|receiver| !receiver.is_closed())
000098 |             },
000099 |         )
000100 |     }
000101 |     #[cfg(not(target_os = "macos"))]

000103 |         Err("platform_unsupported")

000174 | /// Opaque network generation. Interface, route and resolver changes invalidate old evidence.
000175 | pub async fn network_generation() -> Result<String, &'static str> {
000176 |     ensure_network_observation()?;
000177 |     let revision = NETWORK_GENERATION
000178 |         .lock()
000179 |         .map_err(|_| "network_generation_unavailable")?
000180 |         .revision;
000181 |     let (interfaces, route, dns) = tokio::join!(
000182 |         read_command("/usr/sbin/scutil", &["--nwi"]),
000183 |         read_command("/sbin/route", &["-n", "get", "1.1.1.1"]),
000184 |         read_command("/usr/sbin/scutil", &["--dns"])
000185 |     );
000186 |     let mut hash = Sha256::new();
000187 |     for value in [interfaces?, route?, dns?] {
000188 |         hash.update(value.as_bytes());
000189 |         hash.update([0]);
000190 |     }
000191 |     let fingerprint = hash.finalize().iter().map(|b| format!("{b:02x}")).collect();
000192 |     ensure_network_observation()?;
000193 |     NETWORK_GENERATION
000194 |         .lock()
000195 |         .map_err(|_| "network_generation_unavailable")?
000196 |         .observe(fingerprint, revision)
000197 | }

000376 | /// Isolated subscription backend. Events go only to registered process states;
000377 | /// sampling the same route never invents an event or registers a listener.
000378 | #[cfg(test)]
000379 | pub(crate) mod test_observer {
000380 |     use super::ProcessObserver;
000381 |     use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, AtomicU64, AtomicUsize, Ordering};
000382 |     pub(crate) struct Observer {
000383 |         process: ProcessObserver<AtomicU64>,
000384 |         failed: bool,
000385 |         alive: AtomicBool,
000386 |         registrations: AtomicUsize,
000387 |     }
000388 |     impl Observer {
000389 |         pub(crate) fn new(failed: bool) -> Self {
000390 |             Self {
000391 |                 process: ProcessObserver::new(),
000392 |                 failed,
000393 |                 alive: AtomicBool::new(true),
000394 |                 registrations: AtomicUsize::new(0),
000395 |             }
000396 |         }
000397 |         pub(crate) fn ensure(&self) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000398 |             self.process.ensure(
000399 |                 || {
000400 |                     self.registrations.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
000401 |                     if self.failed {
000402 |                         Err("network_events_unavailable")
000403 |                     } else {
000404 |                         Ok(AtomicU64::new(0))
000405 |                     }
000406 |                 },
000407 |                 |_| self.alive.load(Ordering::SeqCst),
000408 |             )
000409 |         }
000410 |         pub(crate) fn generation(&self) -> Result<String, &'static str> {
000411 |             if !self.alive.load(Ordering::SeqCst) {
000412 |                 return Err("network_observer_stopped");
000413 |             }
000414 |             let epoch = self
000415 |                 .process
000416 |                 .registration
000417 |                 .get()
000418 |                 .and_then(|r| r.as_ref().ok())
000419 |                 .map_or(0, |s| s.load(Ordering::SeqCst));
000420 |             Ok(if epoch == 0 {
000421 |                 "generation".into()
000422 |             } else {
000423 |                 format!("{epoch}:route-a")
000424 |             })
000425 |         }
000426 |         pub(crate) fn emit(&self, event: crate::guardian::ProtectionEvent) {
000427 |             if event != crate::guardian::ProtectionEvent::Timer
000428 |                 && let Some(Ok(epoch)) = self.process.registration.get()
000429 |             {
000430 |                 // ABA returns to route A without changing the sampled fingerprint.
000431 |                 epoch.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
000432 |             }
000433 |         }
000434 |         pub(crate) fn stop(&self) {
000435 |             self.alive.store(false, Ordering::SeqCst);
000436 |         }
000437 |         pub(crate) fn registrations(&self) -> usize {
000438 |             self.registrations.load(Ordering::SeqCst)
000439 |         }
000440 |     }
000441 |     #[test]
000442 |     fn network_epoch_guardian_event_does_not_invalidate_unregistered_frontend() {
000443 |         let guardian = Observer::new(false);
000444 |         let frontend = Observer::new(false);
000445 |         guardian.ensure().unwrap();
000446 |         let old = frontend.generation().unwrap();
000447 |         guardian.emit(crate::guardian::ProtectionEvent::NetworkChanged);
000448 |         guardian.emit(crate::guardian::ProtectionEvent::Wake);
000449 |         assert_ne!(guardian.generation().unwrap(), old);
000450 |         assert_eq!(frontend.generation().unwrap(), old);
000451 |         assert_eq!(frontend.registrations(), 0);
000452 |     }
000453 |     #[test]
000454 |     fn network_epoch_registration_is_reused_and_failure_is_sticky() {
000455 |         for failure in [false, true] {
000456 |             let observer = Observer::new(failure);
000457 |             for _ in 0..3 {
000458 |                 assert_eq!(observer.ensure().is_err(), failure);
000459 |             }
000460 |             assert_eq!(observer.registrations(), 1);
000461 |             observer.stop();
000462 |             assert!(observer.ensure().is_err());
000463 |             assert!(observer.generation().is_err());
000464 |         }
000465 |     }

000230 |     fn recover_in_place(&self, store: &AccountStore, lock: &LifecycleLock) -> Result<()> {
000231 |         let path = self.root.join("v2/migration/in-place-journal.json");
000232 |         #[derive(Deserialize)]
000233 |         struct PreviousJournal {
000234 |             intent: MigrationIntent,
000235 |             initialization_copy: Option<InitializationCopy>,
000236 |         }
000237 |         let journal: PreviousJournal = match storage::read_json(&path) {
000238 |             Ok(journal) => journal,
000239 |             Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok(()),
000240 |             Err(_) => {
000241 |                 return Err(MigrationError::Operation(
000242 |                     "旧账号事务记录无法读取，已保留资料",
000243 |                 ));
000244 |             }
000245 |         };
000246 |         if !matches!(
000247 |             journal.intent,
000248 |             MigrationIntent::InitializeA | MigrationIntent::AssociateA
000249 |         ) {
000250 |             return Err(MigrationError::Operation("旧账号事务类型不明，已保留资料"));
000251 |         }
000252 |         if let Some(copy) = journal.initialization_copy {
000253 |             store
000254 |                 .finish_initialization(
000255 |                     lock,
000256 |                     &copy,
000257 |                     &|| self.environment.stopped(self.owner),
000258 |                     &mut |_| Ok(()),
000259 |                 )
000260 |                 .map_err(|_| MigrationError::Operation("旧账号 A 存档事务恢复失败，已保留资料"))?;
000261 |         }
000262 |         // In-place journals never exchange the live directory. Retire the old permit after copy completion.
000263 |         fs::remove_file(&path).map_err(|_| MigrationError::Operation("旧事务记录无法收尾"))?;

000265 |             .map_err(|_| MigrationError::Operation("旧事务记录无法同步"))
000266 |     }

000273 | pub(crate) fn account_home(owner: u32) -> io::Result<PathBuf> {
000274 |     let mut record = std::mem::MaybeUninit::<libc::passwd>::uninit();
000275 |     let mut result = std::ptr::null_mut();
000276 |     let mut buffer = vec![0u8; 65536];
000277 |     let status = unsafe {
000278 |         libc::getpwuid_r(
000279 |             owner,
000280 |             record.as_mut_ptr(),
000281 |             buffer.as_mut_ptr().cast(),
000282 |             buffer.len(),
000283 |             &mut result,
000284 |         )
000285 |     };
000286 |     if status != 0 || result.is_null() {
000287 |         return Err(io::Error::other("system home lookup failed"));
000288 |     }
000289 |     let record = unsafe { record.assume_init() };
000290 |     if record.pw_dir.is_null() {
000291 |         return Err(io::Error::other("system home missing"));
000292 |     }
000293 |     use std::os::unix::ffi::OsStrExt;
000294 |     let home = PathBuf::from(std::ffi::OsStr::from_bytes(
000295 |         unsafe { std::ffi::CStr::from_ptr(record.pw_dir) }.to_bytes(),
000296 |     ));
000297 |     storage::validate_no_symlinks(&home)?;
000298 |     Ok(home)
000299 | }

000073 | pub async fn limited_get(
000074 |     client: &Client,
000075 |     url: &str,
000076 |     limit: usize,
000077 | ) -> Result<Vec<u8>, TransportState> {
000078 |     #[cfg(test)]
000079 |     let test_url = test_support::endpoint(url);
000080 |     #[cfg(test)]
000081 |     let url = test_url.as_deref().unwrap_or(url);
000082 |     let mut response = client
000083 |         .get(url)
000084 |         .send()
000085 |         .await
000086 |         .map_err(|e| classify_error(&e))?;
000087 |     if !response.status().is_success() {
000088 |         return Err(TransportState::InvalidResponse);
000089 |     }
000090 |     if response.content_length().is_some_and(|v| v > limit as u64) {
000091 |         return Err(TransportState::InvalidResponse);
000092 |     }
000093 |     let mut body = Vec::new();
000094 |     while let Some(chunk) = response.chunk().await.map_err(|e| classify_error(&e))? {
000095 |         if chunk.len() > limit.saturating_sub(body.len()) {
000096 |             return Err(TransportState::InvalidResponse);
000097 |         }
000098 |         body.extend_from_slice(&chunk);
000099 |     }
000100 |     Ok(body)
000101 | }

000103 | pub fn access_state(status: u16) -> AccessState {
000104 |     match status {
000105 |         401 => AccessState::AuthenticationRequired,
000106 |         403 | 407 => AccessState::Restricted,
000107 |         300..=399 => AccessState::Redirected,
000108 |         500..=599 => AccessState::ServerError,
000109 |         100..=499 => AccessState::Available,
000110 |         _ => AccessState::Unknown,
000111 |     }
000112 | }
000113 | 
000114 | pub fn classify_error(error: &reqwest::Error) -> TransportState {
000115 |     if error.is_timeout() {
000116 |         return TransportState::Timeout;
000117 |     }
000118 |     if error.is_dns() {
000119 |         return TransportState::DnsFailure;
000120 |     }
000121 |     let mut chain = String::new();
000122 |     let mut current: Option<&(dyn Error + 'static)> = Some(error);
000123 |     while let Some(e) = current {
000124 |         chain.push_str(&e.to_string().to_ascii_lowercase());
000125 |         current = e.source();
000126 |     }
000127 |     // Error detail stays in memory. Reports only expose the fixed enum.
000128 |     if chain.contains("could not resolve to acceptable address type") {
000129 |         TransportState::DnsFailure
000130 |     } else if chain.contains("407")
000131 |         || chain.contains("proxy authentication")
000132 |         || chain.contains("proxy authorization required")
000133 |         || chain.contains("credentials not accepted")
000134 |         || chain.contains("user/pass authentication")
000135 |         || chain.contains("server implements authentication incorrectly")
000136 |     {
000137 |         TransportState::ProxyAuthentication
000138 |     } else if ["certificate", "tls", "ssl", "certnotvalid", "unknownissuer"]
000139 |         .iter()
000140 |         .any(|s| chain.contains(s))
000141 |     {
000142 |         TransportState::TlsFailure
000143 |     } else if error.is_connect() {
000144 |         TransportState::ConnectFailure
000145 |     } else {
000146 |         TransportState::InvalidResponse
000147 |     }
000148 | }

000150 | pub async fn transport_probe(client: &Client, name: &str, url: &str) -> TransportProbe {
000151 |     let start = Instant::now();
000152 |     let mut result = TransportProbe {
000153 |         endpoint: name.into(),
000154 |         transport: TransportState::InvalidResponse,
000155 |         access: AccessState::Unknown,
000156 |         http_status: None,
000157 |         tls_verified: false,
000158 |         duration_ms: 0,
000159 |     };
000160 |     match client.get(url).send().await {
000161 |         Ok(response) => {
000162 |             let status = response.status().as_u16();
000163 |             result.http_status = Some(status);
000164 |             if status == 407 {
000165 |                 result.transport = TransportState::ProxyAuthentication;
000166 |             } else if url.starts_with("https://") {
000167 |                 result.transport = TransportState::Reached;
000168 |                 result.tls_verified = true;
000169 |                 result.access = access_state(status);
000170 |             }
000171 |         }
000172 |         Err(error) => result.transport = classify_error(&error),
000173 |     }
000174 |     result.duration_ms = start.elapsed().as_millis().min(u64::MAX as u128) as u64;
000175 |     result
000176 | }

000186 | pub fn parse_geo(bytes: &[u8]) -> Option<GeoInfo> {
000187 |     let data: Value = serde_json::from_slice(bytes).ok()?;
000188 |     if data.get("success") == Some(&Value::Bool(false)) {
000189 |         return None;
000190 |     }
000191 |     let country = data
000192 |         .get("country_code")
000193 |         .or_else(|| data.get("country"))?
000194 |         .as_str()?;
000195 |     if country.len() != 2 || !country.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_uppercase()) {
000196 |         return None;
000197 |     }
000198 |     let timezone = data
000199 |         .get("timezone")
000200 |         .and_then(|v| v.as_str().or_else(|| v.get("id")?.as_str()))
000201 |         .map(str::to_owned);
000202 |     let ip = data.get("ip")?.as_str()?.parse().ok()?;
000203 |     let organization = data
000204 |         .get("org")
000205 |         .or_else(|| data.get("organization"))
000206 |         .or_else(|| data.get("connection").and_then(|v| v.get("org")))
000207 |         .and_then(Value::as_str)
000208 |         .filter(|s| s.len() <= 256)
000209 |         .map(str::to_owned);
000210 |     Some(GeoInfo {
000211 |         ip: Some(ip),
000212 |         country: Some(country.into()),
000213 |         timezone,
000214 |         organization,
000215 |     })
000216 | }

000218 | /// Obtain the egress identity without waiting for advisory ASN enrichment.
000219 | pub(crate) async fn lookup_egress(client: &Client) -> GeoInfo {
000220 |     let mut info = GeoInfo::default();
000221 |     // Cloudflare supplies the egress decision; the remaining sources are bounded fallbacks.
000222 |     if let Ok(bytes) = limited_get(client, "https://www.cloudflare.com/cdn-cgi/trace", 8192).await
000223 |         && let Ok(text) = std::str::from_utf8(&bytes)
000224 |     {
000225 |         for line in text.lines() {
000226 |             if let Some(ip) = line.strip_prefix("ip=") {
000227 |                 info.ip = ip.parse().ok();
000228 |             }
000229 |             if let Some(country) = line.strip_prefix("loc=")
000230 |                 && country.len() == 2
000231 |                 && country.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_uppercase())
000232 |             {
000233 |                 info.country = Some(country.into());
000234 |             }
000235 |         }
000236 |     }
000237 |     if info.ip.is_some() {
000238 |         return info;
000239 |     }
000240 |     // A country without its source IP cannot be attached to another source's identity.
000241 |     lookup_geo_details(client, GeoInfo::default()).await
000242 | }
000243 | 
000244 | /// Enrich only the same observed egress. Existing fields retain their source's precedence.
000245 | pub(crate) async fn lookup_geo_details(client: &Client, mut info: GeoInfo) -> GeoInfo {
000246 |     if info.country.is_some() && info.timezone.is_some() && info.organization.is_some() {
000247 |         return info;
000248 |     }
000249 |     for endpoint in GEO_ENDPOINTS {
000250 |         if let Ok(bytes) = limited_get(client, endpoint, MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES).await
000251 |             && let Some(fallback) = parse_geo(&bytes)
000252 |         {
000253 |             // Do not attach ASN/timezone from a different egress address.
000254 |             if info.ip.is_some() && info.ip != fallback.ip {
000255 |                 continue;
000256 |             }
000257 |             info.ip = info.ip.or(fallback.ip);
000258 |             info.country = info.country.or(fallback.country);
000259 |             info.timezone = info.timezone.or(fallback.timezone);
000260 |             info.organization = info.organization.or(fallback.organization);
000261 |             break;
000262 |         }
000263 |     }
000264 |     info
000265 | }
000266 | 
000267 | /// Complete geo lookup retained for callers that need region and advisory information.
000268 | pub async fn lookup_geo(client: &Client) -> GeoInfo {
000269 |     lookup_geo_details(client, lookup_egress(client).await).await
000270 | }

000273 | pub enum StunError {
000274 |     Timeout,
000275 |     Dns,
000276 |     Io,
000277 |     WrongSource,
000278 |     Header,
000279 |     Transaction,
000280 |     Length,
000281 |     AddressFamily,

000285 | pub fn parse_stun(
000286 |     bytes: &[u8],
000287 |     transaction: &[u8; 12],
000288 |     expected: SocketAddr,
000289 |     source: SocketAddr,
000290 | ) -> Result<IpAddr, StunError> {
000291 |     if expected != source {
000292 |         return Err(StunError::WrongSource);
000293 |     }
000294 |     if bytes.len() < 20 || bytes[0..2] != [1, 1] || bytes[4..8] != [0x21, 0x12, 0xa4, 0x42] {
000295 |         return Err(StunError::Header);
000296 |     }
000297 |     if bytes[8..20] != transaction[..] {
000298 |         return Err(StunError::Transaction);
000299 |     }
000300 |     let len = u16::from_be_bytes([bytes[2], bytes[3]]) as usize;
000301 |     if !len.is_multiple_of(4) || len + 20 != bytes.len() {
000302 |         return Err(StunError::Length);
000303 |     }
000304 |     let mut offset = 20;
000305 |     let mut mapped = None;
000306 |     while offset < bytes.len() {
000307 |         if offset + 4 > bytes.len() {
000308 |             return Err(StunError::Length);
000309 |         }
000310 |         let kind = u16::from_be_bytes([bytes[offset], bytes[offset + 1]]);
000311 |         let size = u16::from_be_bytes([bytes[offset + 2], bytes[offset + 3]]) as usize;
000312 |         let end = offset
000313 |             .checked_add(4)
000314 |             .and_then(|n| n.checked_add(size))
000315 |             .ok_or(StunError::Length)?;
000316 |         if end > bytes.len() {
000317 |             return Err(StunError::Length);
000318 |         }
000319 |         let value = &bytes[offset + 4..end];
000320 |         if kind == 0x0020 || kind == 0x0001 {
000321 |             if value.len() < 4 || value[0] != 0 {
000322 |                 return Err(StunError::AddressFamily);
000323 |             }
000324 |             let xor = kind == 0x0020;
000325 |             let ip = match (value[1], value.len()) {
000326 |                 (1, 8) => {
000327 |                     let mut octets: [u8; 4] =
000328 |                         value[4..8].try_into().map_err(|_| StunError::Length)?;
000329 |                     if xor {
000330 |                         for (n, key) in octets.iter_mut().zip([0x21, 0x12, 0xa4, 0x42]) {
000331 |                             *n ^= key;
000332 |                         }
000333 |                     }
000334 |                     IpAddr::V4(Ipv4Addr::from(octets))
000335 |                 }
000336 |                 (2, 20) => {
000337 |                     let mut octets: [u8; 16] =
000338 |                         value[4..20].try_into().map_err(|_| StunError::Length)?;
000339 |                     if xor {
000340 |                         let mut mask = [0; 16];
000341 |                         mask[..4].copy_from_slice(&[0x21, 0x12, 0xa4, 0x42]);
000342 |                         mask[4..].copy_from_slice(transaction);
000343 |                         for (n, key) in octets.iter_mut().zip(mask) {
000344 |                             *n ^= key;
000345 |                         }
000346 |                     }
000347 |                     IpAddr::V6(Ipv6Addr::from(octets))
000348 |                 }
000349 |                 _ => return Err(StunError::AddressFamily),
000350 |             };
000351 |             if mapped.is_some_and(|old| old != ip) {
000352 |                 return Err(StunError::AddressFamily);
000353 |             }
000354 |             mapped = Some(ip);
000355 |         }
000356 |         offset = end
000357 |             .checked_add((4 - size % 4) % 4)
000358 |             .ok_or(StunError::Length)?;
000359 |         if offset > bytes.len() {
000360 |             return Err(StunError::Length);
000361 |         }
000362 |     }
000363 |     mapped.ok_or(StunError::MissingAddress)
000364 | }

000366 | pub async fn stun_probe(host: &str, port: u16) -> Result<IpAddr, StunError> {
000367 |     tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(3), async {
000368 |         let mut addrs = tokio::net::lookup_host((host, port))
000369 |             .await
000370 |             .map_err(|_| StunError::Dns)?;
000371 |         let target = addrs.find(SocketAddr::is_ipv4).ok_or(StunError::Dns)?;
000372 |         let socket = tokio::net::UdpSocket::bind("0.0.0.0:0")
000373 |             .await
000374 |             .map_err(|_| StunError::Io)?;
000375 |         let mut transaction = [0; 12];
000376 |         std::fs::File::open("/dev/urandom")
000377 |             .and_then(|mut f| f.read_exact(&mut transaction))
000378 |             .map_err(|_| StunError::Io)?;
000379 |         let mut request = vec![0, 1, 0, 0, 0x21, 0x12, 0xa4, 0x42];
000380 |         request.extend_from_slice(&transaction);
000381 |         socket
000382 |             .send_to(&request, target)
000383 |             .await
000384 |             .map_err(|_| StunError::Io)?;
000385 |         let mut bytes = [0; 2048];
000386 |         let (len, source) = socket
000387 |             .recv_from(&mut bytes)
000388 |             .await
000389 |             .map_err(|_| StunError::Io)?;
000390 |         parse_stun(&bytes[..len], &transaction, target, source)
000391 |     })
000392 |     .await
000393 |     .unwrap_or(Err(StunError::Timeout))
000394 | }

000396 | pub async fn stun_all() -> Vec<Result<IpAddr, StunError>> {
000397 |     let mut tasks = tokio::task::JoinSet::new();
000398 |     let servers: Vec<_> = STUN_SERVERS
000399 |         .into_iter()
000400 |         .map(|(host, port)| (host.to_owned(), port))
000401 |         .collect();

000404 |         .try_with(|s| s.stun_servers.clone())
000405 |         .unwrap_or(servers);
000406 |     for (host, port) in servers {
000407 |         tasks.spawn(async move { stun_probe(&host, port).await });
000408 |     }
000409 |     let mut results = Vec::new();
000410 |     let deadline = tokio::time::Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(10);
000411 |     while !tasks.is_empty() {
000412 |         match tokio::time::timeout_at(deadline, tasks.join_next()).await {
000413 |             Ok(Some(Ok(result))) => results.push(result),
000414 |             Ok(Some(Err(_))) => results.push(Err(StunError::Io)),
000415 |             _ => {
000416 |                 for _ in 0..tasks.len() {
000417 |                     results.push(Err(StunError::Timeout));
000418 |                 }
000419 |                 tasks.abort_all();
000420 |                 break;
000421 |             }
000422 |         }
000423 |     }
000424 |     results
000425 | }

000029 | fn scalar(value: &str) -> io::Result<&str> {
000030 |     let value = value.trim();
000031 |     let value = if value.starts_with('"') && value.ends_with('"') && value.len() >= 2
000032 |         || value.starts_with('\'') && value.ends_with('\'') && value.len() >= 2
000033 |     {
000034 |         &value[1..value.len() - 1]
000035 |     } else {
000036 |         value
000037 |     };
000038 |     if value.is_empty()
000039 |         || value.starts_with(['?', '-', '@', '`', '|', '>', '%'])
000040 |         || matches!(
000041 |             value.to_ascii_lowercase().as_str(),
000042 |             "true" | "false" | "null" | "yes" | "no" | "on" | "off"
000043 |         )
000044 |         || value.parse::<f64>().is_ok()
000045 |         || value.contains([
000046 |             '\n', '\r', '\\', '"', '\'', ',', '#', '[', ']', '{', '}', '&', '*', '!', ':',
000047 |         ])
000048 |         || value.chars().any(char::is_control)
000049 |     {
000050 |         return Err(unsupported());
000051 |     }

000055 | pub(super) fn first_select_group(bytes: &[u8]) -> io::Result<String> {
000056 |     let text = std::str::from_utf8(bytes).map_err(|_| unsupported())?;
000057 |     let mut in_groups = false;
000058 |     let mut groups = 0;
000059 |     let mut name: Option<String> = None;
000060 |     let mut group_type: Option<String> = None;
000061 |     let mut first_select: Option<String> = None;
000062 |     let mut entries = 0;
000063 |     let mut seen_name = false;
000064 |     let mut seen_type = false;
000065 |     let mut nested_field = false;

000067 |         let line = line.trim_end_matches('\r');
000068 |         let trimmed = line.trim();
000069 |         if trimmed.is_empty() || trimmed.starts_with('#') {
000070 |             continue;
000071 |         }
000072 |         if line.starts_with(['%', '-', '{', '['])
000073 |             || line.contains("<<:")
000074 |             || (in_groups && line.contains(['&', '*', '!', '{', '}', '[', ']']))
000075 |         {
000076 |             return Err(unsupported());
000077 |         }
000078 |         if !line.starts_with(char::is_whitespace) {
000079 |             if in_groups {
000080 |                 if group_type.as_deref() == Some("select") && first_select.is_none() {
000081 |                     first_select = Some(name.take().ok_or_else(unsupported)?);
000082 |                 }
000083 |                 in_groups = false;
000084 |             }
000085 |             if line == "proxy-groups:" {
000086 |                 groups += 1;
000087 |                 in_groups = true;
000088 |             }
000089 |             continue;
000090 |         }
000091 |         if !in_groups {
000092 |             continue;
000093 |         }
000094 |         let property = if let Some(rest) = line.strip_prefix("  - ") {
000095 |             if group_type.as_deref() == Some("select") && first_select.is_none() {
000096 |                 first_select = Some(name.take().ok_or_else(unsupported)?);
000097 |             }
000098 |             entries += 1;
000099 |             name = None;
000100 |             group_type = None;
000101 |             seen_name = false;
000102 |             seen_type = false;
000103 |             rest
000104 |         } else if entries > 0 && line.starts_with("    ") && !line[4..].starts_with(' ') {
000105 |             &line[4..]
000106 |         } else if entries > 0 && line.starts_with("      ") {
000107 |             if !nested_field {
000108 |                 return Err(unsupported());
000109 |             }
000110 |             continue;
000111 |         } else {
000112 |             return Err(unsupported());
000113 |         };
000114 |         if property.contains(['&', '*', '!', '{', '}', '[', ']']) {
000115 |             return Err(unsupported());
000116 |         }
000117 |         let (key, raw) = property.split_once(':').ok_or_else(unsupported)?;
000118 |         match key {
000119 |             "name" => {
000120 |                 if seen_name {
000121 |                     return Err(unsupported());
000122 |                 }
000123 |                 name = Some(scalar(raw)?.to_owned());
000124 |                 seen_name = true;
000125 |                 nested_field = false;
000126 |             }
000127 |             "type" => {
000128 |                 if seen_type {
000129 |                     return Err(unsupported());
000130 |                 }
000131 |                 group_type = Some(scalar(raw)?.to_owned());
000132 |                 seen_type = true;
000133 |                 nested_field = false;
000134 |             }
000135 |             _ if !key.is_empty()
000136 |                 && key
000137 |                     .bytes()
000138 |                     .all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b == b'-' || b == b'_') =>
000139 |             {
000140 |                 nested_field = true;
000141 |             }
000142 |             _ => return Err(unsupported()),
000143 |         }
000144 |     }
000145 |     if in_groups && group_type.as_deref() == Some("select") && first_select.is_none() {
000146 |         first_select = Some(name.ok_or_else(unsupported)?);
000147 |     }
000148 |     if groups != 1 {
000149 |         return Err(unsupported());
000150 |     }
000151 |     first_select.ok_or_else(unsupported)
000152 | }
000153 | 
000154 | fn block(group: &str, newline: &str) -> String {
000155 |     let mut output = format!("  {BEGIN}{newline}");
000156 |     for domain in DOMAINS {
000157 |         // JSON strings are valid YAML double-quoted scalars. The whole Clash rule
000158 |         // is quoted, so a group name with spaces or Unicode cannot change YAML shape.
000159 |         let rule = format!("DOMAIN-SUFFIX,{domain},{group}");
000160 |         output.push_str("  - ");
000161 |         output.push_str(&serde_json::to_string(&rule).expect("string encoding"));
000162 |         output.push_str(newline);
000163 |     }
000164 |     output.push_str(&format!("  {END}{newline}"));
000165 |     output
000166 | }
000167 | 
000168 | pub(super) fn propose(original: Option<&[u8]>, group: &str) -> io::Result<(Vec<u8>, bool)> {
000169 |     if group.is_empty() || group.chars().any(char::is_control) {
000170 |         return Err(unsupported());
000171 |     }
000172 |     let Some(original) = original else {
000173 |         return Ok((format!("# Profile Enhancement Merge Template for Clash Verge\n\nprofile:\n  store-selected: true\n\nprepend-rules:\n{}", block(group, "\n")).into_bytes(), true));
000174 |     };
000175 |     let text = std::str::from_utf8(original).map_err(|_| unsupported())?;
000176 |     let newline = if text.contains("\r\n") { "\r\n" } else { "\n" };
000177 |     let mut clean = String::new();
000178 |     let mut in_block = false;
000179 |     let mut current_top = String::new();
000180 |     for line in text.split_inclusive('\n') {
000181 |         if line.trim() == BEGIN || line.trim() == END {
000182 |             let raw = line.trim_end_matches(['\r', '\n']);
000183 |             if raw != line.trim()
000184 |                 && !(raw == format!("  {}", line.trim()) && current_top == "prepend-rules")
000185 |             {
000186 |                 return Err(unsupported());
000187 |             }
000188 |         }
000189 |         if !line.starts_with(char::is_whitespace)
000190 |             && !line.starts_with('#')
000191 |             && let Some((key, _)) = line.split_once(':')
000192 |         {
000193 |             current_top = key.to_owned();
000194 |         }
000195 |         if line.trim() == BEGIN {
000196 |             if in_block {
000197 |                 return Err(unsupported());
000198 |             }
000199 |             in_block = true;
000200 |         } else if line.trim() == END {
000201 |             if !in_block {
000202 |                 return Err(unsupported());
000203 |             }
000204 |             in_block = false;
000205 |         } else if !in_block {
000206 |             clean.push_str(line);
000207 |         }
000208 |     }
000209 |     // An incomplete marker could hide user content; preserve it instead of deleting it.
000210 |     if in_block {
000211 |         return Err(unsupported());
000212 |     }
000213 |     let mut result = String::new();
000214 |     let mut inserted = false;
000215 |     for line in clean.split_inclusive('\n') {
000216 |         result.push_str(line);
000217 |         if !inserted && line.trim_end_matches(['\r', '\n']) == "prepend-rules:" {
000218 |             if !line.ends_with('\n') {
000219 |                 result.push_str(newline);
000220 |             }
000221 |             result.push_str(&block(group, newline));
000222 |             inserted = true;
000223 |         }
000224 |     }
000225 |     if !inserted {
000226 |         result = format!(
000227 |             "prepend-rules:{newline}{}{newline}{clean}",
000228 |             block(group, newline)
000229 |         );
000230 |     }
000231 |     let changed = result.as_bytes() != original;
000232 |     Ok((result.into_bytes(), changed))
000233 | }

000166 |     fn ready(&mut self, mode: &str) -> Result<bool, &'static str>;

000170 | fn execute_app_open_with(
000171 |     plan: &AppOpenPlan,
000172 |     backend: &mut impl AppOpener,
000173 |     now: impl Fn() -> u64,
000174 | ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000175 |     let current = now();
000176 |     if current < plan.issued_at
000177 |         || current >= plan.expires_at
000178 |         || plan.expires_at > plan.issued_at.saturating_add(120)
000179 |     {
000180 |         return Err(APP_OPEN_MANUAL);
000181 |     }
000182 |     let app = app_name(plan.mode).ok_or(APP_OPEN_MANUAL)?;
000183 |     let mode = mode_name(plan.mode);
000184 |     if !backend.running(mode)? {
000185 |         backend.open(app)?;
000186 |     }
000187 |     for _ in 0..40 {
000188 |         if backend.ready(mode)? {
000189 |             return Ok(());
000190 |         }
000191 |         backend.pause();
000192 |     }
000193 |     Err(APP_OPEN_MANUAL)
000194 | }

000013 |     }
000014 | }

000016 | fn trace_country(bytes: &[u8]) -> Option<&str> {
000017 |     let trace = std::str::from_utf8(bytes).ok()?;
000018 |     let country = trace.lines().find_map(|line| line.strip_prefix("loc="))?;
000019 |     valid_country(country).then_some(country)
000020 | }
000021 | 
000022 | fn valid_country(country: &str) -> bool {
000023 |     country.len() == 2 && country.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_uppercase())
000024 | }

000026 | fn locale_for(country: &str) -> &'static str {
000027 |     match country {
000028 |         "JP" => "ja_JP",
000029 |         "TW" => "zh_TW",
000030 |         "HK" => "zh_HK",
000031 |         "SG" => "en_SG",
000032 |         "GB" => "en_GB",
000033 |         "DE" => "de_DE",
000034 |         "FR" => "fr_FR",
000035 |         "KR" => "ko_KR",
000036 |         "AU" => "en_AU",
000037 |         "CA" => "en_CA",
000038 |         _ => "en_US",
000039 |     }
000040 | }
000041 | 
000042 | fn checked_target(
000043 |     trace: Option<&str>,
000044 |     geo: &network::GeoInfo,
000045 | ) -> Result<Option<DetectedRegion>, &'static str> {
000046 |     let Some(country) = geo
000047 |         .country
000048 |         .as_deref()
000049 |         .filter(|country| valid_country(country))
000050 |     else {
000051 |         return Ok(None);
000052 |     };
000053 |     if country == "CN" {
000054 |         return Err("出口国家为 CN；请先切换代理节点");
000055 |     }
000056 |     if trace.is_some_and(|observed| observed != country) {
000057 |         return Err("出口国家来源不一致；地区目标未更改");
000058 |     }
000059 |     let Some(timezone) = geo.timezone.as_deref() else {
000060 |         return Ok(None);
000061 |     };
000062 |     if !config::valid_timezone(timezone) {
000063 |         return Err("出口时区无效；地区目标未更改");
000064 |     }
000065 |     Ok(Some(DetectedRegion(RegionView {
000066 |         country: country.into(),
000067 |         timezone: timezone.into(),
000068 |         locale: locale_for(country).into(),
000069 |     })))
000070 | }
000071 | 
000072 | pub async fn detect(client: &Client) -> Result<DetectedRegion, &'static str> {
000073 |     let trace = network::limited_get(client, TRACE_URL, 8192).await.ok();
000074 |     let country = trace.as_deref().and_then(trace_country);
000075 |     if country == Some("CN") {
000076 |         return Err("出口国家为 CN；请先切换代理节点");
000077 |     }
000078 |     for endpoint in network::GEO_ENDPOINTS {
000079 |         let Ok(bytes) = network::limited_get(client, endpoint, network::MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES).await
000080 |         else {
000081 |             continue;
000082 |         };
000083 |         let Some(geo) = network::parse_geo(&bytes) else {
000084 |             continue;
000085 |         };
000086 |         if let Some(target) = checked_target(country, &geo)? {
000087 |             return Ok(target);
000088 |         }
000089 |     }
000090 |     Err("无法确认出口国家和时区；地区目标未更改")
000091 | }

000120 | enum Resolution {
000121 |     Applied,
000122 |     Restored,
000123 |     Unknown,
000124 | }
000125 | 
000126 | fn resolution(journal: &RegionJournal, response: &HelperResponse) -> Resolution {
000127 |     let Some(plan) = response.plan.as_ref() else {
000128 |         return Resolution::Unknown;
000129 |     };
000130 |     let Some(state) = response.state.as_ref() else {
000131 |         return Resolution::Unknown;
000132 |     };
000133 |     if plan.id != journal.plan.id
000134 |         || !state_matches(
000135 |             &SystemState {
000136 |                 timezone: plan.target.timezone.clone(),
000137 |                 network_service: plan.target.network_service.clone(),
000138 |                 ipv6: plan.target.ipv6,
000139 |             },
000140 |             &journal.plan.target,
000141 |         )
000142 |         || !original_matches(&plan.original, &journal.plan.original)
000143 |     {
000144 |         return Resolution::Unknown;
000145 |     }
000146 |     match response.code.as_str() {
000147 |         "repair_applied" | "applied"
000148 |             if response.ok && state_matches(state, &journal.plan.target) =>
000149 |         {
000150 |             Resolution::Applied
000151 |         }
000152 |         "repair_restored" | "repair_not_started"
000153 |             if original_matches(state, &journal.plan.original) =>
000154 |         {
000155 |             Resolution::Restored
000156 |         }
000157 |         _ => Resolution::Unknown,
000158 |     }
000159 | }

000483 |     fn preview_with(

000537 |     /// Consumes the in-memory plan. A failed or stale plan requires another preview.
000538 |     pub fn execute(&self, prepared: PreparedRepair) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000539 |         if prepared.legacy_region.is_some() {
000540 |             return legacy::execute(self, prepared);
000541 |         }
000542 |         crate::guardian_repair::validate(self.edition).map_err(|_| "正式系统组件尚未安装并验证")?;

000545 |             install::authorize_repair_with_lock,
000546 |             install::execute_repair_with_lock,
000547 |         )?;
000548 |         // execute_authorized_with has returned and dropped its lifecycle lock.
000549 |         crate::guardian_repair::restore_after_commit(self.edition)
000550 |     }

000575 |         self.execute_runtime_and_app_with(prepared, authorize, execute, runtime, |plan| {
000576 |             install::validate_installed_identity(self.edition, unsafe { libc::geteuid() })?;
000577 |             crate::guardian_repair::validate(self.edition)?;
000578 |             if encode(&config::load_read_only(&self.home)?)? != original_config {
000579 |                 return Err("安装身份复核期间配置已改变；请重新预览");

000584 |     fn execute_runtime_and_app_with(
000585 |         &self,
000586 |         prepared: PreparedRepair,
000587 |         authorize: impl FnOnce(&str, &storage::LifecycleLock) -> Result<(), &'static str>,
000588 |         execute: impl FnOnce(String, &storage::LifecycleLock) -> Result<HelperResponse, &'static str>,
000589 |         runtime: &mut dyn Runtime,
000590 |         app_open: impl FnOnce(&AppOpenPlan) -> Result<(), &'static str>,
000591 |     ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000592 |         let v2 = self.home.join(".claude-switcher/v2");
000593 |         if !prepared.preview.can_execute {
000594 |             return Err("修复计划不可执行，请先恢复并重新预览");
000595 |         }
000596 |         if prepared.app_open_plan.is_some() && prepared.proposed_config.proxy_mode != "surge" {
000597 |             return Err("App 打开计划与代理模式不一致，请重新预览");
000598 |         }
000599 |         let system_plan = prepared.system_plan.ok_or("系统修复计划缺失，请重新预览")?;
000600 |         let lock = storage::LifecycleLock::try_acquire(&v2)
000601 |             .map_err(|_| "其他账号、修复或安装事务正在进行")?;
000602 |         if encode(&config::load_read_only(&self.home)?)? != prepared.original_config {
000603 |             return Err("地区配置已改变，请重新预览");
000604 |         }
000605 |         if recovery_pending(&self.home)? {
000606 |             return Err("上次修复尚未完成，请先恢复事务");
000607 |         }
000608 |         // The lock remains held across the native dialog and helper's independent verification.
000609 |         // Cancellation occurs before journal creation, preferences, proxy config or target writes.
000610 |         authorize(&prepared.plan_id, &lock).map_err(|_| "管理员授权取消或未通过；系统、代理、地区格式和语言均未修改，原配置已保留；请重新预览")?;
000611 |         if encode(&config::load_read_only(&self.home)?)? != prepared.original_config {
000612 |             return Err("授权期间地区配置已改变；尚未写入，请重新预览");
000613 |         }
000614 |         if system_plan.expires_at <= crate::checks::unix_now() {
000615 |             return Err("授权后修复计划已过期；尚未写入，请重新预览");
000616 |         }
000617 |         let runtime_state = if prepared.proposed_config.proxy_mode == "clash-verge" {
000618 |             Some(RuntimeState {
000619 |                 adapter: proxy_repair::Adapter::ClashVerge,
000620 |                 originally_running: runtime.running()?,
000621 |                 reload_required: prepared
000622 |                     .user_plan
000623 |                     .as_ref()
000624 |                     .is_some_and(PreparedUserRepair::changes_proxy_files),
000625 |                 phase: Phase::Intent,
000626 |             })
000627 |         } else {
000628 |             None
000629 |         };
000630 |         let user = self.user_coordinator(prepared.user_plan.is_some())?;
000631 |         let mut journal = RegionJournal {
000632 |             schema: 1,
000633 |             owner: unsafe { libc::geteuid() },
000634 |             edition: self.edition,
000635 |             stage: RepairStage::UserPending,
000636 |             original: serde_json::from_slice(&prepared.original_config)
000637 |                 .map_err(|_| "原地区配置无效")?,
000638 |             proposed: prepared.proposed_config,
000639 |             plan: system_plan,
000640 |             user_required: prepared.user_plan.is_some(),
000641 |             receipt: None,
000642 |             runtime_state,
000643 |             app_open_plan: prepared.app_open_plan,
000644 |         };
000645 |         self.save_journal(&journal)?;
000646 |         // App dispatch has durable intent, but occurs before any user configuration write.
000647 |         // A crash or recovery never repeats this action and never stops this App.
000648 |         if let Some(plan) = &journal.app_open_plan {
000649 |             if app_open(plan).is_err() {
000650 |                 // Dispatch may already have reached the OS. Only explicit recovery clears this intent.
000651 |                 return Err(
000652 |                     "App 打开预检失败或结果未确认；未写入用户配置，已保留事务，请先恢复，再手动检查代理并重新预览",
000653 |                 );
000654 |             }
000655 |             let current = config::load_read_only(&self.home).and_then(|value| encode(&value));
000656 |             if journal.plan.expires_at <= crate::checks::unix_now()
000657 |                 || current.as_deref() != Ok(prepared.original_config.as_slice())
000658 |             {
000659 |                 return Err(
000660 |                     "App 打开后计划过期或配置无法复核；未写入用户配置，已保留事务，请先恢复，再手动检查代理并重新预览",
000661 |                 );
000662 |             }
000663 |         }
000664 |         let preparation = (|| {
000665 |             if let Some(state) = &journal.runtime_state
000666 |                 && (state.reload_required || !state.originally_running)
000667 |             {
000668 |                 runtime.stop()?;
000669 |                 self.runtime_phase(&mut journal, Phase::Stopped)?;
000670 |             }
000671 |             if let (Some(coordinator), Some(plan)) = (user.as_ref(), prepared.user_plan) {
000672 |                 journal.receipt = Some(
000673 |                     coordinator
000674 |                         .execute_with_lock(plan, &lock)
000675 |                         .map_err(|_| "用户配置修复中断")?,
000676 |                 );
000677 |                 self.save_journal(&journal)?;
000678 |             }
000679 |             if let Some(state) = &journal.runtime_state {
000680 |                 if state.reload_required || !state.originally_running {
000681 |                     self.runtime_phase(&mut journal, Phase::StartingTarget)?;
000682 |                     runtime.start()?;
000683 |                 }
000684 |                 runtime.verify(
000685 |                     journal
000686 |                         .proposed
000687 |                         .country_target
000688 |                         .as_deref()
000689 |                         .ok_or("目标国家缺失")?,
000690 |                 )?;
000691 |                 self.runtime_phase(&mut journal, Phase::TargetReady)?;
000692 |             }
000693 |             if let (Some(user), Some(receipt)) = (user.as_ref(), journal.receipt.as_ref()) {
000694 |                 user.verify_receipt_with_lock(receipt, &lock, false)
000695 |                     .map_err(|_| "代理启动后配置发生变化；未执行系统修改")?;
000696 |             }
000697 |             if journal.plan.expires_at <= crate::checks::unix_now() {
000698 |                 return Err("代理验证后原授权计划已过期；请重新预览");
000699 |             }
000700 |             Ok(())
000701 |         })();
000702 |         if let Err(error) = preparation {
000703 |             if journal.runtime_state.is_none() {
000704 |                 return Err("用户配置修复中断；请先恢复事务");
000705 |             }
000706 |             self.restore_runtime(&mut journal, user.as_ref(), &lock, runtime)?;
000707 |             return Err(error);
000708 |         }
000709 |         journal.stage = RepairStage::SystemPending;
000710 |         self.save_journal(&journal)?;
000711 |         // A missing reply cannot cancel root. Keep both journals until its result is known.
000712 |         let response = execute(prepared.plan_id, &lock)
000713 |             .map_err(|_| "系统修复结果未知；已保留事务。请使用恢复入口查询结果")?;
000714 |         match resolution(&journal, &response) {
000715 |             Resolution::Applied => self.commit_runtime(&mut journal, user.as_ref(), &lock, runtime),
000716 |             Resolution::Restored => {
000717 |                 self.restore_runtime(&mut journal, user.as_ref(), &lock, runtime)?;
000718 |                 Err("系统修复未完成，原用户配置已恢复；请重新预览")
000719 |             }
000720 |             Resolution::Unknown => Err("系统修复结果尚未确认；已保留事务，请先恢复"),
000721 |         }
000722 |     }
000723 |     fn runtime_phase(&self, journal: &mut RegionJournal, phase: Phase) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000724 |         if let Some(state) = &mut journal.runtime_state {
000725 |             state.phase = phase;
000726 |         }
000727 |         self.save_journal(journal)
000728 |     }

000739 |     fn save_journal(&self, journal: &RegionJournal) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000740 |         storage::atomic_json(&self.journal_path(), journal)
000741 |             .map_err(|_| "地区修复记录保存失败；请保留现场并恢复")

000743 |     fn read_journal(&self) -> Result<RegionJournal, &'static str> {
000744 |         let journal: RegionJournal = storage::read_json(&self.journal_path())
000745 |             .map_err(|_| "地区修复记录无法安全读取；请保留备份")?;
000746 |         journal.original.validate()?;
000747 |         journal.proposed.validate()?;
000748 |         if journal.runtime_state.is_some()
000749 |             && (journal.proposed.proxy_mode != "clash-verge"
000750 |                 || journal.original.proxy_mode != "clash-verge")
000751 |         {
000752 |             return Err("代理运行记录与配置不一致");
000753 |         }
000754 |         if journal.app_open_plan.is_some()
000755 |             && (journal.proposed.proxy_mode != "surge"
000756 |                 || journal.original.proxy_mode != "surge"
000757 |                 || journal.runtime_state.is_some())
000758 |         {
000759 |             return Err("App 打开记录与代理配置不一致");
000760 |         }
000761 |         if journal.schema != 1
000762 |             || journal.owner != unsafe { libc::geteuid() }
000763 |             || journal.edition != self.edition
000764 |             || journal.plan.id.is_empty()
000765 |             || journal.plan.id.len() > 160
000766 |             || journal.plan.target.timezone
000767 |                 != journal.proposed.timezone_target.as_deref().unwrap_or("")
000768 |             || journal.plan.target.network_service != journal.proposed.network_service
000769 |             || journal.plan.original.network_service != journal.plan.target.network_service
000770 |             || journal.plan.target.ipv6 != Ipv6Policy::Off
000771 |             || (journal.stage != RepairStage::UserPending
000772 |                 && journal.user_required
000773 |                 && journal.receipt.is_none())
000774 |         {
000775 |             return Err("地区修复记录与当前用户或目标不一致");
000776 |         }
000777 |         Ok(journal)
000778 |     }

000781 |         storage::sync_directory(&self.home.join(".claude-switcher/v2"))
000782 |             .map_err(|_| "地区修复记录同步未完成，请重试恢复")
000783 |     }

000788 |         if required {

000796 |     fn commit_runtime(
000797 |         &self,
000798 |         journal: &mut RegionJournal,
000799 |         user: Option<&UserRepairCoordinator>,
000800 |         lock: &storage::LifecycleLock,
000801 |         runtime: &mut dyn Runtime,
000802 |     ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000803 |         let current = encode(&config::load_read_only(&self.home)?)?;
000804 |         let target = encode(&journal.proposed)?;
000805 |         if current != encode(&journal.original)? && current != target {
000806 |             return Err("地区目标发生外部变化；请保留事务并核对冲突");
000807 |         }
000808 |         // Persist the decision before either local target or user journal is committed.
000809 |         journal.stage = RepairStage::CommitIntent;
000810 |         self.save_journal(journal)?;
000811 |         let config_path = self.home.join(".claude-switcher/v2/config.json");
000812 |         let missing = match fs::symlink_metadata(&config_path) {
000813 |             Ok(metadata) if metadata.is_file() => false,
000814 |             Ok(_) => return Err("已提交目标配置路径不安全；请保留事务"),
000815 |             Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => true,
000816 |             Err(_) => return Err("无法确认已提交目标配置路径；请保留事务"),
000817 |         };
000818 |         // Legacy fallback can equal the target without a durable v2 policy for Guardian.
000819 |         if current != target || missing {
000820 |             storage::atomic_json(&config_path, &journal.proposed)
000821 |                 .map_err(|_| "系统修复已完成；地区目标保存中断，请恢复事务继续提交")?;
000822 |         }
000823 |         if let (Some(user), Some(receipt)) = (user, journal.receipt.as_ref()) {
000824 |             user.commit_with_lock(receipt, lock)
000825 |                 .map_err(|_| "系统与地区目标已提交；用户配置提交待恢复")?;
000826 |         }
000827 |         if journal.runtime_state.is_some() {
000828 |             let country = journal
000829 |                 .proposed
000830 |                 .country_target
000831 |                 .as_deref()
000832 |                 .ok_or("目标国家缺失")?;
000833 |             if runtime.verify(country).is_err() {
000834 |                 // Applied is irreversible here: repair the target runtime, never original files.
000835 |                 runtime
000836 |                     .stop()
000837 |                     .and_then(|_| runtime.start())
000838 |                     .and_then(|_| runtime.verify(country))
000839 |                     .map_err(|_| "系统与用户配置已提交；代理运行状态尚未恢复，已保留事务")?;
000840 |             }
000841 |         }
000842 |         if let (Some(user), Some(receipt)) = (user, journal.receipt.as_ref()) {
000843 |             user.verify_receipt_with_lock(receipt, lock, false)
000844 |                 .map_err(|_| "系统已提交，但代理启动后配置发生变化；已保留事务")?;
000845 |         }
000846 |         self.remove_journal()
000847 |     }
000848 |     fn restore_runtime(
000849 |         &self,
000850 |         journal: &mut RegionJournal,
000851 |         user: Option<&UserRepairCoordinator>,
000852 |         lock: &storage::LifecycleLock,
000853 |         runtime: &mut dyn Runtime,
000854 |     ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000855 |         if journal.stage == RepairStage::CommitIntent {
000856 |             return Err("事务已有提交决议；请核对系统状态，不能回滚用户配置");
000857 |         }
000858 |         if encode(&config::load_read_only(&self.home)?)? != encode(&journal.original)? {
000859 |             return Err("地区目标发生外部变化；请保留事务并核对冲突");
000860 |         }
000861 |         let files_restored = journal
000862 |             .runtime_state
000863 |             .as_ref()
000864 |             .is_some_and(|state| state.phase == Phase::RestoringRuntime);
000865 |         if journal.runtime_state.is_some() && !files_restored {
000866 |             self.runtime_phase(journal, Phase::RestoringFiles)?;
000867 |             runtime
000868 |                 .stop()
000869 |                 .map_err(|_| "代理未退出，不能安全恢复文件；事务与备份已保留")?;
000870 |         }
000871 |         if !files_restored && let Some(user) = user {
000872 |             if let Some(receipt) = journal.receipt.as_ref() {
000873 |                 user.restore_with_lock(receipt, lock)
000874 |                     .map_err(|_| "原用户配置恢复未完成；请保留事务并核对冲突")?;
000875 |             } else if let Some(receipt) = user
000876 |                 .pending_receipt_with_lock(lock)
000877 |                 .map_err(|_| "中断的用户配置记录无法验证")?
000878 |             {
000879 |                 journal.receipt = Some(receipt.clone());
000880 |                 self.save_journal(journal)?;
000881 |                 user.restore_with_lock(&receipt, lock)
000882 |                     .map_err(|_| "中断的用户配置恢复未完成；请保留事务")?;
000883 |             }
000884 |         }
000885 |         if journal.runtime_state.is_some() {
000886 |             self.runtime_phase(journal, Phase::RestoringRuntime)?;
000887 |             let originally_running = journal.runtime_state.as_ref().unwrap().originally_running;
000888 |             // Retry always stops first, so a process started before a crash cannot be mistaken
000889 |             // for confirmation that the restored files were loaded.
000890 |             runtime
000891 |                 .stop()
000892 |                 .map_err(|_| "原文件已恢复，代理运行状态待恢复；事务已保留")?;
000893 |             if let (Some(user), Some(receipt)) = (user, journal.receipt.as_ref()) {
000894 |                 user.verify_receipt_with_lock(receipt, lock, true)
000895 |                     .map_err(|_| "原配置曾恢复，但文件已改变；未重新启动代理，事务已保留")?;
000896 |             }
000897 |             if originally_running {
000898 |                 runtime
000899 |                     .start()
000900 |                     .map_err(|_| "原文件已恢复，代理启动待恢复；事务已保留")?;
000901 |                 if !runtime.running()? {
000902 |                     return Err("原文件已恢复，代理启动未确认；事务已保留");
000903 |                 }
000904 |             }
000905 |         }
000906 |         if let (Some(user), Some(receipt)) = (user, journal.receipt.as_ref()) {
000907 |             user.verify_receipt_with_lock(receipt, lock, true)
000908 |                 .map_err(|_| "原配置曾恢复，但代理启动后文件发生变化；事务已保留，请核对冲突")?;
000909 |         }
000910 |         self.remove_journal()
000911 |     }
000912 |     pub fn recover_user_repair(&self) -> Result<bool, &'static str> {
000913 |         #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000914 |         {
000915 |             self.recover_validated_finishing_with(
000916 |                 || {
000917 |                     install::validate_installed_identity(self.edition, unsafe { libc::geteuid() })
000918 |                         .map(|_| ())
000919 |                 },
000920 |                 switcher_helper::native_authorization::Authorization::acquire,
000921 |                 |plan_id, authorization| {
000922 |                     let status = install::repair_status(plan_id.clone())?;
000923 |                     if status.code == "repair_recovery_required" {
000924 |                         install::recover_repair_authorized(plan_id, authorization)
000925 |                     } else {
000926 |                         Ok(status)
000927 |                     }
000928 |                 },
000929 |                 || crate::guardian_repair::restore_after_commit(self.edition),
000930 |             )
000931 |         }
000932 |         #[cfg(not(target_os = "macos"))]
000933 |         {
000934 |             Err("macos_required")
000935 |         }
000936 |     }
000937 |     #[cfg(test)]
000938 |     fn recover_validated_with<A>(
000939 |         &self,
000940 |         identity: impl FnOnce() -> Result<(), &'static str>,
000941 |         authorize: impl FnOnce() -> Result<A, &'static str>,
000942 |         status: impl FnOnce(String, &A) -> Result<HelperResponse, &'static str>,
000943 |     ) -> Result<bool, &'static str> {
000944 |         self.recover_validated_finishing_with(identity, authorize, status, || Ok(()))
000945 |     }
000946 |     fn recover_validated_finishing_with<A>(
000947 |         &self,
000948 |         identity: impl FnOnce() -> Result<(), &'static str>,
000949 |         authorize: impl FnOnce() -> Result<A, &'static str>,
000950 |         status: impl FnOnce(String, &A) -> Result<HelperResponse, &'static str>,
000951 |         after_commit: impl FnOnce() -> Result<(), &'static str>,
000952 |     ) -> Result<bool, &'static str> {
000953 |         identity().map_err(|_| "正式系统组件尚未安装并验证")?;
000954 |         let lock = storage::LifecycleLock::try_acquire(&self.home.join(".claude-switcher/v2"))
000955 |             .map_err(|_| "其他账号、修复或安装事务正在进行")?;
000956 |         let outcome = self.recover_authorized_with(&lock, authorize, status)?;
000957 |         drop(lock);
000958 |         if outcome == RecoveryOutcome::Committed {
000959 |             after_commit()?;
000960 |         }
000961 |         Ok(outcome != RecoveryOutcome::NoWork)
000962 |     }
000963 |     fn recover_authorized_with<A>(
000964 |         &self,
000965 |         lock: &storage::LifecycleLock,
000966 |         authorize: impl FnOnce() -> Result<A, &'static str>,
000967 |         status: impl FnOnce(String, &A) -> Result<HelperResponse, &'static str>,
000968 |     ) -> Result<RecoveryOutcome, &'static str> {
000969 |         let authorization =
000970 |             authorize().map_err(|_| "恢复授权取消或未通过；全部事务和备份已保留")?;
000971 |         self.recover_outcome_with(lock, |plan_id| status(plan_id, &authorization))
000972 |     }
000973 |     #[cfg(test)]
000974 |     fn recover_with(
000975 |         &self,
000976 |         lock: &storage::LifecycleLock,
000977 |         status: impl FnOnce(String) -> Result<HelperResponse, &'static str>,
000978 |     ) -> Result<bool, &'static str> {
000979 |         self.recover_outcome_with(lock, status)
000980 |             .map(|outcome| outcome != RecoveryOutcome::NoWork)
000981 |     }
000982 |     fn recover_outcome_with(
000983 |         &self,
000984 |         lock: &storage::LifecycleLock,
000985 |         status: impl FnOnce(String) -> Result<HelperResponse, &'static str>,
000986 |     ) -> Result<RecoveryOutcome, &'static str> {
000987 |         self.recover_runtime_with(lock, status, &mut proxy_repair::Native)
000988 |     }
000989 |     fn recover_runtime_with(
000990 |         &self,
000991 |         lock: &storage::LifecycleLock,
000992 |         status: impl FnOnce(String) -> Result<HelperResponse, &'static str>,
000993 |         runtime: &mut dyn Runtime,
000994 |     ) -> Result<RecoveryOutcome, &'static str> {
000995 |         if !self.has_region_journal()? {
000996 |             let user_path = self
000997 |                 .home
000998 |                 .join(".claude-switcher/v2/user-repairs/journal.json");
000999 |             match fs::symlink_metadata(&user_path) {
001000 |                 Ok(_) => {
001001 |                     // Do not let the user coordinator's existence check hide an unsafe marker.
001002 |                     storage::read_json::<serde_json::Value>(&user_path)
001003 |                         .map_err(|_| "用户配置修复记录无法安全读取；请保留事务与备份")?;
001004 |                 }
001005 |                 Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {}
001006 |                 Err(_) => return Err("无法读取用户配置修复状态"),
001007 |             }
001008 |             return UserRepairCoordinator::for_current_user(self.edition)
001009 |                 .map_err(|_| "无法确认用户修复目录")?
001010 |                 .recover_with_lock(lock)
001011 |                 .map(|recovered| {
001012 |                     if recovered {
001013 |                         RecoveryOutcome::Restored
001014 |                     } else {
001015 |                         RecoveryOutcome::NoWork
001016 |                     }
001017 |                 })
001018 |                 .map_err(|_| "用户配置恢复未完成；请保留事务与备份并核对冲突");
001019 |         }
001020 |         let mut journal = self.read_journal()?;
001021 |         let user = self.user_coordinator(journal.user_required)?;
001022 |         if journal.stage == RepairStage::UserPending {
001023 |             self.restore_runtime(&mut journal, user.as_ref(), lock, runtime)?;
001024 |             return Ok(RecoveryOutcome::Restored);
001025 |         }
001026 |         let response = status(journal.plan.id.clone())
001027 |             .map_err(|_| "系统组件仍在执行或结果未知；已保留事务，请稍后重试恢复")?;
001028 |         match resolution(&journal, &response) {
001029 |             Resolution::Applied => {
001030 |                 self.commit_runtime(&mut journal, user.as_ref(), lock, runtime)?;
001031 |                 Ok(RecoveryOutcome::Committed)
001032 |             }
001033 |             Resolution::Restored => {
001034 |                 self.restore_runtime(&mut journal, user.as_ref(), lock, runtime)?;
001035 |                 Ok(RecoveryOutcome::Restored)
001036 |             }
001037 |             Resolution::Unknown => Err("系统修复尚未得到确定结果；已保留全部事务与备份"),
001038 |         }
001039 |     }
001040 | }

001087 |                 "repair_not_started"
001088 |             },

001091 |         result.plan = Some(plan.clone());
001092 |         result.state = Some(if applied {
001093 |             SystemState {

001096 |                 ipv6: plan.target.ipv6,

001098 |         } else {
001099 |             plan.original.clone()
001100 |         });
001101 |         result
001102 |     }

001562 |             // Native stop/start rejects all calls in tests. Recovery must only clear the intent.

001576 |                 encode(&config::load_read_only(&home).unwrap()).unwrap(),

001584 |     fn app_open_post_dispatch_expiry_and_config_conflicts_keep_intent() {
001585 |         for reason in ["expired", "changed", "unreadable"] {
001586 |             let (home, coordinator) = fixture();
001587 |             let mut prepared = surge_plan(&coordinator, &home);
001588 |             if reason == "expired" {
001589 |                 prepared.system_plan.as_mut().unwrap().expires_at = crate::checks::unix_now() + 1;
001590 |             }
001591 |             let path = home.join(".claude-switcher/v2/config.json");
001592 |             let original = config::load_read_only(&home).unwrap();
001593 |             let calls = std::cell::Cell::new(0);
001594 |             let result = coordinator.execute_runtime_and_app_with(
001595 |                 prepared,
001596 |                 |_, _| Ok(()),
001597 |                 |_, _| panic!("post-open conflict must precede root"),
001598 |                 &mut proxy_repair::Native,
001599 |                 |_| {
001600 |                     calls.set(calls.get() + 1);
001601 |                     match reason {
001602 |                         "expired" => std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(2)),
001603 |                         "changed" => {
001604 |                             let mut changed = original.clone();
001605 |                             changed.network_service = "Ethernet".into();
001606 |                             storage::atomic_json(&path, &changed).unwrap();
001607 |                         }
001608 |                         _ => storage::atomic_write(&path, b"{").unwrap(),
001609 |                     }
001610 |                     Ok(())
001611 |                 },
001612 |             );
001613 |             assert!(result.unwrap_err().contains("请先恢复"));
001614 |             assert_eq!(
001615 |                 coordinator.read_journal().unwrap().stage,
001616 |                 RepairStage::UserPending
001617 |             );
001618 |             let lock =
001619 |                 storage::LifecycleLock::try_acquire(&home.join(".claude-switcher/v2")).unwrap();
001620 |             if reason != "expired" {
001621 |                 assert!(
001622 |                     coordinator
001623 |                         .recover_with(&lock, |_| panic!("must not call root"))
001624 |                         .is_err()
001625 |                 );
001626 |                 assert!(recovery_pending(&home).unwrap());
001627 |                 // Resolve only the test's injected external conflict, then retry explicit recovery.
001628 |                 storage::atomic_json(&path, &original).unwrap();
001629 |             }
001630 |             assert!(
001631 |                 coordinator
001632 |                     .recover_with(&lock, |_| panic!("UserPending must not call root"))
001633 |                     .unwrap()
001634 |             );
001635 |             assert_eq!(calls.get(), 1);
001636 |             assert!(!recovery_pending(&home).unwrap());
001637 |             assert_eq!(
001638 |                 encode(&config::load_read_only(&home).unwrap()).unwrap(),
001639 |                 encode(&original).unwrap()
001640 |             );
001641 |             drop(lock);
001642 |             fs::remove_dir_all(home).unwrap();
001643 |         }
001644 |     }

001678 |     fn images(home: &Path) -> Vec<Vec<u8>> {
001679 |         USER_FILES

001684 |     fn repair_backup_images(directory: &Path) -> std::collections::BTreeMap<PathBuf, Vec<u8>> {
001685 |         let mut images = std::collections::BTreeMap::new();
001686 |         for entry in fs::read_dir(directory).unwrap() {
001687 |             let path = entry.unwrap().path();
001688 |             if path.is_symlink() {
001689 |                 continue; // Marker targets are checked separately without following them.
001690 |             }
001691 |             if path.is_dir() {
001692 |                 images.extend(repair_backup_images(&path));
001693 |             } else {
001694 |                 images.insert(path.clone(), fs::read(path).unwrap());
001695 |             }
001696 |         }
001697 |         images
001698 |     }

002408 |     struct FakeRuntime {
002409 |         home: PathBuf,
002410 |         original: Vec<Vec<u8>>,
002411 |         running: bool,
002412 |         stops: usize,
002413 |         starts: usize,
002414 |         verifies: usize,
002415 |         fail_stop: Option<usize>,
002416 |         fail_start: Option<usize>,
002417 |         fail_verify: Option<usize>,
002418 |         delay_verify: bool,
002419 |         mutate_on_start: Option<usize>,
002420 |     }
002421 |     impl FakeRuntime {
002422 |         fn new(fixture: &Fixture, running: bool) -> Self {
002423 |             Self {
002424 |                 home: fixture.root.clone(),
002425 |                 original: images(&fixture.root),
002426 |                 running,
002427 |                 stops: 0,
002428 |                 starts: 0,

002447 |             let phase = journal.runtime_state.unwrap().phase;
002448 |             if phase == Phase::Intent {
002449 |                 assert_eq!(images(&self.home), self.original);

002459 |             let phase = self.journal().runtime_state.unwrap().phase;
002460 |             assert!(!self.running);
002461 |             if phase == Phase::RestoringRuntime {
002462 |                 assert_eq!(images(&self.home), self.original);
002463 |             } else {
002464 |                 assert_ne!(images(&self.home), self.original);
002465 |             }
002466 |             self.starts += 1;
002467 |             if self.fail_start == Some(self.starts) {
002468 |                 return Err("injected start failure");
002469 |             }

002477 |             }
002478 |             Ok(())
002479 |         }

002482 |             self.verifies += 1;

000173 | fn execute_with(
000174 |     coordinator: &RegionCoordinator,
000175 |     prepared: PreparedRepair,
000176 |     io: &mut impl Operations,
000177 | ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000178 |     let _lock = storage::LifecycleLock::try_acquire(&coordinator.home.join(".claude-switcher/v2"))
000179 |         .map_err(|_| "其他账号、修复或安装事务正在进行")?;
000180 |     if recovery_pending(&coordinator.home)? {
000181 |         return Err("旧修复事务尚未完成；请先使用恢复入口");
000182 |     }
000183 |     if encode(&config::load_read_only(&coordinator.home)?)? != prepared.original_config {
000184 |         return Err("地区配置已改变，请重新预览");
000185 |     }
000186 |     let region_only = prepared.legacy_region.ok_or("修复计划类型错误")?;
000187 |     let config = prepared.proposed_config;
000188 |     let timezone = config.timezone_target.as_deref().ok_or("目标时区缺失")?;
000189 |     let locale = UserLocale::parse(config.locale_target.as_deref().ok_or("目标地区格式缺失")?)
000190 |         .ok_or("目标地区格式无效")?;
000191 |     let mut failed = false;
000192 |     let mut guardian_failed = false;
000193 |     if region_only {
000194 |         // Preserve the original partial-completion contract when administrator access is cancelled.
000195 |         storage::atomic_json(
000196 |             &coordinator.home.join(".claude-switcher/v2/config.json"),
000197 |             &config,
000198 |         )
000199 |         .map_err(|_| "地区目标保存失败")?;
000200 |         failed |= !io.preferences(locale, true).is_empty();
000201 |     } else {
000202 |         io.proxy(&config)?;
000203 |     }
000204 |     let mut commands = Vec::new();
000205 |     let current_timezone = io.timezone();
000206 |     if current_timezone.as_deref() != Some(&format!("/var/db/timezone/zoneinfo/{timezone}")) {
000207 |         commands.push(format!(
000208 |             "/usr/sbin/systemsetup -settimezone {}",
000209 |             shell(timezone)
000210 |         ));
000211 |     }
000212 |     if region_only {
000213 |         if let Some(command) = io.watchdog_command(timezone) {
000214 |             commands.push(command);
000215 |         }
000216 |     } else {
000217 |         let ipv6 = io.command(
000218 |             "/usr/sbin/networksetup",
000219 |             &["-getinfo", &config.network_service],
000220 |         );
000221 |         if !ipv6.is_ok_and(|value| {
000222 |             value
000223 |                 .lines()
000224 |                 .any(|line| line.eq_ignore_ascii_case("IPv6: Off"))
000225 |         }) {
000226 |             commands.push(format!(
000227 |                 "/usr/sbin/networksetup -setv6off {}",
000228 |                 shell(&config.network_service)
000229 |             ));
000230 |         }
000231 |         let (guardian_commands, guardian_ready) = io.guardian_commands();
000232 |         commands.extend(guardian_commands);
000233 |         guardian_failed = !guardian_ready;
000234 |         failed |= guardian_failed;
000235 |         if !commands.is_empty() {
000236 |             commands.push("/usr/bin/dscacheutil -flushcache".into());
000237 |             commands.push("/usr/bin/killall -HUP mDNSResponder".into());
000238 |         }
000239 |     }
000240 |     if !commands.is_empty() {
000241 |         failed |= io.administrator(&commands).is_err();
000242 |     }
000243 |     if !region_only {
000244 |         failed |= !io.preferences(locale, false).is_empty();
000245 |         failed |= io.merge(&config.proxy_mode).is_err();
000246 |         // Persist the unchanged policy for Guardian, even when all system items were already correct.
000247 |         storage::atomic_json(
000248 |             &coordinator.home.join(".claude-switcher/v2/config.json"),
000249 |             &config,
000250 |         )
000251 |         .map_err(|_| "地区目标保存失败")?;
000252 |         failed |= io.proxy(&config).is_err();
000253 |     }
000254 |     if failed {
000255 |         Err(if region_only {
000256 |             "时区或地区格式未完成；国家、时区与地区格式目标已保存，可重新执行"
000257 |         } else if guardian_failed {
000258 |             "保镖服务未恢复；已继续执行其余修复，可重新修复"
000259 |         } else {
000260 |             "部分修复未完成；已继续可执行的用户项目，可重新修复"
000261 |         })
000262 |     } else {
000263 |         Ok(())
000264 |     }
000265 | }

000008 | pub enum RepairCommand {
000009 |     Fix { apply: bool },
000010 |     DetectRegion { apply: bool },
000011 |     SetRegion { preset: RegionPreset, apply: bool },
000012 | }

000014 | impl RepairCommand {
000015 |     pub fn parse(args: &[String]) -> Result<Self, String> {
000016 |         match args {
000017 |             [command] if command == "fix" => Ok(Self::Fix { apply: true }),
000018 |             [command, flag] if command == "fix" && flag == "--preview" => {
000019 |                 Ok(Self::Fix { apply: false })
000020 |             }
000021 |             [command, flag] if command == "fix" && flag == "--apply" => {
000022 |                 Ok(Self::Fix { apply: true })
000023 |             }
000024 |             [command] if command == "set-region" => Ok(Self::DetectRegion { apply: true }),
000025 |             [command, flag] if command == "set-region" && flag == "--preview" => {
000026 |                 Ok(Self::DetectRegion { apply: false })
000027 |             }
000028 |             [command, flag] if command == "set-region" && flag == "--apply" => {
000029 |                 Ok(Self::DetectRegion { apply: true })
000030 |             }
000031 |             [command, name] | [command, name, _]
000032 |                 if command == "set-region"
000033 |                     && (args.len() == 2 || matches!(args[2].as_str(), "--apply" | "--preview")) =>
000034 |             {
000035 |                 let preset = serde_json::from_value(serde_json::Value::String(name.clone()))
000036 |                     .map_err(|_| "地区只接受已列出的固定国家枚举")?;
000037 |                 Ok(Self::SetRegion {
000038 |                     preset,
000039 |                     apply: args.len() == 2 || args[2] == "--apply",
000040 |                 })
000041 |             }
000042 |             _ => Err("invalid_command".into()),
000043 |         }
000044 |     }
000045 | 
000046 |     pub fn args(self) -> Vec<String> {
000047 |         match self {
000048 |             Self::Fix { apply } => with_apply(vec!["fix".into()], apply),
000049 |             Self::DetectRegion { apply } => with_apply(vec!["set-region".into()], apply),
000050 |             Self::SetRegion { preset, apply } => with_apply(
000051 |                 vec![
000052 |                     "set-region".into(),
000053 |                     serde_json::to_value(preset)
000054 |                         .expect("fixed region enum")
000055 |                         .as_str()
000056 |                         .expect("region string")
000057 |                         .into(),
000058 |                 ],
000059 |                 apply,
000060 |             ),
000061 |         }
000062 |     }
000063 | }
000064 | 
000065 | fn with_apply(mut args: Vec<String>, apply: bool) -> Vec<String> {
000066 |     if !apply {
000067 |         args.push("--preview".into());
000068 |     }
000069 |     args

000072 | pub async fn run(command: RepairCommand, edition: Edition) -> Result<i32, String> {
000073 |     let coordinator = crate::regions::RegionCoordinator::for_current_user(edition)?;
000074 |     let prepared = match command {
000075 |         RepairCommand::Fix { .. } => coordinator.preview(None)?,
000076 |         RepairCommand::SetRegion { preset, .. } => coordinator.preview(Some(preset))?,
000077 |         RepairCommand::DetectRegion { .. } => {
000078 |             let client = crate::network::inherited_client()?;
000079 |             let detected = crate::region_detection::detect(&client).await?;
000080 |             coordinator.preview_detected(detected)?
000081 |         }
000082 |     };
000083 |     print_json(&prepared.preview)?;
000084 |     if matches!(
000085 |         command,
000086 |         RepairCommand::Fix { apply: true }
000087 |             | RepairCommand::SetRegion { apply: true, .. }
000088 |             | RepairCommand::DetectRegion { apply: true }
000089 |     ) {
000090 |         coordinator.execute(prepared)?;
000091 |         print_json(
000092 |             &serde_json::json!({"completed":true,"message":"系统修复已完成并保存地区目标；请重新检查环境与地区格式","recovery":null}),
000093 |         )?;
000094 |     }
000095 |     Ok(0)
000096 | }

000100 |     println!("{output}");
000101 |     Ok(())

000113 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000114 | pub fn installed_gui(edition: Edition) -> Result<PathBuf, &'static str> {
