000001 | //! Signed UTF-8 payloads. Verify the exact bytes before deserializing data.
000002 | use ed25519_dalek::{Signature, VerifyingKey};
000003 | use serde::{
000004 |     Deserialize, Serialize,
000005 |     de::{self, DeserializeOwned, MapAccess, SeqAccess, Visitor},
000006 | };
000007 | use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
000008 | 
000009 | #[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
000010 | #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
000011 | pub struct Envelope {
000012 |     pub payload: String,
000013 |     pub signature: Vec<u8>,
000014 | }
000015 | 
000016 | pub fn digest(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
000017 |     // ponytail: the standard byte formatter avoids a hex dependency.
000018 |     Sha256::digest(bytes)
000019 |         .iter()
000020 |         .map(|byte| format!("{byte:02x}"))
000021 |         .collect()
000022 | }
000023 | 
000024 | pub fn verify<T: DeserializeOwned>(
000025 |     wire: &[u8],
000026 |     key: &VerifyingKey,
000027 |     limit: usize,
000028 | ) -> Result<(T, String), &'static str> {
000029 |     if wire.len() > limit {
000030 |         return Err("envelope_too_large");
000031 |     }
000032 |     let envelope: Envelope = serde_json::from_slice(wire).map_err(|_| "envelope_json")?;
000033 |     let signature = Signature::from_slice(&envelope.signature).map_err(|_| "signature_shape")?;
000034 |     key.verify_strict(envelope.payload.as_bytes(), &signature)
000035 |         .map_err(|_| "signature")?;
000036 |     let data = strict_json(envelope.payload.as_bytes(), limit)?;
000037 |     Ok((data, digest(envelope.payload.as_bytes())))
000038 | }
000039 | 
000040 | /// All nested DTOs must also use `deny_unknown_fields`.
000041 | /// Parsing through this visitor rejects duplicate keys before serde can discard them.
000042 | pub fn strict_json<T: DeserializeOwned>(bytes: &[u8], limit: usize) -> Result<T, &'static str> {
000043 |     if bytes.len() > limit {
000044 |         return Err("payload_too_large");
000045 |     }
000046 |     let value: UniqueValue = serde_json::from_slice(bytes).map_err(|_| "payload_json")?;
000047 |     serde_json::from_value(value.0).map_err(|_| "payload_json")
000048 | }
000049 | 
000050 | struct UniqueValue(serde_json::Value);
000051 | 
000052 | impl<'de> Deserialize<'de> for UniqueValue {
000053 |     fn deserialize<D: de::Deserializer<'de>>(deserializer: D) -> Result<Self, D::Error> {
000054 |         struct UniqueVisitor;
000055 |         impl<'de> Visitor<'de> for UniqueVisitor {
000056 |             type Value = UniqueValue;
000057 |             fn expecting(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
000058 |                 f.write_str("JSON without duplicate keys")
000059 |             }
000060 |             fn visit_bool<E: de::Error>(self, value: bool) -> Result<Self::Value, E> {
000061 |                 Ok(UniqueValue(value.into()))
000062 |             }
000063 |             fn visit_i64<E: de::Error>(self, value: i64) -> Result<Self::Value, E> {
000064 |                 Ok(UniqueValue(value.into()))
000065 |             }
000066 |             fn visit_u64<E: de::Error>(self, value: u64) -> Result<Self::Value, E> {
000067 |                 Ok(UniqueValue(value.into()))
000068 |             }
000069 |             fn visit_f64<E: de::Error>(self, value: f64) -> Result<Self::Value, E> {
000070 |                 serde_json::Number::from_f64(value)
000071 |                     .map(|n| UniqueValue(n.into()))
000072 |                     .ok_or_else(|| E::custom("invalid number"))
000073 |             }
000074 |             fn visit_str<E: de::Error>(self, value: &str) -> Result<Self::Value, E> {
000075 |                 Ok(UniqueValue(value.into()))
000076 |             }
000077 |             fn visit_string<E: de::Error>(self, value: String) -> Result<Self::Value, E> {
000078 |                 Ok(UniqueValue(value.into()))
000079 |             }
000080 |             fn visit_none<E: de::Error>(self) -> Result<Self::Value, E> {
000081 |                 Ok(UniqueValue(serde_json::Value::Null))
000082 |             }
000083 |             fn visit_unit<E: de::Error>(self) -> Result<Self::Value, E> {
000084 |                 Ok(UniqueValue(serde_json::Value::Null))
000085 |             }
000086 |             fn visit_seq<A: SeqAccess<'de>>(
000087 |                 self,
000088 |                 mut sequence: A,
000089 |             ) -> Result<Self::Value, A::Error> {
000090 |                 let mut values = Vec::new();
000091 |                 while let Some(value) = sequence.next_element::<UniqueValue>()? {
000092 |                     values.push(value.0);
000093 |                 }
000094 |                 Ok(UniqueValue(values.into()))
000095 |             }
000096 |             fn visit_map<A: MapAccess<'de>>(self, mut map: A) -> Result<Self::Value, A::Error> {
000097 |                 let mut values = serde_json::Map::new();
000098 |                 while let Some(key) = map.next_key::<String>()? {
000099 |                     if values.contains_key(&key) {
000100 |                         return Err(de::Error::custom("duplicate key"));
000101 |                     }
000102 |                     values.insert(key, map.next_value::<UniqueValue>()?.0);
000103 |                 }
000104 |                 Ok(UniqueValue(values.into()))
000105 |             }
000106 |         }
000107 |         deserializer.deserialize_any(UniqueVisitor)
000108 |     }
000109 | }

000111 | #[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
000112 | #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
000113 | pub struct Sequence {
000114 |     pub highest: u64,
000115 |     pub payload_hash: Option<String>,
000116 | }
000117 | 
000118 | impl Sequence {
000119 |     pub fn check(&self, sequence: u64, hash: &str) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000120 |         if sequence == 0 || sequence < self.highest {
000121 |             return Err("old_sequence");
000122 |         }
000123 |         if sequence == self.highest && self.payload_hash.as_deref() != Some(hash) {
000124 |             return Err("sequence_conflict");
000125 |         }
000126 |         Ok(())
000127 |     }
000128 |     pub fn remember(&mut self, sequence: u64, hash: String) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000129 |         self.check(sequence, &hash)?;
000130 |         self.highest = sequence;
000131 |         self.payload_hash = Some(hash);
000132 |         Ok(())
000133 |     }
000134 | }

000012 | /// Held for account writes, launch and installation. Stop requests never take this lock.
000013 | #[derive(Debug)]
000014 | pub struct LifecycleLock {
000015 |     _file: File,
000016 |     directory: PathBuf,
000017 |     directory_identity: (u64, u64),
000018 |     name: &'static str,
000019 | }
000020 | 
000021 | impl Drop for LifecycleLock {
000022 |     fn drop(&mut self) {
000023 |         // Explicit unlock also releases a descriptor briefly inherited by another thread's fork/exec.
000024 |         let _ = self._file.unlock();
000025 |     }
000026 | }
000027 | 
000028 | impl LifecycleLock {
000029 |     pub fn try_acquire(directory: &Path) -> io::Result<Self> {
000030 |         Self::try_named(directory, "lifecycle.lock", true)
000031 |     }
000032 | 
000033 |     fn try_named(directory: &Path, name: &'static str, create: bool) -> io::Result<Self> {
000034 |         validate_no_symlinks(directory)?;
000035 |         let directory = directory.canonicalize()?;
000036 |         let metadata = fs::metadata(&directory)?;
000037 |         if !metadata.is_dir()
000038 |             || metadata.uid() != unsafe { libc::geteuid() }
000039 |             || metadata.mode() & 0o022 != 0
000040 |         {
000041 |             return Err(io::Error::new(
000042 |                 io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied,
000043 |                 "unsafe lifecycle directory",
000044 |             ));
000045 |         }
000046 |         let directory_identity = (metadata.dev(), metadata.ino());
000047 |         let file = OpenOptions::new()
000048 |             .read(true)
000049 |             .write(true)
000050 |             .create(create)
000051 |             .mode(0o600)
000052 |             .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW | libc::O_CLOEXEC)
000053 |             .open(directory.join(name))?;
000054 |         let metadata = file.metadata()?;
000055 |         if !metadata.is_file()
000056 |             || metadata.nlink() != 1
000057 |             || metadata.uid() != unsafe { libc::geteuid() }
000058 |             || metadata.mode() & 0o077 != 0
000059 |         {
000060 |             return Err(io::Error::new(
000061 |                 io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied,
000062 |                 "unsafe lifecycle lock",
000063 |             ));
000064 |         }
000065 |         if name != "lifecycle.lock" {
000066 |             crate::accounts::access_control(&directory)?;
000067 |             crate::accounts::access_control(&directory.join(name))?;
000068 |         }
000069 |         file.try_lock().map_err(|error| match error {
000070 |             std::fs::TryLockError::WouldBlock => {
000071 |                 io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock, "lifecycle busy")
000072 |             }
000073 |             std::fs::TryLockError::Error(error) => error,
000074 |         })?;
000075 |         let lock = Self {
000076 |             _file: file,
000077 |             directory,
000078 |             directory_identity,
000079 |             name,
000080 |         };
000081 |         if !lock.protects(&lock.directory) {
000082 |             return Err(io::Error::new(
000083 |                 io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied,
000084 |                 "lifecycle directory or lock was replaced",
000085 |             ));
000086 |         }
000087 |         Ok(lock)
000088 |     }
000089 | 
000090 |     pub fn protects(&self, directory: &Path) -> bool {
000091 |         if validate_no_symlinks(directory).is_err()
000092 |             || !directory
000093 |                 .canonicalize()
000094 |                 .is_ok_and(|path| path == self.directory)
000095 |         {
000096 |             return false;
000097 |         }
000098 |         let Ok(metadata) = fs::metadata(directory) else {
000099 |             return false;
000100 |         };
000101 |         let Ok(on_disk) = fs::symlink_metadata(directory.join(self.name)) else {
000102 |             return false;
000103 |         };
000104 |         let Ok(held) = self._file.metadata() else {
000105 |             return false;
000106 |         };
000107 |         (metadata.dev(), metadata.ino()) == self.directory_identity
000108 |             && (on_disk.dev(), on_disk.ino()) == (held.dev(), held.ino())
000109 |             && on_disk.is_file()
000110 |             && !on_disk.file_type().is_symlink()
000111 |             && on_disk.nlink() == 1
000112 |             && on_disk.uid() == unsafe { libc::geteuid() }
000113 |             && on_disk.mode() & 0o077 == 0
000114 |             && (self.name == "lifecycle.lock"
000115 |                 || crate::accounts::access_control(&directory.join(self.name)).is_ok())
000116 |     }
000117 | }

000201 |     }
000202 |     validate_no_symlinks(path)?;
000203 |     let metadata = fs::metadata(path)?;
000204 |     if metadata.uid() != unsafe { libc::geteuid() } || metadata.mode() & 0o077 != 0 {
000205 |         return Err(io::Error::new(
000206 |             io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied,
000207 |             "private directory ownership or permissions",
000208 |         ));
000209 |     }
000210 |     sync_directory(parent)
000211 | }
000212 | 
000213 | pub fn sync_directory(path: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {
000214 |     File::open(path)?.sync_all()
000215 | }
000216 | 
000217 | /// The rename is the commit point. The file and its parent are both synchronized.
000218 | pub fn atomic_write(path: &Path, bytes: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {
000219 |     let parent = path
000220 |         .parent()
000221 |         .ok_or_else(|| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput, "missing parent"))?;
000222 |     validate_no_symlinks(parent)?;
000223 |     match fs::symlink_metadata(path) {
000224 |         Ok(metadata) => {
000225 |             if !metadata.is_file()
000226 |                 || metadata.file_type().is_symlink()
000227 |                 || metadata.nlink() != 1
000228 |                 || metadata.uid() != unsafe { libc::geteuid() }
000229 |             {
000230 |                 return Err(io::Error::new(
000231 |                     io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied,
000232 |                     "unsafe metadata destination",
000233 |                 ));
000234 |             }
000235 |         }
000236 |         Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {}
000237 |         Err(error) => return Err(error),
000238 |     }
000239 |     let serial = NEXT_FILE.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
000240 |     let temporary = parent.join(format!(".write-{}-{serial}", std::process::id()));
000241 |     let mut file = OpenOptions::new()
000242 |         .write(true)
000243 |         .create_new(true)
000244 |         .mode(0o600)
000245 |         .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW | libc::O_CLOEXEC)
000246 |         .open(&temporary)?;
000247 |     let result = (|| {
000248 |         file.write_all(bytes)?;
000249 |         file.sync_all()?;
000250 |         fs::rename(&temporary, path)?;
000251 |         sync_directory(parent)
000252 |     })();
000253 |     if result.is_err() {
000254 |         let _ = fs::remove_file(&temporary);
000255 |     }
000256 |     result
000257 | }
000258 | 
000259 | pub fn atomic_json<T: Serialize>(path: &Path, value: &T) -> io::Result<()> {
000260 |     let bytes = serde_json::to_vec(value).map_err(io::Error::other)?;
000261 |     if bytes.len() as u64 > METADATA_LIMIT {
000262 |         return Err(io::Error::new(
000263 |             io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
000264 |             "metadata too large",
000265 |         ));
000266 |     }
000267 |     atomic_write(path, &bytes)
000268 | }
000269 | 
000270 | pub fn read_json<T: DeserializeOwned>(path: &Path) -> io::Result<T> {
000271 |     let bytes = read_private_bytes(path, METADATA_LIMIT as usize)?;
000272 |     crate::signed::strict_json(&bytes, METADATA_LIMIT as usize).map_err(io::Error::other)
000273 | }
000274 | 
000275 | /// Bounded private-file reader for larger signed update state. Callers choose their protocol limit.
000276 | pub fn read_private_bytes(path: &Path, limit: usize) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
000277 |     let read_limit = u64::try_from(limit)
000278 |         .ok()
000279 |         .and_then(|value| value.checked_add(1))
000280 |         .ok_or_else(|| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput, "invalid private file limit"))?;
000281 |     validate_no_symlinks(
000282 |         path.parent()
000283 |             .ok_or_else(|| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput, "missing parent"))?,
000284 |     )?;
000285 |     let file = OpenOptions::new()
000286 |         .read(true)
000287 |         .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW | libc::O_CLOEXEC | libc::O_NONBLOCK)
000288 |         .open(path)?;
000289 |     let metadata = file.metadata()?;
000290 |     if !metadata.is_file()
000291 |         || metadata.nlink() != 1
000292 |         || metadata.uid() != unsafe { libc::geteuid() }
000293 |         || metadata.mode() & 0o077 != 0
000294 |     {
000295 |         return Err(io::Error::new(
000296 |             io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied,
000297 |             "unsafe private file source",
000298 |         ));
000299 |     }
000300 |     if metadata.len() >= read_limit {
000301 |         return Err(io::Error::new(
000302 |             io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
000303 |             "private file too large",
000304 |         ));
000305 |     }
000306 |     let mut bytes = Vec::new();
000307 |     file.take(read_limit).read_to_end(&mut bytes)?;
000308 |     if bytes.len() > limit {
000309 |         return Err(io::Error::new(
000310 |             io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
000311 |             "private file too large",
000312 |         ));
000313 |     }
000314 |     Ok(bytes)
000315 | }

000573 |         struct TemporaryHome(PathBuf);
000574 |         impl Drop for TemporaryHome {
000575 |             fn drop(&mut self) {
000576 |                 let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&self.0);
000577 |             }
000578 |         }
000579 |         struct ChildGuard(std::process::Child);
000580 |         impl Drop for ChildGuard {
000581 |             fn drop(&mut self) {
000582 |                 let _ = self.0.kill();
000583 |                 let _ = self.0.wait();
000584 |             }
000585 |         }
000586 |         fn spawn(home: &Path, role: &str) -> ChildGuard {
000587 |             ChildGuard(
000588 |                 std::process::Command::new(std::env::current_exe().unwrap())
000589 |                     .args([
000590 |                         "--exact",
000591 |                         "storage::tests::lifecycle_contention_child_fixture",
000592 |                         "--nocapture",
000593 |                     ])
000594 |                     .env("HOME", home)
000595 |                     .env("SWITCHER_CONTENTION_HOME", home)
000596 |                     .env("SWITCHER_CONTENTION_ROLE", role)
000597 |                     .stdin(std::process::Stdio::null())
000598 |                     .stdout(std::process::Stdio::null())
000599 |                     .spawn()
000600 |                     .unwrap(),
000601 |             )
000602 |         }
000603 |         fn wait_success(child: &mut ChildGuard) {
000604 |             let deadline = std::time::Instant::now() + std::time::Duration::from_secs(10);
000605 |             loop {
000606 |                 if let Some(status) = child.0.try_wait().unwrap() {
000607 |                     assert!(status.success());
000608 |                     return;
000609 |                 }
000610 |                 assert!(std::time::Instant::now() < deadline, "child exit deadline");
000611 |                 std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(10));
000612 |             }
000613 |         }
000614 |         let home = TemporaryHome(std::env::temp_dir().canonicalize().unwrap().join(format!(
000615 |             "switcher-lock-contention-{}-{}",
000616 |             std::process::id(),
000617 |             NEXT_FILE.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed)
000618 |         )));
000619 |         create_private_directory(&home.0).unwrap();
000620 |         create_private_directory(&home.0.join(".claude-switcher")).unwrap();
000621 |         let v2 = home.0.join(".claude-switcher/v2");
000622 |         create_private_directory(&v2).unwrap();
000623 |         let mut gui = spawn(&home.0, "gui");
000624 |         contention_wait(&v2.join("gui-held"));
000625 |         let mut cli = spawn(&home.0, "cli");
000626 |         let mut update = spawn(&home.0, "update");
000627 |         assert_ne!(gui.0.id(), cli.0.id());
000628 |         assert_ne!(gui.0.id(), update.0.id());
000629 |         assert_ne!(cli.0.id(), update.0.id());
000630 |         contention_wait(&v2.join("cli-denied-by-gui"));
000631 |         contention_wait(&v2.join("update-denied-by-gui"));
000632 |         assert_eq!(fs::read(v2.join("shared-state")).unwrap(), b"gui");
000633 |         assert_eq!(
000634 |             LifecycleLock::try_acquire(&v2).unwrap_err().kind(),
000635 |             io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock
000636 |         );
000637 |         println!("phase=gui-held cli=WouldBlock update=WouldBlock shared=gui");
000638 |         gui.0.kill().unwrap();
000639 |         assert_eq!(gui.0.wait().unwrap().signal(), Some(libc::SIGKILL));
000640 |         atomic_write(&v2.join("retry-cli"), b"retry").unwrap();
000641 |         contention_wait(&v2.join("cli-held"));
000642 |         assert_eq!(fs::read(v2.join("shared-state")).unwrap(), b"cli");
000643 |         atomic_write(&v2.join("retry-update-denied"), b"retry").unwrap();
000644 |         contention_wait(&v2.join("update-denied-by-cli"));
000645 |         assert_eq!(fs::read(v2.join("shared-state")).unwrap(), b"cli");
000646 |         assert_eq!(
000647 |             LifecycleLock::try_acquire(&v2).unwrap_err().kind(),
000648 |             io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock
000649 |         );
000650 |         println!("phase=gui-SIGKILL cli=acquired update=WouldBlock shared=cli");
000651 |         atomic_write(&v2.join("release-cli"), b"release").unwrap();
000652 |         wait_success(&mut cli);
000653 |         atomic_write(&v2.join("retry-update-acquire"), b"retry").unwrap();
000654 |         contention_wait(&v2.join("update-acquired"));
000655 |         wait_success(&mut update);
000656 |         assert_eq!(fs::read(v2.join("shared-state")).unwrap(), b"update");
000657 |         let lock = LifecycleLock::try_acquire(&v2).unwrap();
000658 |         assert!(lock.protects(&v2));
000659 |         drop(lock);
000660 |         println!("phase=cli-released update=acquired final-lock=available shared=update");
000661 |     }

000001 | //! Local UTC continuity. No remote clock service or HTTP Date trust.
000002 | use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
000003 | 
000004 | pub const CLOCK_TOLERANCE_MS: i128 = 300_000;
000005 | 
000006 | #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
000007 | #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
000008 | pub struct ClockSample {
000009 |     pub utc_secs: i64,
000010 |     pub continuous_ms: u64,
000011 |     pub boot_id: String,
000012 | }
000013 | 
000014 | #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
000015 | #[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
000016 | pub enum ClockStatus {
000017 |     Trusted,
000018 |     NeedsRecovery { difference_secs: i64 },
000019 |     AwaitingVerifiedRefresh,
000020 | }
000021 | 
000022 | #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
000023 | #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
000024 | pub struct ClockState {
000025 |     pub status: ClockStatus,
000026 |     pub last_success_utc: Option<i64>,
000027 |     previous: Option<ClockSample>,
000028 | }
000029 | 
000030 | impl Default for ClockState {
000031 |     fn default() -> Self {
000032 |         Self {
000033 |             status: ClockStatus::Trusted,
000034 |             last_success_utc: None,
000035 |             previous: None,
000036 |         }
000037 |     }
000038 | }
000039 | 
000040 | impl ClockState {
000041 |     pub fn trusted(&self) -> bool {
000042 |         self.status == ClockStatus::Trusted
000043 |     }
000044 | 
000045 |     /// A manually established baseline permits a signed refresh, but still blocks installation.
000046 |     pub fn allows_verified_refresh(&self) -> bool {
000047 |         !matches!(self.status, ClockStatus::NeedsRecovery { .. })
000048 |     }
000049 | 
000050 |     pub fn observe(&mut self, sample: ClockSample) -> &ClockStatus {
000051 |         let mut difference_ms = 0i128;
000052 |         if let Some(previous) = &self.previous {
000053 |             if previous.boot_id == sample.boot_id {
000054 |                 if sample.continuous_ms < previous.continuous_ms {
000055 |                     difference_ms = -CLOCK_TOLERANCE_MS - 1_000;
000056 |                 } else {
000057 |                     difference_ms = (i128::from(sample.utc_secs) - i128::from(previous.utc_secs))
000058 |                         * 1_000
000059 |                         - i128::from(sample.continuous_ms - previous.continuous_ms);
000060 |                 }
000061 |             } else if let Some(last_success) = self.last_success_utc {
000062 |                 let rollback_ms = (i128::from(sample.utc_secs) - i128::from(last_success)) * 1_000;
000063 |                 if rollback_ms < -CLOCK_TOLERANCE_MS {
000064 |                     difference_ms = rollback_ms;
000065 |                 }
000066 |             }
000067 |         } else if let Some(last_success) = self.last_success_utc {
000068 |             let rollback_ms = (i128::from(sample.utc_secs) - i128::from(last_success)) * 1_000;
000069 |             if rollback_ms < -CLOCK_TOLERANCE_MS {
000070 |                 difference_ms = rollback_ms;
000071 |             }
000072 |         }
000073 |         // Repeated small rollback steps must not evade the last verified UTC anchor.
000074 |         // A user-established baseline can replace that anchor only after a signed refresh.
000075 |         if self.status != ClockStatus::AwaitingVerifiedRefresh
000076 |             && let Some(last_success) = self.last_success_utc
000077 |         {
000078 |             let rollback_ms = (i128::from(sample.utc_secs) - i128::from(last_success)) * 1_000;
000079 |             if rollback_ms < -CLOCK_TOLERANCE_MS {
000080 |                 difference_ms = rollback_ms;
000081 |             }
000082 |         }
000083 |         if difference_ms.abs() > CLOCK_TOLERANCE_MS {
000084 |             self.status = ClockStatus::NeedsRecovery {
000085 |                 difference_secs: (difference_ms / 1_000)
000086 |                     .clamp(i128::from(i64::MIN), i128::from(i64::MAX))
000087 |                     as i64,
000088 |             };
000089 |         }
000090 |         self.previous = Some(sample);
000091 |         &self.status
000092 |     }
000093 | 
000094 |     /// Display reads keep a stable baseline while still checking cumulative clock drift.
000095 |     pub fn observe_passive(&mut self, sample: ClockSample) -> &ClockStatus {
000096 |         let previous = self.previous.clone();
000097 |         let status = self.status.clone();
000098 |         let same_boot = previous
000099 |             .as_ref()
000100 |             .is_some_and(|value| value.boot_id == sample.boot_id);
000101 |         self.observe(sample);
000102 |         if same_boot && self.status == status {
000103 |             self.previous = previous;
000104 |         }
000105 |         &self.status
000106 |     }
000107 | 
000108 |     /// Explicit local action after the user fixes system time. This alone does not resume anything.
000109 |     pub fn establish_baseline(&mut self, sample: ClockSample) {
000110 |         self.previous = Some(sample);
000111 |         self.status = ClockStatus::AwaitingVerifiedRefresh;
000112 |     }
000113 | 
000114 |     /// Call only after the fixed source's signature, sequence and validity pass at this sample's UTC.
000115 |     /// Replay counters live outside ClockState and are deliberately not reset here.
000116 |     pub fn record_verified_success(&mut self, sample: ClockSample) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000117 |         self.observe(sample.clone());
000118 |         if matches!(self.status, ClockStatus::NeedsRecovery { .. }) {
000119 |             return Err("clock_recovery_required");
000120 |         }
000121 |         self.status = ClockStatus::Trusted;
000122 |         self.last_success_utc = Some(sample.utc_secs);
000123 |         Ok(())
000124 |     }
000125 | }

000127 | /// macOS's continuous clock includes sleep; Instant is intentionally not used here.
000128 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000129 | pub fn sample() -> Result<ClockSample, &'static str> {
000130 |     #[repr(C)]
000131 |     struct Timebase {
000132 |         numerator: u32,
000133 |         denominator: u32,
000134 |     }
000135 |     unsafe extern "C" {
000136 |         fn mach_continuous_time() -> u64;
000137 |         fn mach_timebase_info(info: *mut Timebase) -> i32;
000138 |     }
000139 |     let mut timebase = Timebase {
000140 |         numerator: 0,
000141 |         denominator: 0,
000142 |     };
000143 |     // SAFETY: the system writes exactly one properly aligned Timebase.
000144 |     if unsafe { mach_timebase_info(&mut timebase) } != 0 || timebase.denominator == 0 {
000145 |         return Err("continuous_clock");
000146 |     }
000147 |     // SAFETY: mach_continuous_time has no arguments or memory side effects.
000148 |     let ticks = unsafe { mach_continuous_time() };
000149 |     let continuous_ms = u128::from(ticks) * u128::from(timebase.numerator)
000150 |         / u128::from(timebase.denominator)
000151 |         / 1_000_000;
000152 |     let boot = std::process::Command::new("/usr/sbin/sysctl")
000153 |         .args(["-n", "kern.bootsessionuuid"])
000154 |         .output()
000155 |         .map_err(|_| "boot_id")?;
000156 |     if !boot.status.success() {
000157 |         return Err("boot_id");
000158 |     }
000159 |     let boot_id = String::from_utf8(boot.stdout)
000160 |         .map_err(|_| "boot_id")?
000161 |         .trim()
000162 |         .to_owned();
000163 |     if boot_id.len() != 36 || !boot_id.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_hexdigit() || b == b'-') {
000164 |         return Err("boot_id");
000165 |     }
000166 |     let utc_secs = std::time::SystemTime::now()
000167 |         .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
000168 |         .map_err(|_| "utc_before_epoch")?
000169 |         .as_secs()
000170 |         .try_into()
000171 |         .map_err(|_| "utc_overflow")?;
000172 |     Ok(ClockSample {
000173 |         utc_secs,
000174 |         continuous_ms: continuous_ms
000175 |             .try_into()
000176 |             .map_err(|_| "continuous_overflow")?,
000177 |         boot_id,
000178 |     })
000179 | }

000001 | //! Independent, hourly reconciliation of an administrator-authorized timezone.
000002 | use std::{
000003 |     path::{Path, PathBuf},
000004 |     time::{Duration, Instant},
000005 | };
000006 | 
000007 | const INTERVAL: Duration = Duration::from_secs(3600);
000008 | const RETRY_INTERVAL: Duration = Duration::from_secs(5);
000009 | 
000010 | /// The blocking XPC call has exactly one slot. A late call never creates a second writer.
000011 | #[derive(Default)]
000012 | struct Scheduler {
000013 |     flight: Option<tokio::task::JoinHandle<Result<(), &'static str>>>,
000014 |     next_attempt: Option<Instant>,
000015 | }
000016 | 
000017 | impl Scheduler {
000018 |     async fn tick_at<F>(&mut self, now: Instant, operation: F)
000019 |     where
000020 |         F: FnOnce() -> Result<(), &'static str> + Send + 'static,
000021 |     {
000022 |         if self
000023 |             .flight
000024 |             .as_ref()
000025 |             .is_some_and(|flight| !flight.is_finished())
000026 |         {
000027 |             return;
000028 |         }
000029 |         if let Some(flight) = self.flight.take() {
000030 |             let delay = match flight.await {
000031 |                 Ok(Err("timezone_guard_lifecycle_busy" | "timezone_guard_transaction_pending")) => {
000032 |                     RETRY_INTERVAL
000033 |                 }
000034 |                 _ => INTERVAL,
000035 |             };
000036 |             self.next_attempt = Some(now + delay);
000037 |         }
000038 |         if self.next_attempt.is_some_and(|next| now < next) {
000039 |             return;
000040 |         }
000041 |         self.flight = Some(tokio::task::spawn_blocking(operation));
000042 |     }
000043 | }
000044 | 
000045 | /// Read the configured target without waiting for unrelated lifecycle transactions.
000046 | fn reconcile_with<F>(v2: &Path, call: F) -> Result<(), &'static str>
000047 | where
000048 |     F: FnOnce(String) -> Result<(), &'static str>,
000049 | {
000050 |     crate::storage::validate_no_symlinks(v2).map_err(|_| "timezone_guard_configuration")?;
000051 |     let bytes =
000052 |         std::fs::read(v2.join("config.json")).map_err(|_| "timezone_guard_policy_missing")?;
000053 |     let config: crate::config::CheckConfig =
000054 |         serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).map_err(|_| "timezone_guard_policy_invalid")?;
000055 |     let expected = config
000056 |         .timezone_target
000057 |         .filter(|zone| crate::config::valid_timezone(zone))
000058 |         .ok_or("timezone_guard_policy_missing")?;
000059 |     call(expected)
000060 | }

000066 |         if current.as_deref()

000089 | /// Poll immediately for RunAtLoad, then dispatch only when the result-dependent delay expires.

000131 | pub fn authenticate_candidate(
000132 |     wire: &[u8],
000133 |     key: &VerifyingKey,
000134 |     context: &PinnedContext<'_>,
000135 |     sequence: &Sequence,
000136 |     now: u64,
000137 |     time_trusted: bool,
000138 | ) -> Result<Candidate, &'static str> {
000139 |     if !time_trusted {
000140 |         return Err("clock_recovery_required");
000141 |     }
000142 |     let (metadata, payload_hash): (Metadata, _) = signed::verify(wire, key, METADATA_LIMIT)?;
000143 |     if metadata.schema_version != 1 {
000144 |         return Err("schema_version");
000145 |     }
000146 |     if metadata.edition != context.edition
000147 |         || metadata.channel != context.channel
000148 |         || metadata.platform != "macos"
000149 |         || metadata.architecture != context.architecture
000150 |         || metadata.key_id != context.key_id
000151 |     {
000152 |         return Err("release_context");
000153 |     }
000154 |     if !valid_token(&metadata.key_id)
000155 |         || !valid_token(&metadata.release_id)
000156 |         || !valid_token(&metadata.channel)
000157 |         || !matches!(metadata.architecture.as_str(), "aarch64" | "x86_64")
000158 |     {
000159 |         return Err("release_identifier");
000160 |     }
000161 |     if metadata.issued_at > now
000162 |         || metadata.expires_at <= now
000163 |         || metadata.expires_at <= metadata.issued_at
000164 |     {
000165 |         return Err("metadata_expired");
000166 |     }
000167 |     if metadata.version.cmp_precedence(context.installed_app) != Ordering::Greater {
000168 |         return Err("downgrade_or_same_version");
000169 |     }
000170 |     if metadata.app.version != metadata.version {
000171 |         return Err("app_version_mismatch");
000172 |     }
000173 |     validate_artifact(&metadata.app, ArtifactKind::App, context)?;
000174 |     let final_helper = match &metadata.helper {
000175 |         Some(helper) => {
000176 |             validate_artifact(helper, ArtifactKind::Helper, context)?;
000177 |             if context
000178 |                 .installed_helper
000179 |                 .is_some_and(|v| helper.version.cmp_precedence(v) == Ordering::Less)
000180 |             {
000181 |                 return Err("helper_downgrade");
000182 |             }
000183 |             if !helper.compatible_with.matches(&metadata.version) {
000184 |                 return Err("helper_app_incompatible");
000185 |             }
000186 |             &helper.version
000187 |         }
000188 |         None => context.installed_helper.ok_or("helper_missing")?,
000189 |     };
000190 |     if !metadata.app.compatible_with.matches(final_helper) {
000191 |         return Err("app_helper_incompatible");
000192 |     }
000193 |     // Both the final pair and the intermediate pair must be compatible.
000194 |     let install_order = match &metadata.helper {

000196 |         Some(helper) if helper.compatible_with.matches(context.installed_app) => {

000198 |         }
000199 |         Some(_)
000200 |             if context
000201 |                 .installed_helper
000202 |                 .is_some_and(|v| metadata.app.compatible_with.matches(v)) =>
000203 |         {
000204 |             InstallOrder::AppThenHelper
000205 |         }
000206 |         Some(_) => return Err("compatible_bridge_required"),
000207 |     };

000211 |         payload_hash,

000545 |         &mut self,
000546 |         candidate: &Candidate,
000547 |         explicit_retry: bool,
000548 |     ) -> Result<bool, &'static str> {
000549 |         self.sequence
000550 |             .remember(candidate.metadata.sequence, candidate.payload_hash.clone())?;
000551 |         let failed = self
000552 |             .failures
000553 |             .iter()
000554 |             .any(|item| item.combination == candidate.combination());
000555 |         if let Some(pending) = &self.candidate
000556 |             && matches!(
000557 |                 pending.stage,
000558 |                 InstallStage::InstallingHelper
000559 |                     | InstallStage::InstallingApp
000560 |                     | InstallStage::AwaitingHealth
000561 |                     | InstallStage::RecoveryRequired
000562 |             )
000563 |         {
000564 |             return Err("install_recovery_required");
000565 |         }
000566 |         if failed && !explicit_retry {
000567 |             // Keep the newest authenticated candidate available for an explicit retry.
000568 |             // Retaining an older wire here would make resume fail its sequence check.
000569 |             self.candidate = Some(PendingCandidate {
000570 |                 wire: candidate.wire.clone(),
000571 |                 payload_hash: candidate.payload_hash.clone(),
000572 |                 stage: InstallStage::Rejected,
000573 |                 install_order: candidate.install_order,
000574 |             });
000575 |             return Ok(false);
000576 |         }
000577 |         if let Some(pending) = &self.candidate
000578 |             && pending.payload_hash == candidate.payload_hash
000579 |             && !matches!(
000580 |                 pending.stage,
000581 |                 InstallStage::RolledBack | InstallStage::Rejected
000582 |             )
000583 |         {
000584 |             return Ok(true);
000585 |         }
000586 |         self.candidate = Some(PendingCandidate {
000587 |             wire: candidate.wire.clone(),
000588 |             payload_hash: candidate.payload_hash.clone(),
000589 |             stage: InstallStage::Authenticated,
000590 |             install_order: candidate.install_order,
000591 |         });
000592 |         Ok(true)
000593 |     }
000594 | 
000595 |     /// Restored candidates are authenticated again. A JSON cache cannot mint a Candidate.
000596 |     pub fn resume(
000597 |         &self,
000598 |         key: &VerifyingKey,
000599 |         context: &PinnedContext<'_>,
000600 |         now: u64,
000601 |         time_trusted: bool,
000602 |     ) -> Result<Candidate, &'static str> {
000603 |         let pending = self.candidate.as_ref().ok_or("no_candidate")?;
000604 |         let candidate = authenticate_candidate(
000605 |             &pending.wire,
000606 |             key,
000607 |             context,
000608 |             &self.sequence,
000609 |             now,
000610 |             time_trusted,
000611 |         )?;
000612 |         if candidate.payload_hash != pending.payload_hash
000613 |             || candidate.install_order != pending.install_order
000614 |         {
000615 |             return Err("candidate_binding");
000616 |         }
000617 |         Ok(candidate)
000618 |     }
000619 | 
000620 |     pub fn mark_downloaded(
000621 |         &mut self,
000622 |         candidate: &Candidate,
000623 |         app: &VerifiedDownload,
000624 |         helper: Option<&VerifiedDownload>,
000625 |     ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000626 |         self.check_binding(candidate)?;
000627 |         check_proof(
000628 |             candidate,
000629 |             ArtifactKind::App,
000630 |             &app.candidate_hash,
000631 |             &app.artifact_hash,
000632 |             app.kind,
000633 |         )?;
000634 |         match (candidate.metadata.helper.as_ref(), helper) {
000635 |             (Some(_), Some(proof)) => check_proof(
000636 |                 candidate,
000637 |                 ArtifactKind::Helper,
000638 |                 &proof.candidate_hash,
000639 |                 &proof.artifact_hash,
000640 |                 proof.kind,
000641 |             )?,
000642 |             (Some(_), None) | (None, Some(_)) => return Err("helper_proof"),
000643 |             (None, None) => (),
000644 |         }
000645 |         if self.candidate.as_ref().unwrap().stage == InstallStage::Downloaded {
000646 |             return Ok(());
000647 |         }
000648 |         if self.candidate.as_ref().unwrap().stage != InstallStage::Authenticated {
000649 |             return Err("install_stage");
000650 |         }
000651 |         self.candidate.as_mut().unwrap().stage = InstallStage::Downloaded;
000652 |         Ok(())
000653 |     }

000655 |     /// The caller holds the lifecycle lock and supplies fresh local process/compatibility observations.
000656 |     pub fn begin_install(
000657 |         &mut self,
000658 |         candidate: &Candidate,
000659 |         app: &AppleIdentity,
000660 |         helper: Option<&AppleIdentity>,
000661 |         readiness: InstallReadiness,
000662 |     ) -> Result<InstallStage, &'static str> {
000663 |         self.check_binding(candidate)?;
000664 |         if !readiness.clock_trusted {
000665 |             return Err("clock_recovery_required");
000666 |         }
000667 |         if !readiness.claude_exited || !readiness.account_idle {
000668 |             return Err("lifecycle_busy");
000669 |         }
000670 |         if !readiness.components_compatible {
000671 |             return Err("components_incompatible");
000672 |         }
000673 |         if readiness.now >= candidate.metadata.expires_at
000674 |             || readiness.now < candidate.metadata.issued_at
000675 |         {
000676 |             return Err("metadata_expired");
000677 |         }
000678 |         check_proof(
000679 |             candidate,
000680 |             ArtifactKind::App,
000681 |             &app.candidate_hash,
000682 |             &app.artifact_hash,
000683 |             app.kind,
000684 |         )?;
000685 |         match (candidate.metadata.helper.as_ref(), helper) {
000686 |             (Some(_), Some(proof)) => check_proof(
000687 |                 candidate,
000688 |                 ArtifactKind::Helper,
000689 |                 &proof.candidate_hash,
000690 |                 &proof.artifact_hash,
000691 |                 proof.kind,
000692 |             )?,
000693 |             (Some(_), None) | (None, Some(_)) => return Err("helper_apple_identity"),
000694 |             (None, None) => (),
000695 |         }
000696 |         let pending = self.candidate.as_mut().unwrap();
000697 |         if pending.stage != InstallStage::Downloaded {
000698 |             return Err("install_stage");
000699 |         }
000700 |         pending.stage = if candidate.install_order == InstallOrder::HelperThenApp {
000701 |             InstallStage::InstallingHelper
000702 |         } else {
000703 |             InstallStage::InstallingApp
000704 |         };
000705 |         Ok(pending.stage)
000706 |     }
000707 | 
000708 |     pub fn advance_install(
000709 |         &mut self,
000710 |         expected: InstallStage,
000711 |         next: InstallStage,
000712 |     ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000713 |         let pending = self.candidate.as_mut().ok_or("no_candidate")?;
000714 |         let ordered_step = match pending.install_order {
000715 |             InstallOrder::AppOnly => {
000716 |                 (expected, next) == (InstallStage::InstallingApp, InstallStage::AwaitingHealth)
000717 |             }
000718 |             InstallOrder::HelperThenApp => matches!(
000719 |                 (expected, next),
000720 |                 (InstallStage::InstallingHelper, InstallStage::InstallingApp)
000721 |                     | (InstallStage::InstallingApp, InstallStage::AwaitingHealth)
000722 |             ),
000723 |             InstallOrder::AppThenHelper => matches!(
000724 |                 (expected, next),
000725 |                 (InstallStage::InstallingApp, InstallStage::InstallingHelper)
000726 |                     | (InstallStage::InstallingHelper, InstallStage::AwaitingHealth)
000727 |             ),
000728 |         };
000729 |         if !ordered_step
000730 |             && !matches!(
000731 |                 (expected, next),
000732 |                 (InstallStage::AwaitingHealth, InstallStage::Healthy)
000733 |                     | (InstallStage::RecoveryRequired, InstallStage::RolledBack)
000734 |             )
000735 |         {
000736 |             return Err("invalid_install_transition");
000737 |         }
000738 |         if pending.stage != expected {
000739 |             return Err("install_stage");
000740 |         }
000741 |         pending.stage = next;
000742 |         Ok(())
000743 |     }
000744 | 
000745 |     /// No automatic assumption about which filesystem version won an interrupted install.
000746 |     pub fn recover_interrupted(&mut self) -> bool {
000747 |         if let Some(pending) = &mut self.candidate
000748 |             && matches!(
000749 |                 pending.stage,
000750 |                 InstallStage::InstallingHelper
000751 |                     | InstallStage::InstallingApp
000752 |                     | InstallStage::AwaitingHealth
000753 |             )
000754 |         {
000755 |             pending.stage = InstallStage::RecoveryRequired;
000756 |             return true;
000757 |         }
000758 |         false
000759 |     }
000760 | 
000761 |     pub fn record_failure(
000762 |         &mut self,
000763 |         candidate: &Candidate,
000764 |         reason: &str,
000765 |         now: u64,
000766 |     ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000767 |         self.check_binding(candidate)?;
000768 |         if reason.is_empty()
000769 |             || reason.len() > 128
000770 |             || !reason
000771 |                 .bytes()
000772 |                 .all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b"_-".contains(&b))
000773 |         {
000774 |             return Err("failure_reason");
000775 |         }
000776 |         let combination = candidate.combination();
000777 |         self.failures.retain(|item| item.combination != combination);
000778 |         self.failures.push(FailedArtifact {
000779 |             combination,
000780 |             reason: reason.into(),
000781 |             recorded_at: now,
000782 |         });
000783 |         if self.failures.len() > MAX_FAILURES {
000784 |             self.failures.remove(0);
000785 |         }
000786 |         let pending = self.candidate.as_mut().unwrap();
000787 |         pending.stage = if matches!(
000788 |             pending.stage,
000789 |             InstallStage::InstallingHelper
000790 |                 | InstallStage::InstallingApp
000791 |                 | InstallStage::AwaitingHealth
000792 |                 | InstallStage::RecoveryRequired
000793 |         ) {
000794 |             InstallStage::RecoveryRequired
000795 |         } else {
000796 |             InstallStage::Rejected
000797 |         };
000798 |         Ok(())
000799 |     }

000801 |     pub fn encode(&self) -> Result<Vec<u8>, &'static str> {
000802 |         let bytes = serde_json::to_vec(self).map_err(|_| "update_state")?;
000803 |         if bytes.len() > STATE_LIMIT {
000804 |             return Err("update_state_too_large");
000805 |         }
000806 |         Ok(bytes)
000807 |     }
000808 | 
000809 |     pub fn decode(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<Self, &'static str> {
000810 |         let state: Self = signed::strict_json(bytes, STATE_LIMIT)?;
000811 |         if state.failures.len() > MAX_FAILURES
000812 |             || state.failures.iter().any(|f| {
000813 |                 !valid_combination(&f.combination)
000814 |                     || f.reason.is_empty()
000815 |                     || f.reason.len() > 128
000816 |                     || !f
000817 |                         .reason
000818 |                         .bytes()
000819 |                         .all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b"_-".contains(&b))
000820 |             })
000821 |             || (state.sequence.highest == 0) != state.sequence.payload_hash.is_none()
000822 |             || state
000823 |                 .sequence
000824 |                 .payload_hash
000825 |                 .as_ref()
000826 |                 .is_some_and(|hash| !is_hash(hash))
000827 |             || state
000828 |                 .candidate
000829 |                 .as_ref()
000830 |                 .is_some_and(|c| c.wire.len() > METADATA_LIMIT || !is_hash(&c.payload_hash))
000831 |         {
000832 |             return Err("update_state_bounds");
000833 |         }
000834 |         Ok(state)
000835 |     }
000836 | 
000837 |     fn check_binding(&self, candidate: &Candidate) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000838 |         if self.candidate.as_ref().map(|p| p.payload_hash.as_str())
000839 |             != Some(candidate.payload_hash.as_str())
000840 |         {
000841 |             return Err("candidate_binding");
000842 |         }
000843 |         self.sequence
000844 |             .check(candidate.metadata.sequence, &candidate.payload_hash)
000845 |     }
000846 | }
000847 | 
000848 | fn valid_combination(value: &str) -> bool {
000849 |     value
000850 |         .split_once(':')
000851 |         .is_some_and(|(app, helper)| is_hash(app) && (helper == "none" || is_hash(helper)))
000852 | }
000853 | 
000854 | fn check_proof(
000855 |     candidate: &Candidate,
000856 |     expected_kind: ArtifactKind,
000857 |     candidate_hash: &str,
000858 |     artifact_hash: &str,
000859 |     actual_kind: ArtifactKind,
000860 | ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000861 |     if actual_kind != expected_kind
000862 |         || candidate_hash != candidate.payload_hash
000863 |         || artifact_hash != candidate.artifact(expected_kind)?.sha256
000864 |     {
000865 |         return Err("artifact_binding");
000866 |     }
000867 |     Ok(())
000868 | }

000871 |     pub claude_exited: bool,

000873 |     pub components_compatible: bool,
000874 |     pub clock_trusted: bool,
000875 |     pub now: u64,

000878 | #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
000879 | #[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
000880 | pub enum UpdateAction {
000881 |     Check,
000882 |     Download,
000883 |     Install,
000884 | }
000885 | 
000886 | #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
000887 | #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
000888 | pub struct UpdateSchedule {
000889 |     pub edition: Edition,
000890 |     pub paused: bool,
000891 |     pub deferred_until: Option<u64>,
000892 |     pub next_check_at: u64,
000893 |     pub failures: u8,
000894 |     in_flight: Option<UpdateAction>,
000895 | }
000896 | 
000897 | impl UpdateSchedule {
000898 |     pub fn new(edition: Edition, now: u64) -> Self {
000899 |         Self {
000900 |             edition,
000901 |             paused: false,
000902 |             deferred_until: None,
000903 |             next_check_at: now.saturating_add(CHECK_INTERVAL),
000904 |             failures: 0,
000905 |             in_flight: None,
000906 |         }
000907 |     }
000908 |     pub fn automatic_check_due(&self, now: u64) -> bool {
000909 |         self.edition == Edition::Public
000910 |             && !self.paused
000911 |             && self.in_flight.is_none()
000912 |             && now >= self.next_check_at
000913 |     }
000914 |     pub fn begin(
000915 |         &mut self,
000916 |         action: UpdateAction,
000917 |         user_requested: bool,
000918 |         now: u64,
000919 |     ) -> Result<bool, &'static str> {
000920 |         if self.in_flight.is_some() {
000921 |             return Ok(false);
000922 |         }
000923 |         if !user_requested {
000924 |             if self.edition == Edition::Personal {
000925 |                 return Err("personal_requires_user_action");
000926 |             }
000927 |             if self.paused {
000928 |                 return Err("updates_paused");
000929 |             }
000930 |             if action == UpdateAction::Check && now < self.next_check_at {
000931 |                 return Err("check_not_due");
000932 |             }
000933 |             if action == UpdateAction::Install
000934 |                 && self.deferred_until.is_some_and(|until| now < until)
000935 |             {
000936 |                 return Err("installation_deferred");
000937 |             }
000938 |         }
000939 |         self.in_flight = Some(action);
000940 |         Ok(true)
000941 |     }
000942 |     pub fn success(&mut self, action: UpdateAction, now: u64) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000943 |         if self.in_flight != Some(action) {
000944 |             return Err("update_action");
000945 |         }
000946 |         self.in_flight = None;
000947 |         self.failures = 0;
000948 |         if action == UpdateAction::Check {
000949 |             self.next_check_at = now.saturating_add(CHECK_INTERVAL);
000950 |         }
000951 |         Ok(())
000952 |     }
000953 |     pub fn transient_failure(&mut self, now: u64) {
000954 |         self.in_flight = None;
000955 |         let backoff = [60, 300, 900, 1800, 3600];
000956 |         self.next_check_at =
000957 |             now.saturating_add(backoff[usize::from(self.failures).min(backoff.len() - 1)]);
000958 |         self.failures = self.failures.saturating_add(1);
000959 |     }
000960 |     pub fn authorization_cancelled(&mut self) {
000961 |         self.in_flight = None;
000962 |     }
000963 |     /// Called after acquiring the OS lifecycle lock on process restart.
000964 |     pub fn recover_process(&mut self) {
000965 |         self.in_flight = None;
000966 |     }
000967 | }

001453 | /// Build-time release configuration. It has no Deserialize implementation and is
001454 | /// never accepted by IPC, CLI arguments, preferences, or unsigned server metadata.
001455 | pub struct ReleasePinSpec {
001456 |     pub edition: Edition,
001457 |     pub metadata_url: &'static str,
001458 |     pub metadata_key: [u8; 32],
001459 |     pub key_id: &'static str,
001460 |     pub minisign_key: &'static str,
001461 |     pub channel: &'static str,
001462 |     pub architecture: &'static str,
001463 |     pub app_bundle_id: &'static str,
001464 |     pub helper_bundle_id: &'static str,
001465 |     pub team_id: &'static str,
001466 |     pub artifact_origin: &'static str,
001467 |     pub artifact_prefix: &'static str,
001468 | }
001469 | #[derive(Clone)]
001470 | pub struct ValidatedReleasePins {
001471 |     metadata_url: Url,
001472 |     metadata_key: VerifyingKey,
001473 |     minisign_key: &'static str,
001474 |     edition: Edition,
001475 |     key_id: &'static str,
001476 |     channel: &'static str,
001477 |     architecture: &'static str,
001478 |     app_bundle_id: &'static str,
001479 |     helper_bundle_id: &'static str,
001480 |     team_id: &'static str,
001481 |     artifact_origin: &'static str,
001482 |     artifact_prefix: &'static str,
001483 | }
001484 | impl ValidatedReleasePins {
001485 |     pub fn validate(spec: ReleasePinSpec) -> Result<Self, &'static str> {
001486 |         let url = Url::parse(spec.metadata_url).map_err(|_| "metadata_pin_url")?;
001487 |         let origin = Url::parse(spec.artifact_origin).map_err(|_| "artifact_pin_origin")?;
001488 |         if url.scheme() != "https"
001489 |             || url.host_str().is_none()
001490 |             || !url.username().is_empty()
001491 |             || url.password().is_some()
001492 |             || url.port_or_known_default() != Some(443)
001493 |             || url.query().is_some()
001494 |             || url.fragment().is_some()
001495 |             || url.path().contains('%')
001496 |             || url.origin() != origin.origin()
001497 |             || !url.path().starts_with(spec.artifact_prefix)
001498 |             || !spec.artifact_prefix.starts_with('/')
001499 |             || !spec.artifact_prefix.ends_with('/')
001500 |             || !valid_token(spec.key_id)
001501 |             || !valid_token(spec.channel)
001502 |             || !matches!(spec.architecture, "aarch64" | "x86_64")
001503 |             || !valid_bundle(spec.app_bundle_id)
001504 |             || !valid_bundle(spec.helper_bundle_id)
001505 |             || !valid_team(spec.team_id)
001506 |         {
001507 |             return Err("release_pins");
001508 |         }
001509 |         let metadata_key =
001510 |             VerifyingKey::from_bytes(&spec.metadata_key).map_err(|_| "metadata_pin_key")?;
001511 |         minisign_verify::PublicKey::decode(spec.minisign_key).map_err(|_| "minisign_pin_key")?;
001512 |         Ok(Self {
001513 |             metadata_url: url,
001514 |             metadata_key,
001515 |             minisign_key: spec.minisign_key,
001516 |             edition: spec.edition,
001517 |             key_id: spec.key_id,
001518 |             channel: spec.channel,
001519 |             architecture: spec.architecture,
001520 |             app_bundle_id: spec.app_bundle_id,
001521 |             helper_bundle_id: spec.helper_bundle_id,
001522 |             team_id: spec.team_id,
001523 |             artifact_origin: spec.artifact_origin,
001524 |             artifact_prefix: spec.artifact_prefix,
001525 |         })
001526 |     }
001527 |     pub fn edition(&self) -> Edition {
001528 |         self.edition
001529 |     }
001530 |     pub fn minisign_public_key(&self) -> &str {
001531 |         self.minisign_key
001532 |     }

001534 |         &'a self,

001537 |     ) -> PinnedContext<'a> {
001538 |         PinnedContext {
001539 |             edition: self.edition,
001540 |             channel: self.channel,
001541 |             architecture: self.architecture,
001542 |             key_id: self.key_id,
001543 |             app_bundle_id: self.app_bundle_id,
001544 |             helper_bundle_id: self.helper_bundle_id,
001545 |             team_id: self.team_id,
001546 |             artifact_origin: self.artifact_origin,
001547 |             artifact_prefix: self.artifact_prefix,
001548 |             installed_app: app,
001549 |             installed_helper: helper,
001550 |         }
001551 |     }
001552 |     pub fn restore(
001553 |         &self,
001554 |         state: &UpdateState,

001556 |         helper: Option<&Version>,
001557 |         now: u64,
001558 |         clock_allows_refresh: bool,
001559 |     ) -> Result<Candidate, &'static str> {
001560 |         state.resume(

001572 | // Keep production and isolated TLS tests on the same transport policy.
001573 | fn release_client_builder() -> reqwest::ClientBuilder {
001574 |     reqwest::Client::builder()
001575 |         .https_only(true)
001576 |         .no_proxy()
001577 |         .redirect(reqwest::redirect::Policy::none())
001578 |         .connect_timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(10))
001579 |         .timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(120))
001580 |         .user_agent("ClaudeSwitcher/0.2 update")
001581 | }
001582 | 
001583 | pub struct ReleaseTransport {
001584 |     pins: ValidatedReleasePins,
001585 |     client: reqwest::Client,
001586 | }
001587 | impl ReleaseTransport {
001588 |     /// Dedicated worker thread avoids nesting a Tokio runtime in an IPC executor.
001589 |     pub fn check_blocking(
001590 |         &self,
001591 |         state: &UpdateState,
001592 |         app: &Version,
001593 |         helper: Option<&Version>,
001594 |         now: u64,
001595 |         clock_allows_refresh: bool,
001596 |     ) -> Result<Candidate, &'static str> {
001597 |         std::thread::scope(|scope| {
001598 |             scope
001599 |                 .spawn(|| {
001600 |                     let runtime = tokio::runtime::Builder::new_current_thread()
001601 |                         .enable_all()
001602 |                         .build()
001603 |                         .map_err(|_| "update_runtime")?;
001604 |                     runtime.block_on(self.check(state, app, helper, now, clock_allows_refresh))
001605 |                 })
001606 |                 .join()
001607 |                 .map_err(|_| "update_worker")?
001608 |         })
001609 |     }
001610 |     pub fn download_blocking(
001611 |         &self,
001612 |         candidate: &Candidate,
001613 |         kind: ArtifactKind,
001614 |         now: u64,
001615 |     ) -> Result<(Vec<u8>, VerifiedDownload), &'static str> {
001616 |         std::thread::scope(|scope| {
001617 |             scope
001618 |                 .spawn(|| {
001619 |                     let runtime = tokio::runtime::Builder::new_current_thread()
001620 |                         .enable_all()
001621 |                         .build()
001622 |                         .map_err(|_| "update_runtime")?;
001623 |                     runtime.block_on(self.download(candidate, kind, now))
001624 |                 })
001625 |                 .join()
001626 |                 .map_err(|_| "update_worker")?
001627 |         })
001628 |     }
001629 |     pub fn new(pins: ValidatedReleasePins) -> Result<Self, &'static str> {
001630 |         let client = release_client_builder()
001631 |             .build()
001632 |             .map_err(|_| "update_transport")?;
001633 |         Ok(Self { pins, client })
001634 |     }
001635 |     pub async fn check(
001636 |         &self,
001637 |         state: &UpdateState,
001638 |         app: &Version,
001639 |         helper: Option<&Version>,
001640 |         now: u64,
001641 |         clock_allows_refresh: bool,
001642 |     ) -> Result<Candidate, &'static str> {
001643 |         if !clock_allows_refresh {
001644 |             return Err("clock_recovery_required");
001645 |         }
001646 |         let bytes = self
001647 |             .fetch(self.pins.metadata_url.as_str(), METADATA_LIMIT)
001648 |             .await?;
001649 |         authenticate_candidate(
001650 |             &bytes,
001651 |             &self.pins.metadata_key,
001652 |             &self.pins.context(app, helper),
001653 |             &state.sequence,
001654 |             now,
001655 |             clock_allows_refresh,
001656 |         )
001657 |     }
001658 |     pub async fn download(
001659 |         &self,
001660 |         candidate: &Candidate,
001661 |         kind: ArtifactKind,
001662 |         now: u64,
001663 |     ) -> Result<(Vec<u8>, VerifiedDownload), &'static str> {
001664 |         self.validate_candidate(candidate)?;
001665 |         if candidate.metadata.issued_at > now || candidate.metadata.expires_at <= now {
001666 |             return Err("metadata_expired");
001667 |         }
001668 |         let artifact = candidate.artifact(kind)?;
001669 |         // Repeat source restrictions against these build's pins before issuing any request.
001670 |         let unused_version = Version::new(0, 0, 0);
001671 |         validate_artifact(artifact, kind, &self.pins.context(&unused_version, None))?;
001672 |         if candidate.metadata.edition != self.pins.edition
001673 |             || candidate.metadata.key_id != self.pins.key_id
001674 |         {
001675 |             return Err("release_context");
001676 |         }
001677 |         let bytes = self
001678 |             .fetch(
001679 |                 &artifact.url,
001680 |                 artifact.size.try_into().map_err(|_| "artifact_bounds")?,
001681 |             )
001682 |             .await?;
001683 |         let proof = verify_download(candidate, kind, &bytes, self.pins.minisign_key)?;
001684 |         Ok((bytes, proof))
001685 |     }
001686 |     async fn fetch(&self, url: &str, limit: usize) -> Result<Vec<u8>, &'static str> {
001687 |         let mut response = self
001688 |             .client
001689 |             .get(url)
001690 |             .send()
001691 |             .await
001692 |             .map_err(|_| "update_network")?;
001693 |         if response.url().as_str() != url || !response.status().is_success() {
001694 |             return Err("update_http_status_or_redirect");
001695 |         }
001696 |         if response
001697 |             .content_length()
001698 |             .is_some_and(|size| size > limit as u64)
001699 |         {
001700 |             return Err("update_response_too_large");
001701 |         }
001702 |         let mut bytes = Vec::new();
001703 |         while let Some(chunk) = response.chunk().await.map_err(|_| "update_network")? {
001704 |             if chunk.len() > limit.saturating_sub(bytes.len()) {
001705 |                 return Err("update_response_too_large");
001706 |             }
001707 |             bytes.extend_from_slice(&chunk);
001708 |         }
001709 |         Ok(bytes)
001710 |     }
001711 |     pub fn verify_cached(
001712 |         &self,
001713 |         candidate: &Candidate,
001714 |         kind: ArtifactKind,
001715 |         bytes: &[u8],
001716 |     ) -> Result<VerifiedDownload, &'static str> {
001717 |         self.validate_candidate(candidate)?;
001718 |         verify_download(candidate, kind, bytes, self.pins.minisign_key)
001719 |     }
001720 |     fn validate_candidate(&self, candidate: &Candidate) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
001721 |         let (metadata, hash): (Metadata, _) =
001722 |             signed::verify(&candidate.wire, &self.pins.metadata_key, METADATA_LIMIT)?;
001723 |         if hash != candidate.payload_hash
001724 |             || metadata.edition != self.pins.edition
001725 |             || metadata.key_id != self.pins.key_id
001726 |             || metadata.channel != self.pins.channel
001727 |             || metadata.architecture != self.pins.architecture
001728 |             || metadata.platform != "macos"
001729 |         {
001730 |             return Err("release_context");
001731 |         }
001732 |         Ok(())
001733 |     }
001734 | }

001736 | /// Sealed Apple assessments for the same authenticated candidate are required
001737 | /// before a coordinator receives staged paths. This method performs no install.
001738 | pub struct PreparedInstallation {
001739 |     candidate: Candidate,
001740 |     app_path: std::path::PathBuf,
001741 |     helper_path: Option<std::path::PathBuf>,
001742 |     app_identity: AppleIdentity,
001743 |     helper_identity: Option<AppleIdentity>,
001744 | }
001745 | impl PreparedInstallation {
001746 |     pub fn candidate(&self) -> &Candidate {
001747 |         &self.candidate
001748 |     }
001749 |     pub fn app_path(&self) -> &Path {
001750 |         &self.app_path
001751 |     }
001752 |     /// The assessed CodeDirectory hash. The coordinator must compare this after
001753 |     /// its privileged copy and also verify the copied bundle's strict resource seal.
001754 |     pub fn app_cdhash(&self) -> &str {
001755 |         &self.app_identity.app_cdhash
001756 |     }
001757 |     pub fn helper_path(&self) -> Option<&Path> {
001758 |         self.helper_path.as_deref()
001759 |     }
001760 |     pub fn begin(
001761 |         &self,
001762 |         state: &mut UpdateState,
001763 |         readiness: InstallReadiness,
001764 |     ) -> Result<InstallStage, &'static str> {
001765 |         state.begin_install(
001766 |             &self.candidate,
001767 |             &self.app_identity,
001768 |             self.helper_identity.as_ref(),
001769 |             readiness,
001770 |         )
001771 |     }
001772 | }
001773 | pub fn assess_staged_installation(
001774 |     candidate: Candidate,
001775 |     app: &VerifiedDownload,
001776 |     app_path: &Path,
001777 |     helper: Option<(&VerifiedDownload, &Path)>,
001778 | ) -> Result<PreparedInstallation, &'static str> {
001779 |     if app.kind != ArtifactKind::App
001780 |         || helper.is_some_and(|(proof, _)| proof.kind != ArtifactKind::Helper)
001781 |     {
001782 |         return Err("artifact_binding");
001783 |     }
001784 |     let app_identity = verify_apple_identity(&candidate, app, app_path)?;
001785 |     let helper_identity = match (candidate.metadata.helper.as_ref(), helper) {
001786 |         (Some(_), Some((proof, path))) => Some(verify_apple_identity(&candidate, proof, path)?),
001787 |         (None, None) => None,
001788 |         _ => return Err("helper_apple_identity"),
001789 |     };
001790 |     Ok(PreparedInstallation {
001791 |         candidate,
001792 |         app_path: app_path.to_owned(),
001793 |         helper_path: helper.map(|(_, path)| path.to_owned()),
001794 |         app_identity,
001795 |         helper_identity,
001796 |     })
001797 | }
001798 | /// A platform coordinator must retain verified compatible backups, persist each
001799 | /// step, use Installer authorization for helper changes, and verify final health.
001800 | /// Production without that coordinator must report WAIT and never begin_install.
001801 | pub trait UpdateInstallCoordinator {
001802 |     fn install(
001803 |         &mut self,
001804 |         prepared: &PreparedInstallation,
001805 |         state: &mut UpdateState,
001806 |     ) -> Result<(), &'static str>;
001807 | }

001809 | /// Unpack only authenticated archive bytes into a new private directory. The tar
001810 | /// library's unpack_in path checks remain enabled in addition to these bounds.
001811 | pub fn stage_app_archive(
001812 |     candidate: &Candidate,
001813 |     proof: &VerifiedDownload,
001814 |     bytes: &[u8],
001815 |     staging: &Path,
001816 | ) -> Result<std::path::PathBuf, &'static str> {
001817 |     use std::path::Component;
001818 |     check_proof(
001819 |         candidate,
001820 |         ArtifactKind::App,
001821 |         &proof.candidate_hash,
001822 |         &proof.artifact_hash,
001823 |         proof.kind,
001824 |     )?;
001825 |     if bytes.len() as u64 != candidate.metadata.app.size
001826 |         || signed::digest(bytes) != proof.artifact_hash
001827 |     {
001828 |         return Err("staging_artifact_binding");
001829 |     }
001830 |     crate::storage::create_private_directory(staging).map_err(|_| "staging_directory")?;
001831 |     if std::fs::read_dir(staging)
001832 |         .map_err(|_| "staging_directory")?
001833 |         .next()
001834 |         .is_some()
001835 |     {
001836 |         return Err("staging_not_empty");
001837 |     }
001838 |     let result = (|| {
001839 |         let decoder = flate2::read::GzDecoder::new(bytes);
001840 |         let mut archive = tar::Archive::new(decoder);
001841 |         let mut total = 0u64;
001842 |         let mut count = 0u32;
001843 |         let mut app_root = None;
001844 |         for entry in archive.entries().map_err(|_| "app_archive")? {
001845 |             let mut entry = entry.map_err(|_| "app_archive")?;
001846 |             count = count.checked_add(1).ok_or("app_archive_bounds")?;
001847 |             total = total
001848 |                 .checked_add(entry.size())
001849 |                 .ok_or("app_archive_bounds")?;
001850 |             if count > 50_000 || total > 2 * MAX_ARTIFACT_SIZE {
001851 |                 return Err("app_archive_bounds");
001852 |             }
001853 |             let path = entry.path().map_err(|_| "app_archive_path")?.into_owned();
001854 |             let parts: Vec<_> = path.components().collect();
001855 |             if parts.is_empty()
001856 |                 || parts
001857 |                     .iter()
001858 |                     .any(|part| !matches!(part, Component::Normal(_)))
001859 |             {
001860 |                 return Err("app_archive_path");
001861 |             }
001862 |             let Component::Normal(root) = parts[0] else {
001863 |                 return Err("app_archive_path");
001864 |             };
001865 |             let root = root.to_str().ok_or("app_archive_path")?;
001866 |             if !root.ends_with(".app") || root.len() > 255 {
001867 |                 return Err("app_archive_root");
001868 |             }
001869 |             if app_root.as_ref().is_some_and(|old: &String| old != root) {
001870 |                 return Err("app_archive_root");
001871 |             }
001872 |             app_root = Some(root.to_owned());
001873 |             let kind = entry.header().entry_type();
001874 |             if !(kind.is_file() || kind.is_dir() || kind.is_symlink() || kind.is_hard_link()) {
001875 |                 return Err("app_archive_entry");
001876 |             }
001877 |             if kind.is_symlink() || kind.is_hard_link() {
001878 |                 let target = entry
001879 |                     .link_name()
001880 |                     .map_err(|_| "app_archive_link")?
001881 |                     .ok_or("app_archive_link")?;
001882 |                 let mut depth = if kind.is_hard_link() {
001883 |                     0
001884 |                 } else {
001885 |                     parts.len() - 1
001886 |                 };
001887 |                 for part in target.components() {
001888 |                     match part {
001889 |                         Component::Normal(_) => depth += 1,
001890 |                         Component::CurDir => (),
001891 |                         Component::ParentDir if depth > 1 => depth -= 1,
001892 |                         _ => return Err("app_archive_link"),
001893 |                     }
001894 |                 }
001895 |                 if depth == 0 {
001896 |                     return Err("app_archive_link");
001897 |                 }
001898 |             }
001899 |             if !entry.unpack_in(staging).map_err(|_| "app_archive_unpack")? {
001900 |                 return Err("app_archive_path");
001901 |             }
001902 |         }
001903 |         let app = staging.join(app_root.ok_or("app_archive_empty")?);
001904 |         let metadata = std::fs::symlink_metadata(&app).map_err(|_| "app_archive_root")?;
001905 |         if !metadata.is_dir() || metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
001906 |             return Err("app_archive_root");
001907 |         }
001908 |         Ok(app)
001909 |     })();
001910 |     if result.is_err() {
001911 |         let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(staging);
001912 |     }
001913 |     result
001914 | }

002302 |     fn archive_paths_links_and_expansion_are_bounded_before_apple_assessment() {
002303 |         fn archive(link: bool) -> Vec<u8> {
002304 |             let mut output =
002305 |                 flate2::write::GzEncoder::new(Vec::new(), flate2::Compression::default());
002306 |             {
002307 |                 let mut tar = tar::Builder::new(&mut output);
002308 |                 let mut header = tar::Header::new_gnu();
002309 |                 header.set_mode(0o755);
002310 |                 if link {
002311 |                     header.set_entry_type(tar::EntryType::Symlink);
002312 |                     header.set_size(0);
002313 |                     header.set_link_name("/tmp/outside-switcher-test").unwrap();
002314 |                     header.set_cksum();
002315 |                     tar.append_data(&mut header, "Test.app/Contents/link", std::io::empty())
002316 |                         .unwrap();
002317 |                 } else {
002318 |                     let data = b"test";
002319 |                     header.set_entry_type(tar::EntryType::Regular);
002320 |                     header.set_size(data.len() as u64);
002321 |                     header.set_cksum();
002322 |                     tar.append_data(&mut header, "Test.app/Contents/Info.plist", &data[..])
002323 |                         .unwrap();
002324 |                 }
002325 |                 tar.finish().unwrap();
002326 |             }
002327 |             output.flush().unwrap();
002328 |             output.finish().unwrap()
002329 |         }
002330 |         for link in [false, true] {
002331 |             let bytes = archive(link);
002332 |             let mut metadata = super::tests::metadata();
002333 |             metadata.app.size = bytes.len() as u64;
002334 |             metadata.app.sha256 = signed::digest(&bytes);
002335 |             let key = ed25519_dalek::SigningKey::from_bytes(&[17; 32]);
002336 |             let installed = Version::new(1, 0, 0);
002337 |             let candidate = authenticate_candidate(
002338 |                 &super::tests::sign(&metadata, &key),
002339 |                 &key.verifying_key(),
002340 |                 &TlsFixture::pins().context(&installed, Some(&installed)),
002341 |                 &Sequence::default(),
002342 |                 200,
002343 |                 true,
002344 |             )
002345 |             .unwrap();
002346 |             // This unit test isolates tar validation. It does not claim this synthetic
002347 |             // archive has a Minisign or Apple signature. Real callers cannot mint proof.
002348 |             let proof = VerifiedDownload {
002349 |                 candidate_hash: candidate.payload_hash.clone(),
002350 |                 artifact_hash: metadata.app.sha256,
002351 |                 kind: ArtifactKind::App,
002352 |             };
002353 |             let staging = std::env::temp_dir().canonicalize().unwrap().join(format!(
002354 |                 "switcher-archive-{}-{}",
002355 |                 std::process::id(),
002356 |                 SERIAL.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed)
002357 |             ));
002358 |             let result = stage_app_archive(&candidate, &proof, &bytes, &staging);
002359 |             if link {
002360 |                 assert_eq!(result.unwrap_err(), "app_archive_link");
002361 |                 assert!(!staging.exists());
002362 |             } else {
002363 |                 assert!(result.unwrap().join("Contents/Info.plist").exists());
002364 |                 std::fs::remove_dir_all(staging).unwrap();
002365 |             }
002366 |         }

000054 | fn repair_legacy_preferences_with(
000055 |     locale: Option<UserLocale>,

000057 | ) -> Vec<String> {
000058 |     let result = if let Some(locale) = locale {

000070 |             .lines()
000071 |             .nth(1)
000072 |             .unwrap_or("")
000073 |             .trim_matches(|c: char| c.is_whitespace() || matches!(c, ',' | '"'));
000074 |         if app.contains("en-US") || first.starts_with("en") {
000075 |             Ok(String::new())
000076 |         } else {
000077 |             run(&[
000078 |                 "write",
000079 |                 "com.anthropic.claudefordesktop",
000080 |                 "AppleLanguages",
000081 |                 "-array",
000082 |                 "en-US",
000083 |             ])
000084 |         }
000085 |     };

000089 | /// Restore only the legacy top-level false text, after the normal three-second quit wait.
000090 | pub(crate) fn repair_legacy_tun() -> Result<bool, String> {
000091 |     if cfg!(test) {
000092 |         return Err("native_user_tun_disabled_in_tests".into());
000093 |     }
000094 |     let home =
000095 |         crate::migration::account_home(unsafe { libc::geteuid() }).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
000096 |     repair_legacy_tun_at(&home, &mut crate::proxy_repair::Native).map_err(|e| e.to_string())
000097 | }
000098 | fn repair_legacy_tun_at(
000099 |     home: &Path,
000100 |     runtime: &mut impl crate::proxy_repair::Runtime,
000101 | ) -> io::Result<bool> {
000102 |     let path = home.join(Kind::Proxy.relative());
000103 |     let path = path.canonicalize().unwrap_or(path);
000104 |     let original = match fs::read(&path) {
000105 |         Ok(bytes) => bytes,
000106 |         Err(e) if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok(false),
000107 |         Err(e) => return Err(e),
000108 |     };
000109 |     let (proposed, changed) = proxy_proposal(&original)?;
000110 |     if !changed {
000111 |         return Ok(false);
000112 |     }
000113 |     runtime.stop().map_err(fail)?;
000114 |     // Refuse to overwrite an unrelated edit made while the app was quitting.
000115 |     if fs::read(&path)? != original {
000116 |         return Err(fail("代理配置在退出期间变化"));
000117 |     }
000118 |     replace_file(&path, &proposed, unsafe { libc::geteuid() })?;
000119 |     runtime.start().map_err(fail)?;
000120 |     Ok(true)
000121 | }
